local function CreateButton(text, yPos, callback)

    Button.Parent = MainFrame

    local BtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    BtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
    BtnCorner.Parent = Button

    local BtnStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    BtnStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(35, 55, 85)
    BtnStroke.Thickness = 1
    BtnStroke.Parent = Button

    local state = false
    Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

            Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 240)
            Button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            BtnStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255)

            Button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 210, 255)
            BtnStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(35, 55, 85)
        end
        callback(state)
    end)
end

-- 2. SISTEMA DE DETECCIÓN VISIBLE (SISTEMA ANTI-PAREDES)
local function IsVisible(targetHead)
    local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local destination = targetHead.Position
    local direction = destination - origin

    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    
    -- Ignorar a nuestro propio personaje y al enemigo que estamos evaluando
    local ignoreList = {}
    if LocalPlayer.Character then table.insert(ignoreList, LocalPlayer.Character) end
    if targetHead.Parent then table.insert(ignoreList, targetHead.Parent) end
    
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignoreList
    raycastParams.IgnoreWater = true

    -- Lanzar un "rayo" desde la cámara hasta la cabeza del jugador
    local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, raycastParams)

    -- Si el rayo no choca contra ninguna pared/mapa, está visible
    return result == nil
end

-- BÚSQUEDA DEL JUGADOR MÁS CERCANO (DENTRO DEL CÍRCULO Y VISIBLE)
local function GetClosestPlayer()
    local closest = nil
    local maxDist = FOVRadius
    local screenCenter = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)

    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and player.Character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
            local head = player.Character.Head
            local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
            
            if onScreen then
                local dist = (Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y) - screenCenter).Magnitude
                
                -- Verificar 1: Está dentro del círculo
                if dist < maxDist then
                    -- Verificar 2: NO está detrás de una pared (Visible Check)
                    if IsVisible(head) then
                        maxDist = dist
                        closest = player
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return closest
end

-- 3. BOTONES DEL MENÚ

    ESPEnabled = active
    if not active then
        for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("AngelESP") then
                player.Character.AngelESP:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end
end)

    if AimbotEnabled then
        local target = GetClosestPlayer()
        if target and target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
            Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, target.Character.Head.Position)
        end
    end

    -- Ejecución de View Players (ESP)
    if ESPEnabled then
        for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

                    highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) -- Blanco
                    highlight.FillTransparency = 0.35
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

local RunService  = game:GetService("RunService")
local REMOTE_NAME = "ForgeAnemoRemote"

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SERVER
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function runServer()
	local Players           = game:GetService("Players")
	local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local AssetService      = game:GetService("AssetService")

	local COOLDOWNS = { Animation = 1.5, ResetAnimations = 1.5 }

	-- RemoteEvent (created here so nothing has to be placed manually)
	local remote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(REMOTE_NAME)
	if not remote then
		remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
		remote.Name = REMOTE_NAME
		remote.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	end

	-- Deploy a client-context copy of THIS script so players run the UI half automatically
	do
		local existing = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("ForgeAnemoClient")
		if existing then existing:Destroy() end
		local copy = script:Clone()
		copy.Name = "ForgeAnemoClient"
		copy.RunContext = Enum.RunContext.Client
		copy.Enabled = true
		copy.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	end

	local lastAction = {}  -- [Player] = { [action] = os.clock() }
	local busy       = {}  -- [Player] = true while a request is running

	local function tell(player, message)
		if player.Parent then remote:FireClient(player, "msg", message) end
	end

	local function getLivingHumanoid(player)
		local char = player.Character
		local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if char and hum and hum.Health > 0 and char.Parent then
			return hum
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function isValidId(v)
		return typeof(v) == "number" and v == math.floor(v) and v > 0 and v < 1e13
	end

	-- Bundle item names (e.g. "Ninja Run") -> HumanoidDescription property
	local ANIM_KEYWORDS = {
		{ "swim",  "SwimAnimation"  }, { "mood",  "MoodAnimation"  },
		{ "idle",  "IdleAnimation"  }, { "walk",  "WalkAnimation"  },
		{ "run",   "RunAnimation"   }, { "jump",  "JumpAnimation"  },
		{ "fall",  "FallAnimation"  }, { "climb", "ClimbAnimation" },
	}
	local ANIM_PROPS = { "SwimAnimation", "MoodAnimation", "IdleAnimation", "WalkAnimation",
		"RunAnimation", "JumpAnimation", "FallAnimation", "ClimbAnimation" }

	local function applyAnimationBundle(player, bundleId)
		local hum = getLivingHumanoid(player)
		if not hum then tell(player, "No living character found."); return end

		local ok, details = pcall(AssetService.GetBundleDetailsAsync, AssetService, bundleId)
		if not ok or typeof(details) ~= "table" or typeof(details.Items) ~= "table" then
			warn("[Forge - Anemo] GetBundleDetailsAsync failed: " .. tostring(details))
			tell(player, "Could not read that animation pack.")
			return
		end

		local mapped, count, seenNames = {}, 0, {}
		for _, item in ipairs(details.Items) do
			if typeof(item.Name) == "string" and typeof(item.Id) == "number" then
				table.insert(seenNames, item.Name)
				local lower = item.Name:lower()
				local isSwimIdle = lower:find("%f[%a]swim") and lower:find("%f[%a]idle")
				if not isSwimIdle then
					for _, pair in ipairs(ANIM_KEYWORDS) do
						if mapped[pair[2]] == nil and lower:find("%f[%a]" .. pair[1]) then
							mapped[pair[2]] = item.Id
							count += 1
							break
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if count == 0 then
			warn("[Forge - Anemo] No animations recognised in bundle. Items: " .. table.concat(seenNames, ", "))
			tell(player, "That pack has no recognisable animations.")
			return
		end

		-- Layer 1: apply through the character's HumanoidDescription (replicates from the server)
		local okApply, err = pcall(function()
			local desc = hum:GetAppliedDescription()
			for prop, id in pairs(mapped) do desc[prop] = id end
			hum:ApplyDescription(desc)
		end)
		if not okApply then
			warn("[Forge - Anemo] ApplyDescription (animations) failed: " .. tostring(err))
		end

		-- Layer 2: hand the IDs to the client, which writes them into its Animate script
		if player.Parent then remote:FireClient(player, "animMap", mapped) end
	end

	local function resetAnimations(player)
		local hum = getLivingHumanoid(player)
		if not hum then return end
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			local desc = hum:GetAppliedDescription()
			for _, prop in ipairs(ANIM_PROPS) do desc[prop] = 0 end
			hum:ApplyDescription(desc)
		end)
		if not ok then warn("[Forge - Anemo] Animation reset failed: " .. tostring(err)) end
	end

	remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action, value)
		if typeof(action) ~= "string" then return end
		local cooldown = COOLDOWNS[action]
		if not cooldown then return end
		if action == "Animation" and not isValidId(value) then return end

		if busy[player] then return end
		lastAction[player] = lastAction[player] or {}
		local now = os.clock()
		if lastAction[player][action] and now - lastAction[player][action] < cooldown then return end
		lastAction[player][action] = now

		busy[player] = true
		local ok, err
		if action == "Animation" then
			ok, err = pcall(applyAnimationBundle, player, value)
		else
			ok, err = pcall(resetAnimations, player)
		end
		busy[player] = nil
		if not ok then warn("[Forge - Anemo] " .. action .. " error: " .. tostring(err)) end
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		lastAction[player] = nil
		busy[player] = nil
	end)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CLIENT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function runClient()
	local Players             = game:GetService("Players")
	local ReplicatedStorage   = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local TweenService        = game:GetService("TweenService")
	local UserInputService    = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local AvatarEditorService = game:GetService("AvatarEditorService")

	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
	local PlayerGui   = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

	--// Config
	local LOGO_ID    = "rbxassetid://134885781177002"
	local TOGGLE_KEY = Enum.KeyCode.RightControl
	local WIN_W, WIN_H = 420, 440
	local ACTION_DEBOUNCE = 1.0

	local COLORS = {
		Background = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 10),
		Panel      = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20),
		Element    = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30),
		Hover      = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50),
		Stroke     = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70),
		Text       = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
		SubText    = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 160),
	}
	local TWEEN_FAST = TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	local TWEEN_MED  = TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

	local STYLES = { { "Solid", 0 }, { "Glass", 0.25 }, { "Clear", 0.5 } }
	local SIZES  = { { "Small", 44 }, { "Medium", 56 }, { "Large", 72 } }

	--// State
	local connections    = {}
	local currentTrack   = nil
	local lastActionTime = 0
	local originalIds    = {}   -- [Animation instance] = original AnimationId
	local selectedPack   = nil  -- last animation pack (property -> id), re-applied on respawn

	local function track(conn)
		table.insert(connections, conn)
		return conn
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- UI helpers
	----------------------------------------------------------------------------
	local function new(class, props, parent)
		local inst = Instance.new(class)
		for k, v in pairs(props) do inst[k] = v end
		if parent then inst.Parent = parent end
		return inst
	end

	local function corner(parent, radius)
		return new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = radius or UDim.new(0, 8) }, parent)
	end

	local function stroke(parent, color, thickness)
		return new("UIStroke", {
			Color = color or COLORS.Stroke, Thickness = thickness or 1,
			ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
		}, parent)
	end

	local function tween(inst, info, props)
		TweenService:Create(inst, info, props):Play()
	end

	local function makeButton(parent, text, size, position)
		local btn = new("TextButton", {
			Text = text, Size = size, Position = position or UDim2.new(),
			BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.Element, TextColor3 = COLORS.Text,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextSize = 13, AutoButtonColor = false,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		}, parent)
		corner(btn, UDim.new(0, 8))
		stroke(btn)
		track(btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(btn, TWEEN_FAST, { BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.Hover }) end))
		track(btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(btn, TWEEN_FAST, { BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.Element }) end))
		return btn
	end

	local function makeTextBox(parent, placeholder, size, position)
		local box = new("TextBox", {
			PlaceholderText = placeholder, PlaceholderColor3 = COLORS.SubText, Text = "",
			Size = size, Position = position or UDim2.new(),
			BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.Element, TextColor3 = COLORS.Text,
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 13, ClearTextOnFocus = false,
		}, parent)
		corner(box, UDim.new(0, 8))
		stroke(box)
		return box
	end

	local function makeScroller(parent, size, position)
		local sf = new("ScrollingFrame", {

			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement

				local delta = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y) - dragStart
				if delta.Magnitude > 6 then moved = true end

					local x = math.clamp(startPos.X + delta.X, 0, vp.X - bubble.AbsoluteSize.X)

		return nil

	local function stopAnimation()
		if currentTrack then
			pcall(function() currentTrack:Stop(0.2) end)
			currentTrack = nil
			return true
		end
		return false
	end

	-- Plays a catalog emote by asset ID (R15). Runs on our own Animator, so it replicates.
	local function playCatalogEmote(assetId, label)
		local hum = getHumanoid()
		if not hum then notify("No living character found."); return end

		stopAnimation()

		local ok, played, emoteTrack = pcall(function()
			return hum:PlayEmoteAndGetAnimTrackById(assetId)
		end)
		if ok and played and emoteTrack then
			currentTrack = emoteTrack
			notify("Playing: " .. label)
			emoteTrack.Stopped:Connect(function()
				if currentTrack == emoteTrack then currentTrack = nil end
			end)
		else
			notify(label .. " could not be played (R15 only, may need ownership).")
		end
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Animation packs: write IDs into the character's Animate script
	----------------------------------------------------------------------------
	local ANIMATE_TARGETS = {
		IdleAnimation  = { { "idle", "Animation1" }, { "idle", "Animation2" } },
		WalkAnimation  = { { "walk", "WalkAnim" } },
		RunAnimation   = { { "run", "RunAnim" } },
		JumpAnimation  = { { "jump", "JumpAnim" } },
		FallAnimation  = { { "fall", "FallAnim" } },
		ClimbAnimation = { { "climb", "ClimbAnim" } },
		SwimAnimation  = { { "swim", "Swim" } },
	}

	local function getAnimate()
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		return char and char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
	end

	-- Restart the Animate script so it immediately picks up the new IDs
	local function restartAnimate(animate)
		pcall(function()
			animate.Disabled = true
			local hum = getHumanoid()
			local animator = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
			if animator then
				for _, t in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do t:Stop(0) end
			end
			task.wait()
			animate.Disabled = false
		end)
	end

	local function applyPackToAnimate(mapped)
		local animate = getAnimate()
		if not animate then return 0 end

		local count = 0
		for prop, id in pairs(mapped) do
			local targets = ANIMATE_TARGETS[prop]
			if targets and typeof(id) == "number" then
				for _, t in ipairs(targets) do
					local folder = animate:FindFirstChild(t[1])
					local anim = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(t[2])
					if anim and anim:IsA("Animation") then
						if originalIds[anim] == nil then originalIds[anim] = anim.AnimationId end
						anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. id
						count += 1
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if count > 0 then restartAnimate(animate) end
		return count
	end

	local function resetLocalAnimations()
		local animate = getAnimate()
		local restored = 0
		for anim, original in pairs(originalIds) do
			if anim.Parent then
				anim.AnimationId = original
				restored += 1
			end
		end
		originalIds = {}
		selectedPack = nil
		if animate and restored > 0 then restartAnimate(animate) end
		return restored
	end

	-- Server remote
	----------------------------------------------------------------------------
	local remote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild(REMOTE_NAME, 10)
	if not remote then
		warn("[Forge - Anemo] RemoteEvent '" .. REMOTE_NAME .. "' not found.")
	else
		track(remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind, payload)
			if kind == "msg" and typeof(payload) == "string" then
				notify(payload)
			elseif kind == "animMap" and typeof(payload) == "table" then
				selectedPack = payload
				local n = applyPackToAnimate(payload)
				if n > 0 then
					notify("Animation pack applied.")
				else
					notify("Pack sent to server (no Animate script found on your character).")
				end
			end
		end))
	end

	local function sendToServer(action, value)
		if not remote then notify("Server connection missing."); return false end
		if os.clock() - lastActionTime < ACTION_DEBOUNCE then return false end
		lastActionTime = os.clock()
		remote:FireServer(action, value)
		return true
	end

	-- Reusable catalog browser (Catalog + Animations tabs)
	----------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- opts: placeholder, itemType (Enum.AvatarItemType), makeParams(keyword), onSelect(id, label),
	--       extras = { {text=, callback=}, ... }
	local function createBrowser(page, opts)
		local search = makeTextBox(page, opts.placeholder, UDim2.new(1, -96, 0, 30))
		local go     = makeButton(page, "Search", UDim2.new(0, 88, 0, 30), UDim2.new(1, -88, 0, 0))

		local n = #opts.extras
		for i, extra in ipairs(opts.extras) do
			local b = makeButton(page, extra.text,
				UDim2.new(1 / n, -6 * (n - 1) / n, 0, 30),
				UDim2.new((i - 1) / n, 6 * (i - 1) / n, 0, 36))
			track(b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(extra.callback))
		end

		local list = makeScroller(page, UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -72), UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 72))
		new("UIGridLayout", {
			CellSize = UDim2.new(0.5, -4, 0, 34), CellPadding = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 6),
			SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
		}, list)

		local loadMore = makeButton(list, "Load more...", UDim2.new())
		loadMore.LayoutOrder = 1000000
		loadMore.Visible = false

		local pagesObj, busy, order = nil, false, 0

		local function clearItems()
			for _, child in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("TextButton") and child ~= loadMore then child:Destroy() end
			end
			order = 0
		end

		local function addItems(items)
			local ids = {}
			for _, item in ipairs(items) do
				if item.Id then table.insert(ids, item.Id) end
			end
			if #ids == 0 then return end

			local names = {}
			local ok, details = pcall(function()
				return AvatarEditorService:GetBatchItemDetails(ids, opts.itemType)
			end)
			if ok and typeof(details) == "table" then
				for _, d in ipairs(details) do names[d.Id] = d.Name end
			end

			for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
				local label = names[id] or ("Item " .. id)
				local btn = makeButton(list, label, UDim2.new())
				order += 1
				btn.LayoutOrder = order
				track(btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() opts.onSelect(id, label) end))
			end
		end

		local function refreshLoadMore()
			loadMore.Visible = pagesObj ~= nil and not pagesObj.IsFinished
		end

		local function runSearch()
			if busy then return end
			busy = true
			notify("Searching...")

			local ok, result = pcall(function()
				return AvatarEditorService:SearchCatalog(opts.makeParams(search.Text))
			end)
			if not ok or not result then
				notify("Catalog search failed. Try again shortly.")
				busy = false
				return
			end

			pagesObj = result
			clearItems()

			local okPage, pageItems = pcall(function() return result:GetCurrentPage() end)
			if okPage and typeof(pageItems) == "table" and #pageItems > 0 then
				addItems(pageItems)
				notify("Found " .. #pageItems .. " results.")
			else
				notify("No results.")
			end
			refreshLoadMore()
			busy = false
		end

		track(go.MouseButton1Click:Connect(runSearch))
		track(search.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
			if enterPressed then runSearch() end
		end))
		track(loadMore.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if busy or not pagesObj or pagesObj.IsFinished then return end
			busy = true
			local ok = pcall(function() pagesObj:AdvanceToNextPageAsync() end)
			if ok then
				local okPage, pageItems = pcall(function() return pagesObj:GetCurrentPage() end)
				if okPage and typeof(pageItems) == "table" then addItems(pageItems) end
			else
				notify("Could not load more.")
			end
			refreshLoadMore()
			busy = false
		end))

		return runSearch
	end

	----------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Character lifecycle (respawns)
	----------------------------------------------------------------------------
	local runningConn

	local function onCharacterAdded(char)
		currentTrack = nil
		originalIds = {}  -- new character = new Animate script instances
		if runningConn then runningConn:Disconnect(); runningConn = nil end

		local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
		if not hum then return end

		-- Cancel the current emote when the player starts moving
		runningConn = hum.Running:Connect(function(speed)
			if speed > 0.5 and currentTrack then stopAnimation() end
		end)

		-- Re-apply the chosen animation pack once the Animate script has loaded
		if selectedPack then
			local animate = char:WaitForChild("Animate", 10)
			if animate then
				animate:WaitForChild("idle", 5)
				task.wait(0.5)
				if LocalPlayer.Character == char and selectedPack then
					applyPackToAnimate(selectedPack)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	track(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded))
	if LocalPlayer.Character then task.spawn(onCharacterAdded, LocalPlayer.Character) end

	-- Window dragging (mouse + touch)
	----------------------------------------------------------------------------

		local dragging, dragStart, startPos

		track(topbar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
				or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				dragging, dragStart, startPos = true, input.Position, main.Position
				local c; c = input.Changed:Connect(function()
					if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
						dragging = false
						c:Disconnect()
					end
				end)
			end
		end))

		track(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
				or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
				local d = input.Position - dragStart
				main.Position = UDim2.new(
					startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X,
					startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
			end
		end))
	end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- ██ ULTIMATE G-FORCE DASH
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

-- ═══════════════════ settings ═══════════════════
local DASH_SPEED = 60           
local FAST_FALL_SPEED = -40     
local SKYDIVE_GRAVITY = 60      
local NORMAL_GRAVITY = 196.2    

local SLIDE_ANIM_ID = "rbxassetid://282574440" 
local SOUND_LAUNCH = "rbxassetid://4827310202" 
local SOUND_WIND = "rbxassetid://3744362814" 
local SOUND_LAND = "rbxassetid://9120386436"   
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════

local isBusy = false -- 🔒 Единый замок (блокирует кнопку до приземления)
local slideAnimTrack = nil
local activeConnections = {}

local function clearConnections()
    for _, conn in pairs(activeConnections) do
        if conn and conn.Connected then conn:Disconnect() end
    end
    activeConnections = {}
end

-- 🧹 Очистка старых UI
for _, v in ipairs(playerGui:GetChildren()) do
    if v.Name == "SlideUI" then v:Destroy() end
end

-- ─────────────── 1. UI ───────────────
local ui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ui.Name = "SlideUI"
ui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ui.DisplayOrder = 999
ui.Parent = playerGui

local glowFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
glowFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 90)
glowFrame.Position = UDim2.new(1, -200, 1, -300)
glowFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 200)
glowFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
glowFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
glowFrame.Parent = ui
Instance.new("UICorner", glowFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

local btnFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
btnFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 75, 0, 75)
btnFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 7.5, 0, 7.5)
btnFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20)
btnFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
btnFrame.Parent = glowFrame
Instance.new("UICorner", btnFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

local btnGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", btnFrame)
btnGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(40, 45, 60)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(5, 5, 10))
})

local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", btnFrame)
stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 200)
stroke.Thickness = 2.5
stroke.Transparency = 0.1

local icon = Instance.new("TextLabel")
icon.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
icon.Text = "skydive"
icon.TextSize = 45
icon.ZIndex = 2
icon.Parent = btnFrame

local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
btn.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
btn.Text = ""
btn.ZIndex = 3
btn.Parent = btnFrame

-- Текст "in the air"
local airText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
airText.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
airText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 5)
airText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
airText.Text = "WAIT YOURE ARLEADY SKYDIVING"
airText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
airText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
airText.TextSize = 14
airText.Visible = false
airText.Parent = glowFrame

-- ─────────────── 2. АНИМАЦИЯ ───────────────
local function setupAnimation(character)
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
    if not humanoid then return end
    
    local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", humanoid)
    local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
    anim.AnimationId = SLIDE_ANIM_ID
    
    local success, track = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(anim) end)
    if success and track then
        slideAnimTrack = track
        slideAnimTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
        slideAnimTrack.Looped = true
    end
end

if player.Character then setupAnimation(player.Character) end
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    setupAnimation(player.Character)
    Workspace.Gravity = NORMAL_GRAVITY
    isBusy = false
    clearConnections()
    btnFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20)
    airText.Visible = false
end)

-- ─────────────── 3. ЭФФЕКТ ПРИЗЕМЛЕНИЯ ───────────────
local function playImpactEffect(position)
    local landSnd = Instance.new("Sound", camera)
    landSnd.SoundId = SOUND_LAND
    landSnd.Volume = 1
    landSnd.PlaybackSpeed = 0.8
    landSnd:Play()
    Debris:AddItem(landSnd, 2)

    local wave = Instance.new("Part", Workspace)
    wave.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
    wave.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    wave.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 200)
    wave.Anchored = true
    wave.CanCollide = false
    wave.CFrame = CFrame.new(position) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
    wave.Size = Vector3.new(1, 5, 5)
    
    TweenService:Create(wave, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Exponential, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        Size = Vector3.new(1, 50, 50), Transparency = 1
    }):Play()
    Debris:AddItem(wave, 0.5)

    local dust = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter", wave)
    dust.Texture = "rbxassetid://243660364"
    dust.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 200))
    dust.Size = NumberSequence.new(3, 0)
    dust.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1)
    dust.Speed = NumberRange.new(20, 40)
    dust.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.8)
    dust:Emit(40)

    local shakeTime = 0
    local shakeConn
    shakeConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        shakeTime += dt
        if shakeTime < 0.4 then
            camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(math.random(-15, 15)/100, math.random(-15, 15)/100, 0)
        else
            shakeConn:Disconnect()
        end
    end)
end

-- ─────────────── 4. ЛОГИКА ───────────────
local function doAction()
    -- 🔒 Если мы уже в воздухе или на кулдауне — ничего не делаем
    if isBusy then return end
    
    local char = player.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end

    isBusy = true
    clearConnections()
    
    -- 🌍 Гравитация и прыжок
    Workspace.Gravity = SKYDIVE_GRAVITY
    hum.Jump = true
    hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
    
    -- 🎨 UI (Блокируем кнопку)
    TweenService:Create(btnFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 60), Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 15)}):Play()
    task.delay(0.1, function()
        TweenService:Create(btnFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 75, 0, 75), Position = UDim2.new(0, 7.5, 0, 7.5)}):Play()
    end)
    btnFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 25, 10) -- Темнеет
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 0) -- Оранжевый
    airText.Visible = true
    
    -- 🎬 Анимация
    if slideAnimTrack then slideAnimTrack:Play(0.3) end
    
    -- 🔊 Звуки
    local launchSnd = Instance.new("Sound", hrp)
    launchSnd.SoundId = SOUND_LAUNCH
    launchSnd.Volume = 1
    launchSnd:Play()
    Debris:AddItem(launchSnd, 2)

    local windSnd = Instance.new("Sound", hrp)
    windSnd.SoundId = SOUND_WIND
    windSnd.Volume = 0.5
    windSnd.Looped = true
    windSnd:Play()
    
    TweenService:Create(camera, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {FieldOfView = 110}):Play()

    -- ✨ Эффекты
    local att0 = Instance.new("Attachment", hrp); att0.Position = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
    local att1 = Instance.new("Attachment", hrp); att1.Position = Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)
    local trail = Instance.new("Trail", hrp)
    trail.Attachment0 = att0; trail.Attachment1 = att1
    trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 200))
    trail.Lifetime = 0.4

    local thruster = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter", hrp)
    thruster.Texture = "rbxassetid://243660364"
    thruster.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 200))
    thruster.Size = NumberSequence.new(2, 0)
    thruster.Speed = NumberRange.new(10, 20)
    thruster.Rate = 100
    
    local moveDir = hum.MoveDirection
    if moveDir.Magnitude < 0.1 then
        local camLook = camera.CFrame.LookVector
        moveDir = Vector3.new(camLook.X, 0, camLook.Z).Unit
    end
    
    local hasStopped = false
    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {char}
    
    -- 🛑 ОСТАНОВКА (При касании пола)
    local function stopSkydive()
        if hasStopped then return end
        hasStopped = true
        isBusy = false -- 🔓 РАЗБЛОКИРОВЫВАЕМ КНОПКУ
        
        clearConnections()
        Workspace.Gravity = NORMAL_GRAVITY
        
        -- 🎨 Возврат UI
        TweenService:Create(camera, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {FieldOfView = 70}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(btnFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20)}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 200)}):Play()
        airText.Visible = false
        
        -- Очистка
        if trail then trail:Destroy() end
        if att0 then att0:Destroy() end
        if att1 then att1:Destroy() end
        if thruster then thruster:Destroy() end
        if windSnd then windSnd:Destroy() end
        if slideAnimTrack then slideAnimTrack:Stop(0.3) end
        
        -- Торможение
        local stopVel = Vector3.new(0, hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0)
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity:Lerp(stopVel, 0.5)
        
        playImpactEffect(hrp.Position)
    end

    -- Слушаем изменение состояния (Landed / Running)
    table.insert(activeConnections, hum.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, newState)
        if newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed or newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running then
            task.wait(0.15) -- Даем время на прыжок, чтобы не отменить сразу
            if not hasStopped then stopSkydive() end
        end
    end))

    -- Отслеживаем смерть
    table.insert(activeConnections, hum.Died:Connect(function()
        stopSkydive()
    end))
    
    -- 🚀 Цикл физики и Рейкастов
    local flightConn
    flightConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if not hrp or hum.Health <= 0 or hasStopped then return end
        
        local currentVel = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        local result = Workspace:Raycast(hrp.Position, Vector3.new(0, -6, 0), raycastParams)
        
        -- Если мы летим вниз и впереди пол — стоп!
        if result and currentVel.Y <= 0 then 
            stopSkydive() 
            return 
        end
        
        local targetVel = Vector3.new(moveDir.X * DASH_SPEED, FAST_FALL_SPEED, moveDir.Z * DASH_SPEED)
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = currentVel:Lerp(targetVel, 1 - math.exp(-15 * dt))
    end)
    table.insert(activeConnections, flightConn)
end

-- ─────────────── 5. ПРИВЯЗКА ───────────────
btn.Activated:Connect(doAction)
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
    if gp then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.C then doAction() end
end)
