-- Twisted - probe autofarm
-- place 14170731342 / gameId 2251388500
--
-- One job: wait for a storm, park on its path, drop tower probes in pairs,
-- hold through the pass, cash out when the readings stop, restock.
--
-- RightShift hides the readout. X unloads the script.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

local LP = Players.LocalPlayer

-- playable map bound; storms past this are off the map and not worth chasing
local MAP_LIMIT = 30000
local EDGE_PAD = 350          -- stay this far inside the real map edge

local MAP = { minX = -MAP_LIMIT, maxX = MAP_LIMIT, minZ = -MAP_LIMIT, maxZ = MAP_LIMIT }
do
    local mr = workspace:FindFirstChild("map_related")
    local land = mr and mr:FindFirstChild("landscape")
    local ok, cf, size = pcall(function()
        return land:GetBoundingBox()
    end)
    if ok and cf and size and size.X > 1000 and size.Z > 1000 then
        MAP.minX, MAP.maxX = cf.Position.X - size.X / 2, cf.Position.X + size.X / 2
        MAP.minZ, MAP.maxZ = cf.Position.Z - size.Z / 2, cf.Position.Z + size.Z / 2
    end
end

local function inBounds(x, z, pad)
    local p = pad or 0
    return x >= MAP.minX + p and x <= MAP.maxX - p
        and z >= MAP.minZ + p and z <= MAP.maxZ - p
end

print(string.format("[MAP] safe X %.0f..%.0f  Z %.0f..%.0f",
    MAP.minX + EDGE_PAD, MAP.maxX - EDGE_PAD, MAP.minZ + EDGE_PAD, MAP.maxZ - EDGE_PAD))

if getgenv().TW_FARM then
    pcall(function()
        getgenv().TW_FARM.alive = false
        for _, c in ipairs(getgenv().TW_FARM.conns or {}) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        if getgenv().TW_FARM.gui then getgenv().TW_FARM.gui:Destroy() end
    end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- theme
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local C = {
    -- Solana hub palette
    bg      = Color3.fromRGB(13, 11, 20),
    surface = Color3.fromRGB(18, 16, 27),
    raised  = Color3.fromRGB(31, 27, 48),
    line    = Color3.fromRGB(42, 38, 64),
    text    = Color3.fromRGB(232, 230, 242),
    dim     = Color3.fromRGB(124, 119, 146),
    faint   = Color3.fromRGB(78, 73, 102),
    accent  = Color3.fromRGB(153, 69, 255),
    accent2 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 241, 149),
    good    = Color3.fromRGB(20, 241, 149),
    warn    = Color3.fromRGB(232, 196, 104),
    bad     = Color3.fromRGB(255, 92, 122),
}

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- anti-cheat: client-side CheatHandler, three hooks
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function stripAC()
    local killed = 0
    local ch = LP.Character
    local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local pg = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    local function sweep(sig)
        if not sig then return end
        for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(sig)) do
            local ok, src = pcall(function() return debug.info(c.Function, "s") end)
            if ok and tostring(src):find("CheatHandler", 1, true) then
                pcall(function() c:Disable() end)
                pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
                killed = killed + 1
            end
        end
    end
    sweep(hum and hum.Changed)
    sweep(ch and ch.DescendantAdded)
    sweep(pg and pg.ChildAdded)
    return killed
end

local ENV = {
    alive = true,
    gui = nil,
    conns = {},
    running = true,
    busy = false,
    state = "starting",
    runs = 0,
    placed = 0,
    load = 0,
    lead = 0,
    clear = 0,
    eta = 0,
    killzone = 0,
    hp = 0,
    hourly = 0,
    speed = 0,
    collectTime = 0,
    grace = 4,
    dist = 0,
    winds = 0,
    lateral = 0,
    closest = 0,
    moneyStart = 0,
    esp = true,
    probeEsp = true,
    fullbright = true,
    antiafk = true,
    holdStill = false,
    parkPos = nil,
    lastClear = 0,
    justDied = false,
    vehLogged = false,
    dead = false,
    deathSerial = 0,
    deathAt = 0,
    cooldownUntil = 0,
    leadBump = 0,
    scoutFails = 0,
    stormLock = nil,
    stormSkip = {},
    probeTag = nil,
}

stripAC()
for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
    if (d.Name == "TW_STORM" or d.Name == "TW_PROBE") and d:IsA("BillboardGui") then
        pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
    end
end
getgenv().TW_FARM = ENV

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- helpers
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function character()
    local ch = LP.Character
    if not ch or not ch.Parent then return nil end
    return ch
end

local function root()
    local ch = character()
    return ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or nil
end

local function humanoid()
    local ch = character()
    return ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or nil
end

local function new(class, props, parent)
    local o = Instance.new(class)
    for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
    o.Parent = parent
    return o
end

local function corner(obj, r)
    return new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 6) }, obj)
end

local function moneyNow()
    local ps = LP:FindFirstChild("player_stats")
    local m = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("money")
    return m and m.Value or 0
end

-- a run belongs to the character that started it; a death invalidates it
local function aliveSince(serial)
    local hum = humanoid()
    return not ENV.dead and ENV.deathSerial == serial and hum ~= nil and hum.Health > 0
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- probes
------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- tower probe only: it pays the most per intercept, so nothing cheaper gets
-- bought. if the wallet cannot cover one, the cycle waits.
local CHEAPEST = 1250
local WANT = 4                -- stock minimum for a fresh run
local PLACE_MAX = 4           -- one rack = four tower probes
local PLACE_PER_PROBE = 1.3   -- measured: attach + activate + confirm
local FLAT_SAMPLES = 4        -- ticks (~1.6 s) of unchanged readings = done
local GRACE_SECONDS = 2       -- extra seconds after completion, before collection

-- the game names cars and probes after the owner's UserId, so target our id
-- directly; a nearest-Scout scan picked up other players' cars in busy servers
local function ourCarId()
    local pr = workspace:FindFirstChild("player_related")
    local cars = pr and pr:FindFirstChild("cars")
    local uid = tostring(LP.UserId)
    local mine = cars and cars:FindFirstChild(uid)
    if not mine then return nil end
    local info = mine:FindFirstChild("info")
    if info then
        local ok, data = pcall(require, info)
        if ok and type(data) == "table" and data.Vehicle and data.Vehicle.Model == "Scout" then
            return uid
        end
        return nil
    end
    return uid
end

local function deployedProbes()
    local pr = workspace:FindFirstChild("player_related")
    local pf = pr and pr:FindFirstChild("probes")
    if not pf then return {} end
    local out = {}
    local id = tostring(LP.UserId)
    for _, m in ipairs(pf:GetChildren()) do
        if m.Name == id then out[#out + 1] = m end
    end
    return out
end

-- nearest freshly placed probe at our feet only counts if it is ours
local function resolveProbeTag()
    local pr = workspace:FindFirstChild("player_related")
    local pf = pr and pr:FindFirstChild("probes")
    local hrp = root()
    if not (pf and hrp) then return nil end
    local id = tostring(LP.UserId)
    local best, bd = nil, math.huge
    for _, m in ipairs(pf:GetChildren()) do
        if m.Name == id then
            local part = m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
            if part then
                local d = (part.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                if d < bd then best, bd = m.Name, d end
            end
        end
    end
    if best then ENV.probeTag = best end
    return best
end

local function probeTools()
    local n = 0
    local ch = character()
    for _, src in ipairs({ LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"), ch }) do
        if src then
            for _, t in ipairs(src:GetChildren()) do
                if t:IsA("Tool") and (t.Name:find("Probe") or t.Name:find("Pod")) then n = n + 1 end
            end
        end
    end
    return n
end

local function bestProbeTool()
    local bp = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    local ch = character()
    for _, src in ipairs({ bp, ch }) do
        if src then
            local t = src:FindFirstChild("Twistex Tower Probe")
            if t and t:IsA("Tool") then return t end
        end
    end
    for _, src in ipairs({ bp, ch }) do
        if src then
            for _, t in ipairs(src:GetChildren()) do
                if t:IsA("Tool") and (t.Name:find("Probe") or t.Name:find("Pod")) then return t end
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- the Scout is the car that carries the probe rack; the info module names it
local function scoutSpawned()
    return ourCarId() ~= nil
end

local function restock()
    local had = probeTools()
    if moneyNow() >= CHEAPEST then
        local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("remotes")
        local rf = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("buy_probes")
        if rf then
            for _, name in ipairs({ "91TERRITORY-SCOUT", "Scout" }) do
                pcall(function()
                    rf:InvokeServer({ vehicle = name, probe = "Twistex Tower Probe" })
                end)
                task.wait(0.3)
                if probeTools() > had then return true end
            end
        end
    end

    -- idempotent: do not stack duplicate vehicles. if a Scout already exists,
    -- respawning it is how the rack is refreshed; if it does not, spawn one.
    local events = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("events")
    local ev = events and events:FindFirstChild("spawn_vehicle")
    if ev and not scoutSpawned() then
        pcall(function() ev:FireServer("91TERRITORY-SCOUT") end)
        for _ = 1, 10 do
            task.wait(0.5)
            if probeTools() > had then return true end
        end
    end
    return false
end


local function spawnScout()
    if scoutSpawned() then return true end
    local events = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("events")
    local ev = events and events:FindFirstChild("spawn_vehicle")
    if not ev then return false end
    pcall(function() ev:FireServer("91TERRITORY-SCOUT") end)
    for _ = 1, 12 do
        task.wait(0.5)
        if scoutSpawned() then return true end
    end
    return scoutSpawned()
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- storms
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function tornadoPart(storm)
    local rot = storm and storm:FindFirstChild("rotation")
    return rot and (rot:FindFirstChild("TornadoPart") or rot:FindFirstChild("tornado_scan")) or nil
end

-- the funnel carries its own wind number; configs.winds is the storm's and
-- reads 20-40 lower. the payout follows the funnel, so read that one.
local function stormWinds(storm)
    local cfg = storm and storm:FindFirstChild("configs")
    if not cfg then return 0 end
    local tor = cfg:FindFirstChild("tornado")
    local tw = tor and tor:FindFirstChild("winds")
    local w = tw and tonumber(tw.Value)
    if w and w > 0 then return w end
    local sw = cfg:FindFirstChild("winds")
    return sw and tonumber(sw.Value) or 0
end

-- a storm is only usable while its funnel is alive and inside the map bound
local function stormValid(storm)
    if not storm or not storm.Parent then return false end
    local tp = tornadoPart(storm)
    if not tp then return false end
    return inBounds(tp.Position.X, tp.Position.Z, 0)
end

-- a storm cancelled at the boundary stays ignored for a minute, so the next
-- one on the list gets picked instead of the same bad target
local function stormUsable(storm)
    if not stormValid(storm) then return false end
    local untilT = ENV.stormSkip[storm]
    if untilT then
        if os.clock() < untilT then return false end
        ENV.stormSkip[storm] = nil
    end
    return true
end

local function pickStorm()
    local sr = workspace:FindFirstChild("storm_related")
    local st = sr and sr:FindFirstChild("storms")
    if not st then return nil end
    local best, bw = nil, -1
    for _, m in ipairs(st:GetChildren()) do
        if stormUsable(m) then
            local w = stormWinds(m)
            if w > bw then best, bw = m, w end
        end
    end
    return best
end

-- the storm the farm is actually working. the readout and the ESP both follow
-- this instead of re-picking, so the tag on screen is the funnel being farmed.
local function activeStorm()
    if stormUsable(ENV.stormLock) then return ENV.stormLock end
    return pickStorm()
end

-- least-squares fit over every sample: the endpoint delta drags the bearing off
-- whenever the core curves or wobbles
local function trackPath(storm, samples, interval)
    local tp = tornadoPart(storm)
    if not tp then return nil end
    local pts = {}
    for i = 1, samples do
        pts[#pts + 1] = { pos = tp.Position, t = os.clock() }
        if i < samples then task.wait(interval) end
    end
    local n = #pts
    if n < 2 then return nil end
    local t0 = pts[1].t
    local sx, sz, st, stt, stx, stz = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
    for _, p in ipairs(pts) do
        local dt = p.t - t0
        sx = sx + p.pos.X
        sz = sz + p.pos.Z
        st = st + dt
        stt = stt + dt * dt
        stx = stx + dt * p.pos.X
        stz = stz + dt * p.pos.Z
    end
    local denom = n * stt - st * st
    if math.abs(denom) < 1e-6 then
        return { pos = pts[n].pos, dir = nil, speed = 0 }
    end
    local vx = (n * stx - st * sx) / denom
    local vz = (n * stz - st * sz) / denom
    local flat = Vector3.new(vx, 0, vz)
    if flat.Magnitude < 0.5 then
        return { pos = pts[n].pos, dir = nil, speed = 0 }
    end
    return { pos = pts[n].pos, dir = flat.Unit, speed = flat.Magnitude }
end

local function fitBearing(tp, count, gap)
    local pts = {}
    local t0 = os.clock()
    for i = 1, count do
        pts[#pts + 1] = { p = tp.Position, t = os.clock() - t0 }
        if i < count then task.wait(gap) end
    end
    local n = #pts
    if n < 2 then return nil, pts[n] and pts[n].p end
    local sx, sz, st, stt, stx, stz = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
    for _, q in ipairs(pts) do
        local dt = q.t
        sx = sx + q.p.X
        sz = sz + q.p.Z
        st = st + dt
        stt = stt + dt * dt
        stx = stx + dt * q.p.X
        stz = stz + dt * q.p.Z
    end
    local denom = n * stt - st * st
    if math.abs(denom) < 1e-6 then return nil, pts[n].p end
    local vx = (n * stx - st * sx) / denom
    local vz = (n * stz - st * sz) / denom
    local v = Vector3.new(vx, 0, vz)
    if v.Magnitude < 0.5 then return nil, pts[n].p end
    return v.Unit, pts[n].p, v.Magnitude
end

-- forward declaration: lineUp centers on dry ground, but drySpot is defined
-- below with the rest of the ground helpers
local drySpot

-- slide onto the core's line: fit a wider window, cancel the lateral error,
-- then verify with a short second fit. two passes only - every extra pass
-- spends seconds the core is already moving.
local function lineUp(storm, passes)
    local tp = tornadoPart(storm)
    local hrp = root()
    if not (tp and hrp) then return end
    for pass = 1, passes or 2 do
        local dir, last
        -- a slow or wobbly core can fit as nil; retry the bearing twice before
        -- giving up on this pass instead of deploying on a bad line
        for attempt = 1, 3 do
            dir, last = fitBearing(tp, pass == 1 and 4 or 3, pass == 1 and 0.32 or 0.26)
            if dir and last then break end
            if attempt < 3 then
                ENV.state = "line-up nil - retrying bearing"
                print(string.format("[LINEUP] bearing nil - retry %d/2", attempt))
                task.wait(0.3)
            end
        end
        if dir and last and hrp.Parent then
            local rel = Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X - last.X, 0, hrp.Position.Z - last.Z)
            local lateral = rel - dir * rel:Dot(dir)
            ENV.lateral = lateral.Magnitude
            if lateral.Magnitude > 3 then
                local fixed = Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X, 0, hrp.Position.Z) - lateral
                -- only slide if the centerline spot is dry; never trade a dry
                -- rack for a wet one just to cancel a small lateral error
                local gx, gz, gy = drySpot(fixed.X, fixed.Z)
                if gx and inBounds(gx, gz, EDGE_PAD) then
                    hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(gx, gy + 4, gz)
                end
            end
        end
        task.wait(0.08)
    end
    ENV.parkPos = hrp.CFrame
end


-- the funnel's width configuration carries the real size: base is the full
-- width in studs, sfc the surface width. big cores need a wider berth.
local function tornadoWidth(storm)
    local cfg = storm and storm:FindFirstChild("configs")
    local tor = cfg and cfg:FindFirstChild("tornado")
    local w = tor and tor:FindFirstChild("width")
    if not w then return 400 end
    local base = tonumber(w:GetAttribute("base"))
    local sfc = tonumber(w:GetAttribute("sfc"))
    local size = math.max(base or 0, (sfc or 0) * 2)
    if size <= 0 then return 400 end
    return size
end

-- Ervoila prints a killzone radius that is much smaller than the visual funnel
-- width. the placement gets refused once the wind field reaches the rack, so
-- the intercept distance has to clear the effect radius, not the model width.
local function tornadoKillzone(storm)
    local cfg = storm and storm:FindFirstChild("configs")
    local tor = cfg and cfg:FindFirstChild("tornado")
    local sources = { tor, cfg, storm }
    for _, src in ipairs(sources) do
        if src then
            for _, name in ipairs({ "killzone", "kill_zone", "damage_zone" }) do
                local v = src:FindFirstChild(name)
                if v and tonumber(v.Value) then return tonumber(v.Value) end
                local a = tonumber(src:GetAttribute(name))
                if a then return a end
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- threat classification from winds and funnel width; margins scale with it
local function threatFrom(winds, width)
    if winds >= 170 or width >= 5000 then return "EXTREME" end
    if winds >= 130 or width >= 2500 then return "DANGEROUS" end
    if winds >= 90 or width >= 1000 then return "ELEVATED" end
    return "NORMAL"
end

local function threatScale(threat)
    if threat == "EXTREME" then return 2.0 end
    if threat == "DANGEROUS" then return 1.6 end
    if threat == "ELEVATED" then return 1.3 end
    return 1.0
end

-- clearance beyond the funnel's own radius; grows with size and intensity
local function safetyMargin(width, threat)
    local add = 0
    if threat == "EXTREME" then add = 900
    elseif threat == "DANGEROUS" then add = 500
    elseif threat == "ELEVATED" then add = 250
    end
    return 300 + add + width * 0.15
end


------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- ground: never park on water or in the void
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

local function hitIsWater(hit)
    if not hit then return true end
    if hit.Material == Enum.Material.Water then return true end
    local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("map_related")
    local wt = map and map:FindFirstChild("water_table")
    if wt and hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(wt) then return true end
    return hit.Instance.Name:lower():find("water") ~= nil
end

local function sampleGround(x, z)
    local ignore = {}
    if LP.Character then table.insert(ignore, LP.Character) end
    for _, n in ipairs({ "storm_related", "player_related" }) do
        local o = workspace:FindFirstChild(n)
        if o then table.insert(ignore, o) end
    end
    rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
    local hit = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(x, 900, z), Vector3.new(0, -2400, 0), rayParams)
    if not hit then return 0, true end
    return hit.Position.Y, hitIsWater(hit)
end

function drySpot(x, z)
    if not inBounds(x, z, EDGE_PAD) then return nil end
    local y, wet = sampleGround(x, z)
    if not wet then return x, z, y end
    for _, r in ipairs({ 60, 120, 200, 320, 480, 700, 1000 }) do
        for a = 0, 7 do
            local th = (a / 8) * math.pi * 2
            local nx, nz = x + math.cos(th) * r, z + math.sin(th) * r
            if inBounds(nx, nz, EDGE_PAD) then
                local ny, nwet = sampleGround(nx, nz)
                if not nwet then return nx, nz, ny end
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function placeAt(x, z)
    local hrp = root()
    if not hrp then return false end
    local dx, dz, dy = drySpot(x, z)
    if not dx or not inBounds(dx, dz, EDGE_PAD) then return false end
    hrp.Anchored = false
    hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(dx, dy + 4, dz))
    ENV.parkPos = hrp.CFrame
    return true
end

-- anchoring only the root still lets the core fling the rest of the rig, so
-- every part gets pinned and its velocity zeroed while we hold
local function anchorRig(on)
    local ch = character()
    if not ch then return end
    for _, p in ipairs(ch:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            if on then
                pcall(function() p.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero end)
                pcall(function() p.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero end)
                pcall(function() p.Anchored = true end)
            else
                pcall(function() p.Anchored = false end)
            end
        end
    end
end

local function holdAt()
    local hrp = root()
    local hum = humanoid()
    if not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
    ENV.parkPos = hrp.CFrame
    hrp.Anchored = true
    pcall(function() hum.PlatformStand = true end)
    pcall(function() hum.WalkSpeed = 0 end)
    -- measured: 100k max health holds for 5s+ with no server correction
    if hum.MaxHealth < 100000 then hum.MaxHealth = 100000 end
    hum.Health = hum.MaxHealth
    anchorRig(true)
    ENV.holdStill = true
end

local function releaseHold()
    ENV.holdStill = false
    local hrp = root()
    local hum = humanoid()
    anchorRig(false)
    if hum then
        pcall(function() hum.PlatformStand = false end)
        pcall(function() hum.WalkSpeed = 16 end)
    end
    if hrp then pcall(function() hrp.Anchored = false end) end
end

-- Ervoila aborts to a safe spot instead of trying to farm from a flung or
-- boundary position. nearest spawn is the reliable fixed point on this map.
local function goSafeZone()
    local hrp = root()
    if not hrp then return end
    local pos = nil
    local ok, loc = pcall(function() return workspace:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpawnLocation", true) end)
    if ok and loc then
        pos = loc.Position + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0)
    elseif inBounds(0, 0, 0) then
        pos = Vector3.new(0, 60, 0)
    end
    if not pos then return end
    pcall(function() hrp.Anchored = false end)
    pcall(function() hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) end)
    ENV.parkPos = nil
    ENV.holdStill = false
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- deploy: two at a time
------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- EquipTool only holds one tool, but parenting a Tool straight to the character
-- attaches it anyway - so several can be held and pressed in the same frame.
-- Measured: 2 down in ~1.8 s, 4 in ~3.6 s.
local function deployChunk(n, serial)
    local ch = character()
    local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not (hum and ch) or not aliveSince(serial) then return 0 end

    local t0 = os.clock()
    pcall(function() hum:UnequipTools() end)
    task.wait(0.1)

    local before = #deployedProbes()
    local tools = {}
    for _ = 1, n do
        if not aliveSince(serial) then break end
        local t = bestProbeTool()
        if not t then break end
        pcall(function() t.Parent = ch end)
        tools[#tools + 1] = t
    end
    if #tools == 0 then return 0 end

    task.wait(0.2)
    for _, t in ipairs(tools) do
        -- death invalidates this deploy; never press another probe after it
        if not aliveSince(serial) then break end
        pcall(function() t:Activate() end)
    end

    local function consumed()
        local c = 0
        for _, t in ipairs(tools) do
            if t.Parent == nil then c = c + 1 end
        end
        return c
    end

    local function placedCount()
        return math.max(#deployedProbes() - before, consumed(), 0)
    end

    local want = #tools
    local deadline = os.clock() + 3.5
    while os.clock() < deadline do
        if not aliveSince(serial) then break end
        if placedCount() >= want then break end
        task.wait(0.2)
    end

    if placedCount() < want and aliveSince(serial) then
        for _, t in ipairs(tools) do
            if t.Parent == ch then
                if not aliveSince(serial) then break end
                pcall(function() t:Activate() end)
                task.wait(0.4)
            end
        end
    end

    pcall(function() hum:UnequipTools() end)
    ENV.lastDeploy = os.clock() - t0
    return placedCount()
end

-- Ervoila logs a missed batch as "server lag" and re-queues it. cap the number
-- of attempts so a stubborn batch cannot over-place past the observed ceiling.
local function deployProbes(n, serial)
    local placed, attempts = 0, 0
    while placed < n and attempts < 3 do
        if not aliveSince(serial) then break end
        attempts = attempts + 1
        local got = deployChunk(math.min(2, n - placed), serial)
        placed = placed + got
        if got == 0 then
            ENV.state = "missed placement (server lag), retrying"
            print("[PLACEMENT] missed placement (server lag), retrying")
            task.wait(0.9)
        end
        task.wait(0.1)
    end
    return placed
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- collect: sweep, then mop up
------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the part a probe hangs its label and its prompt off: probePart when the game
-- names it that, else the prompt part, else any BasePart it owns
local function probeAnchor(probe)
    local a = probe:FindFirstChild("probePart")
    if a and a:IsA("BasePart") then return a end
    local b = probe:FindFirstChild("PromptPart")
    if b and b:IsA("BasePart") then return b end
    return probe:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
end

-- Probe pickup: one teleport to the cluster, then every prompt fires in the
-- same frame. Walking probe to probe was the slow part after a storm.
local function collectProbes(serial)
    if ENV.dead then return 0 end
    if serial and not aliveSince(serial) then return 0 end
    local before = #deployedProbes()
    if before == 0 then
        ENV.lastCollectLeft = 0
        return 0
    end

    -- needs a character to stand next to the probe; called from a death
    -- recovery it returns cleanly and the probes are collected next cycle
    local hrp = root()
    local hum = humanoid()
    if not hrp then
        ENV.lastCollectLeft = #deployedProbes()
        return before - #deployedProbes()
    end
    local t0 = os.clock()
    local VIM = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")

    local function promptOf(probe)
        return probe:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
    end

    local function arm(probe)
        local prompt = promptOf(probe)
        if prompt then
            pcall(function()
                prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
                prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 100000
                prompt.HoldDuration = 0
            end)
            pcall(setproximitypromptduration, prompt, 0)
        end
    end

    local function fire(probe)
        local prompt = promptOf(probe)
        if prompt then
            pcall(fireproximityprompt, prompt)
        else
            pcall(function() VIM:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.E, false, game) end)
            task.wait(0.1)
            pcall(function() VIM:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.E, false, game) end)
        end
    end

    if hum then pcall(function() hum:UnequipTools() end) end

    -- stand at the cluster once. every probe sits within a few studs of the
    -- park point, so one position satisfies the server's distance check for
    -- all of them - walking to each one was the slow part.
    local first = probeAnchor(deployedProbes()[1])
    if first then
        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(first.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
        task.wait(0.15)
    end

    -- burst pickup: arm and fire every prompt in the same frame, then only
    -- re-fire models that are still standing
    for _ = 1, 5 do
        if ENV.dead then break end
        local list = deployedProbes()
        if #list == 0 then break end

        for _, probe in ipairs(list) do arm(probe) end
        for _, probe in ipairs(list) do
            if probe.Parent then fire(probe) end
        end
        task.wait(0.3)
        if #deployedProbes() == 0 then break end
    end

    -- anything left after the burst gets the slow walk-up treatment
    for _ = 1, 3 do
        local left = deployedProbes()
        if #left == 0 then break end
        for _, probe in ipairs(left) do
            local part = probeAnchor(probe)
            if part and not ENV.dead then
                hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(part.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                task.wait(0.25)
                arm(probe)
                fire(probe)
                task.wait(0.25)
            end
        end
        task.wait(0.3)
    end

    local remaining = #deployedProbes()
    ENV.lastCollectLeft = remaining
    ENV.lastCollectTime = os.clock() - t0
    if remaining == 0 then ENV.probeTag = nil end   -- rack empty, next run re-tags
    local got = math.max(before - remaining, 0)
    print(string.format("[PICKUP] %d back in %.1fs (left %d, held %d)",
        got, ENV.lastCollectTime, remaining, probeTools()))
    return got
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- one cycle
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function cycle()
    local serial = ENV.deathSerial
    if not aliveSince(serial) then
        ENV.state = "not alive - waiting for respawn"
        return
    end
    if os.clock() < (ENV.cooldownUntil or 0) then
        ENV.state = string.format("cooldown %.1fs after death", ENV.cooldownUntil - os.clock())
        return
    end

    -- car first: it is what the probe rack hangs off, so it goes down before
    -- any intercept work
    ENV.state = "checking the Scout"
    if scoutSpawned() then
        if not ENV.vehLogged then
            ENV.vehLogged = true
            print("[VEHICLE] existing usable vehicle found; skipping spawn")
        end
    end
    if not scoutSpawned() and (ENV.scoutFails or 0) < 6 then
        ENV.state = "spawning the Scout"
        if not spawnScout() then
            ENV.scoutFails = (ENV.scoutFails or 0) + 1
            ENV.state = "scout spawn failed - respawning elsewhere"
            print("[VEHICLE] Spawn failed; respawning to a valid spot and retrying")
            -- the car can only spawn from certain spots; a death relocates us
            local hum = humanoid()
            if hum then pcall(function() hum.Health = 0 end) end
            return
        end
        ENV.scoutFails = 0
    end

    -- the Scout exists but its rack is empty: respawn it once to refresh the
    -- four tower probes instead of idling on "no probes"
    if scoutSpawned() and probeTools() == 0 and #deployedProbes() == 0 then
        ENV.state = "Scout empty - refreshing its rack"
        local events = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("events")
        local ev = events and events:FindFirstChild("spawn_vehicle")
        if ev then
            pcall(function() ev:FireServer("91TERRITORY-SCOUT") end)
            for _ = 1, 8 do
                task.wait(0.5)
                if probeTools() > 0 then break end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Ervoila always picks up before the next intercept. doing the same here
    -- keeps the world count and the bag count from stacking across runs.
    local downNow = #deployedProbes()
    if downNow > 0 then
        ENV.load = downNow
        ENV.state = string.format("picking up %d probes", downNow)
        local got = collectProbes(serial)
        ENV.runs = ENV.runs + 1
        print(string.format("[PROBES] picked up %d/%d probes (held %d)", got, downNow, probeTools()))
    end

    ENV.state = "scanning for a storm"

    local storm = pickStorm()
    ENV.stormLock = storm
    if not storm then
        ENV.state = "waiting for a storm"
        return
    end

    local winds = stormWinds(storm)
    ENV.winds = winds

    -- stock first, so the lead knows how many probes actually go down
    local guard = 0
    while probeTools() < WANT and guard < 6 do
        guard = guard + 1
        if moneyNow() < CHEAPEST then break end
        if not restock() then break end
        task.wait(0.8)
    end

    -- place every held probe, capped at one rack's worth
    if ENV.probeTag and #deployedProbes() == 0 then ENV.probeTag = nil end
    local have = math.min(probeTools(), PLACE_MAX)
    if have == 0 then
        ENV.state = string.format("no probes, $%d - paused", math.floor(moneyNow()))
        return
    end
    ENV.load = have

    ENV.state = "tracking the core"
    local tr = trackPath(storm, 9, 0.35)
    if not tr then
        ENV.state = "lost the tornado"
        return
    end

    -- ---------- tornado analysis + projected path ----------
    local speed = math.max(tr.speed or 0, 1)
    local width = tornadoWidth(storm)
    local killzone = tornadoKillzone(storm) or (width / 2)
    local threat = threatFrom(winds, width)
    local margin = safetyMargin(width, threat)
    local corridor = width / 2 + margin        -- danger corridor half-width

    -- park just outside the effect radius: radius + the ground the core covers
    -- while we track, line up and place the batch, plus a fixed berth. Ervoila's
    -- captures sit at roughly radius+350 on slow storms, not a big multiple.
    local radius = math.max(killzone, width / 2, 300)
    -- keep the rack as close to the core as safely possible: only the time
    -- actually needed to line up and press the batch, not a large fixed pad
    local placeSecs = have * PLACE_PER_PROBE + 5   -- teleport + line-up + deploy
    local clearance = 120 + speed * placeSecs
    local leadDist = radius + clearance
    local bumpSec = math.min(ENV.leadBump or 0, 600) / speed
    local lead = math.clamp(clearance / speed + 2 + bumpSec, 10, 320)
    ENV.killzone = killzone
    local clearDist = math.clamp(350 + speed * 8 + winds * 4 + corridor, 700, 9000)
    ENV.lead, ENV.clear = lead, clearDist
    ENV.threat = threat
    ENV.corridor = corridor

    print(string.format("[SAFETY] Tornado threat: %s (winds %.0f, width %.0f)", threat, winds, width))
    print(string.format("[PATH] speed %.0f studs/s, killzone %.0f, corridor %.0f, lead %.0fs (%.0f studs)",
        speed, killzone, corridor, lead, leadDist))
    print(string.format("[INTERCEPT] killzone %.0f | dist %.0f | est wait %.0fs", radius, leadDist, lead))

    local base = tr.pos
    local dirv = tr.dir or Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
    local side = Vector3.new(-dirv.Z, 0, dirv.X)
    if side.Magnitude < 0.1 then side = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end

    -- cancel this storm outright if the teleport point would land outside the
    -- map, or if the core leaves before the pass can finish. no clamping onto
    -- the edge: switch to the next storm and wait for a better one.
    local leadEnd = base + dirv * leadDist
    local exitTime = math.huge
    do
        local vx, vz = dirv.X * speed, dirv.Z * speed
        local tx, tz = math.huge, math.huge
        if vx > 1e-4 then
            tx = (MAP.maxX - EDGE_PAD - base.X) / vx
        elseif vx < -1e-4 then
            tx = (MAP.minX + EDGE_PAD - base.X) / vx
        end
        if vz > 1e-4 then
            tz = (MAP.maxZ - EDGE_PAD - base.Z) / vz
        elseif vz < -1e-4 then
            tz = (MAP.minZ + EDGE_PAD - base.Z) / vz
        end
        exitTime = math.min(tx, tz)
    end
    local passTime = math.clamp((corridor * 2) / speed + 4, 10, 45)
    if not inBounds(leadEnd.X, leadEnd.Z, EDGE_PAD) or exitTime < lead + passTime then
        ENV.stormSkip[storm] = os.clock() + 60
        if ENV.stormLock == storm then ENV.stormLock = nil end
        ENV.state = "storm too close to boundary - cancelled"
        print(string.format("[STORM] cancel %s: exit %.0fs, lead %.0fs, teleport %.0f,%.0f",
            tostring(storm.Name), exitTime, lead, leadEnd.X, leadEnd.Z))
        return
    end

    -- deployment point: on the projected path, far enough ahead in TIME that
    -- the core cannot arrive before the probes are down. prefer farther, but
    -- only if the spot is still in bounds and on dry ground.
    local deployPoint = nil
    local deployLat = 0
    local tryMult = { 1.0, 1.08, 0.94, 1.15, 0.88, 1.25, 1.4 }
    -- stay on the core's centerline: try tiny lateral nudges first so the
    -- rack lands on the path instead of stepping far off to find dry ground
    local tryLat = { 0, 0.08, -0.08, 0.16, -0.16, 0.28, -0.28, 0.45, -0.45 }
    for _, mult in ipairs(tryMult) do
        local dd = leadDist * mult
        for _, lat in ipairs(tryLat) do
            local cx = base.X + dirv.X * dd + side.X * lat * corridor
            local cz = base.Z + dirv.Z * dd + side.Z * lat * corridor
            if inBounds(cx, cz, EDGE_PAD) then
                local gx, gz, gy = drySpot(cx, cz)
                if gx and inBounds(gx, gz, EDGE_PAD) then
                    deployPoint = Vector3.new(gx, gy + 4, gz)
                    deployLat = lat
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if deployPoint then
            print(string.format("[PATH] deploy point chosen at %.0f studs, lateral %+d%% of corridor", dd, math.floor(deployLat * 100)))
            break
        end
        print(string.format("[PATH] candidate rejected: no dry ground at %.0f studs", dd))
    end

    if not deployPoint then
        ENV.state = "[SAFETY] no valid deployment position - skipping"
        print("[SAFETY] No valid deployment position; searching for fallback")
        return
    end

    -- go stand at the deploy point
    if not placeAt(deployPoint.X, deployPoint.Z) then
        ENV.state = "[SAFETY] cannot reach deployment point - skipping"
        return
    end

    task.wait(1.0)
    if not aliveSince(serial) then
        ENV.state = "died at the deploy point - aborting run"
        return
    end

    ENV.state = "lining up on the path"
    lineUp(storm, 2)
    if not aliveSince(serial) then
        ENV.state = "died while lining up - aborting run"
        return
    end

    -- revalidate before committing any probe
    local tpNow = tornadoPart(storm)
    if not tpNow then
        ENV.state = "[SAFETY] tornado vanished before deploy"
        return
    end

    -- if the wind reaches the rack before the batch can go down, do not burn
    -- the probes on a refused placement; let this storm pass
    local hrpGate = root()
    local nowDist = hrpGate and (tpNow.Position - hrpGate.Position).Magnitude or 0
    local edgeEta = speed > 0 and math.max(nowDist - radius, 0) / speed or 0
    local needSecs = have * PLACE_PER_PROBE + 3
    if edgeEta < needSecs then
        ENV.stormSkip[storm] = os.clock() + 45
        if ENV.stormLock == storm then ENV.stormLock = nil end
        ENV.state = string.format("too late (%.0fs to wind, need %.0fs) - next storm", edgeEta, needSecs)
        print(string.format("[PLACEMENT] too late: %.0fs to killzone, need %.0fs; skipping storm", edgeEta, needSecs))
        return
    end

    local preDeploy = root() and root().Position
    ENV.state = string.format("deploying %d probe%s", have, have == 1 and "" or "s")
    local placed = deployProbes(have, serial)
    ENV.placed = ENV.placed + placed
    if not aliveSince(serial) then
        ENV.state = "died during deploy - probes left for recovery"
        return
    end
    -- lock onto the probe name we just put down (nearest to our feet), so a
    -- second Scout nearby cannot hijack the filter later in the pass
    if placed > 0 then resolveProbeTag() end
    if placed == 0 then
        ENV.leadBump = math.min((ENV.leadBump or 0) + 200, 600)
        -- the wind is already on the rack: retrying this storm just wastes the
        -- pass, so let it go and take the next one with a wider lead
        ENV.stormSkip[storm] = os.clock() + 45
        if ENV.stormLock == storm then ENV.stormLock = nil end
        ENV.state = "placement refused - next storm, lead +200"
        print("[PLACEMENT] placement refused by wind; skipping this storm, lead +200.")
        return
    end

    -- being flung during the equip is what puts a probe off the park point;
    -- abort to the safe spot and re-approach on the next cycle
    local hrpAfter = root()
    if preDeploy and hrpAfter and (hrpAfter.Position - preDeploy).Magnitude > 150 then
        ENV.state = "flung by wind during equip - aborting"
        print("[WIND] flung by wind during equip! aborting to retry cleanly.")
        releaseHold()
        goSafeZone()
        ENV.stormSkip[storm] = os.clock() + 20
        return
    end

    -- stay on the path, anchored, while the core passes over the rack
    local probePoint = (ENV.parkPos and ENV.parkPos.Position) or root().Position
    local dir = tr.dir or Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)

    holdAt()

    local tpStart = tornadoPart(storm)
    local startDist = tpStart and (tpStart.Position - probePoint).Magnitude or 0
    local etaAtDeploy = speed > 0 and math.max(startDist - radius, 0) / speed or 0
    ENV.eta = etaAtDeploy
    -- edge arrival + the full pass through the killzone + grace: a wide core
    -- must not time out before it actually reaches the rack
    local passSecs = speed > 0 and (radius * 2) / speed or 0
    local maxWait = math.clamp(etaAtDeploy + passSecs + 90, 45, 400)
    print(string.format("[WAIT] chilling for %.1fs (Dynamic ETA, %.0f studs to killzone)",
        etaAtDeploy, math.max(startDist - radius, 0)))

    local closest = math.huge
    local started = os.clock()
    local lastMoney, moneyStill = -1, 0
    local lastWinds, windsStill = -1, 0
    local exposed = false          -- the core actually reached the rack
    local doneAt = nil             -- first confirmed-completion timestamp
    local moneyAtStart = moneyNow()
    local lastTpPos, lastTpAt = tpStart and tpStart.Position, os.clock()
    local missTicks = 0

    while ENV.alive and os.clock() - started < maxWait do
        task.wait(0.4)
        if not aliveSince(serial) then
            ENV.state = "died during the pass"
            ENV.holdStill = false
            return
        end
        local hrp = root()
        if not hrp then
            ENV.state = "died during the pass"
            ENV.holdStill = false
            return
        end
        local tp = tornadoPart(storm)
        if not tp or not storm.Parent then
            -- core gone: nothing left to measure, so go straight to pickup
            ENV.state = "tornado cleared early - moving to pickup"
            print("[STORM] tornado cleared early! moving to pickup.")
            break
        end

        -- live speed: track how far the core actually moved between ticks, so the
        -- ETA follows the storm even when it accelerates or stalls
        local now = os.clock()
        if lastTpPos then
            local dt = now - lastTpAt
            if dt > 0.15 then
                local v = (tp.Position - lastTpPos).Magnitude / dt
                if v > 0.5 and v < 500 then
                    speed = speed * 0.7 + v * 0.3
                end
            end
        end
        lastTpPos, lastTpAt = tp.Position, now
        ENV.speed = speed

        local d = (tp.Position - probePoint).Magnitude
        local eta = speed > 0 and math.max(d - radius, 0) / speed or 0
        ENV.dist, ENV.eta = d, eta
        if d < closest then closest = d end
        ENV.closest = closest

        -- the core has been over the rack at least once
        if closest < radius + 100 then exposed = true end

        local away = (probePoint - tp.Position):Dot(dir) < -40

        -- predicted path was off: the core is already past us and never got
        -- near the rack. stop burning time on a miss and go cash out.
        if away and not exposed and d > radius + 400 then
            missTicks = missTicks + 1
        else
            missTicks = 0
        end
        if missTicks >= 6 then
            ENV.state = "storm missed the rack - moving to pickup"
            print("[STORM] storm missed the rack; moving to pickup.")
            break
        end

        -- live readings straight off the probes
        local live = deployedProbes()
        local made, windSum, hpSum = 0, 0, 0
        for _, prb in ipairs(live) do
            made    = made    + (tonumber(prb:GetAttribute("money")) or 0)
            windSum = windSum + (tonumber(prb:GetAttribute("winds")) or 0)
            hpSum   = hpSum   + (tonumber(prb:GetAttribute("health")) or 0)
        end
        ENV.hp = hpSum
        local runSecs = os.clock() - started
        ENV.hourly = runSecs > 5 and (moneyNow() - moneyAtStart) / runSecs * 3600 or 0

        if made == lastMoney then moneyStill = moneyStill + 1 else moneyStill = 0 end
        if windSum == lastWinds then windsStill = windsStill + 1 else windsStill = 0 end
        lastMoney, lastWinds = made, windSum

        local readingsFlat = moneyStill >= FLAT_SAMPLES and windsStill >= FLAT_SAMPLES
        local farPast = away and d > clearDist

        if not exposed then
            ENV.state = string.format("chilling %.0fs - %s (ETA %.0fs)",
                os.clock() - started,
                d > radius and string.format("%.0f studs to killzone", d - radius) or "winds on the rack",
                eta)
        elseif not (away and (readingsFlat or farPast)) then
            ENV.state = "tornado still affecting probe - continuing measurements"
        else
            -- measurements stopped and the core is receding / clear
            doneAt = doneAt or os.clock()
            local elapsed = os.clock() - doneAt
            if elapsed < (ENV.grace or GRACE_SECONDS) then
                ENV.state = string.format("grace period active %.1fs", elapsed)
            else
                ENV.state = "probe ready for collection"
                break
            end
        end

        -- probes all destroyed = nothing left to earn
        if exposed and away and hpSum <= 0 and #live > 0 then
            ENV.state = "probes destroyed - collecting"
            break
        end

        -- every probe already cleared off the rack = pass finished, cash out now
        if exposed and #live == 0 then
            ENV.state = "all probes cleared - collecting"
            break
        end

        ENV.collectTime = have * 1.6
    end

    releaseHold()
    if closest < math.huge then
        print(string.format("[PASS] closest approach %.0f studs (killzone %.0f, %s)",
            closest, radius,
            closest <= radius and "core crossed the rack" or string.format("%.0f studs outside", closest - radius)))
    end
    ENV.state = "collecting"
    task.wait(0.4)
    if not aliveSince(serial) then
        ENV.state = "died before collection - recovery next cycle"
        return
    end
    local got = collectProbes(serial)
    ENV.runs = ENV.runs + 1
    -- a clean pickup pays down the death/refusal padding, so the lead creeps
    -- back toward the tight value instead of staying permanently wide
    if (ENV.leadBump or 0) > 0 then
        ENV.leadBump = math.max(0, ENV.leadBump - 100)
    end
    ENV.state = string.format("collection complete - next cycle | run %d, %d back", ENV.runs, got)

    if probeTools() < WANT and moneyNow() > 2500 then
        restock()
        task.wait(0.8)
    end
end

local function respawnNow()
    local events = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("events")
    local ev = events and events:FindFirstChild("plr_respawn")
    if ev then pcall(function() ev:FireServer() end) end
    task.wait(0.5)

    if rg then
        for _, d in ipairs(rg:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("TextButton") then
                for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(d.MouseButton1Click)) do
                    pcall(function() c.Function() end)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

local function watchCharacter(ch)
    local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end
    hum.Died:Connect(function()
        -- do NOT clear busy here: the cycle that is mid-pass must unwind on its
        -- own, otherwise two cycles end up running at once
        ENV.deathSerial = ENV.deathSerial + 1
        ENV.deathAt = os.clock()
        ENV.cooldownUntil = os.clock() + 10.5
        ENV.leadBump = math.min((ENV.leadBump or 0) + 500, 2500)
        ENV.dead = true
        ENV.holdStill = false
        ENV.parkPos = nil
        ENV.lastClear = 0
        ENV.state = "died - respawning"
        ENV.justDied = true
        print("[DEATH] character died! intercept distance bumped by +500 studs")
        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait(0.35)
            pcall(respawnNow)
            for _ = 1, 25 do
                if LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then break end
                task.wait(0.2)
                pcall(respawnNow)
            end
        end)
    end)
end

    task.wait(0.2)

    ENV.dead = false

    ENV.state = "back up"
    print("[RECOVERY] player respawned; checking existing equipment")
end)

local fbSaved = nil

local function applyFB()
    Lighting.Brightness = 3
    Lighting.ClockTime = 14
    Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(172, 172, 184)
    Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(172, 172, 184)
    Lighting.FogEnd = 1e6
    Lighting.FogStart = 0
    Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
    for _, e in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
        if e:IsA("Atmosphere") then pcall(function() e.Density = 0 end) end
    end
end

local function setFullbright(on)
    if on then
        if not fbSaved then
            fbSaved = {
                Brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
                ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime,
                Ambient = Lighting.Ambient,
                OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
                FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
                FogStart = Lighting.FogStart,
                GlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
                Density = {},
            }
            for _, e in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
                if e:IsA("Atmosphere") then fbSaved.Density[e] = e.Density end
            end
        end
        applyFB()
    elseif fbSaved then
        Lighting.Brightness = fbSaved.Brightness
        Lighting.ClockTime = fbSaved.ClockTime
        Lighting.Ambient = fbSaved.Ambient
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = fbSaved.OutdoorAmbient
        Lighting.FogEnd = fbSaved.FogEnd
        Lighting.FogStart = fbSaved.FogStart
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = fbSaved.GlobalShadows
        for e, d in pairs(fbSaved.Density) do
            if e.Parent then pcall(function() e.Density = d end) end
        end
        fbSaved = nil
    end
end

local stormEsp = {}

local function clearStormESP()

    for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if d.Name == "TW_STORM" and d:IsA("BillboardGui") then pcall(function() d:Destroy() end) end

end

local function refreshStormESP()
    if not ENV.esp then return end
    local hrp = root()
    local my = hrp and hrp.Position
    local target = activeStorm()

    local sr = workspace:FindFirstChild("storm_related")
    local st = sr and sr:FindFirstChild("storms")
    local list = st and st:GetChildren() or {}

    for _, storm in ipairs(list) do
        local tp = tornadoPart(storm)   -- no funnel, no tag
        if tp then
            local bb = stormEsp[storm]
            if not (bb and bb.Parent) then
                bb = new("BillboardGui", {
                    Name = "TW_STORM",
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 46),
                    StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 26, 0),
                    AlwaysOnTop = true,
                    MaxDistance = 60000,
                }, tp)
                new("TextLabel", {
                    Name = "Top", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextSize = 15, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
                    TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2, Text = "-",
                }, bb)
                new("TextLabel", {
                    Name = "Mid", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 13), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 18),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 10,
                    TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 214, 224), TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3, Text = "-",
                }, bb)
                new("TextLabel", {
                    Name = "Low", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 31),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 9,
                    TextColor3 = C.good, TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3, Text = "",
                }, bb)
                stormEsp[storm] = bb
            end

            local winds = stormWinds(storm)
            local d = my and (tp.Position - my).Magnitude or -1
            local hot = winds >= 140
            local isTarget = (storm == target)

            bb.Enabled = d < 0 or d <= 25000
            local top = bb:FindFirstChild("Top")
            local mid = bb:FindFirstChild("Mid")
            local low = bb:FindFirstChild("Low")
            if top then
                top.Text = string.format("%d mph", math.floor(winds))
                top.TextColor3 = hot and C.bad or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            end
            if mid then
                mid.Text = d >= 0 and string.format("%d studs", d) or "-"
            end
            if low then
                low.Text = isTarget and "TARGET" or ""
                low.TextColor3 = C.good
            end
        end
    end

    for storm, bb in pairs(stormEsp) do
        if not storm.Parent or not tornadoPart(storm) then
            pcall(function() bb:Destroy() end)
            stormEsp[storm] = nil
        end
    end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local MAX_DISTANCE = 700

local roleColors = {
	["Slapper"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 110),
	["Detective"] = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 255),
	["Chemist"] = Color3.fromRGB(0, 230, 180),
	["Murderer"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0),
	["Sheriff"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 0),
	["Medic"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 220),
	["Wizard"] = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 255),
	["Clown"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100),
	["Thug"] = Color3.fromRGB(180, 0, 255),
	["Cop"] = Color3.fromRGB(100, 180, 255),
	["Agent"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 0),
	["Hacker"] = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 50),
	["Barber"] = Color3.fromRGB(0, 195, 255),
	["Party Pooper"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 75, 0)
}

local defaultColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

-- Получение только информации о роли игрока
local function getRoleInfo(character)
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then return nil, defaultColor end

	local roleValue = humanoid:FindFirstChild("Role") or character:FindFirstChild("Role")
	if roleValue and roleValue.Value ~= "" then
		local roleName = tostring(roleValue.Value)
		local roleColor = roleColors[roleName] or defaultColor
		return roleName, roleColor
	end

	return nil, defaultColor
end

-- Применение подсветки только к персонажу
local function updateHighlight(character, color, enabled)
	local highlight = character:FindFirstChild("ESPHighlight")
	if not highlight then
		highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
		highlight.Name = "ESPHighlight"
		highlight.FillTransparency = 0.4
		highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0.2
		highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
		highlight.Parent = character
	end

	highlight.Enabled = enabled
	highlight.FillColor = color
end

-- Создание только имени и роли над головой
local function updateNameTag(character, playerName, roleName, color, enabled)
	local gui = character:FindFirstChild("ESPNameTag")
	if not gui then
		gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		gui.Name = "ESPNameTag"
		gui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 50)
		gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
		gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
		gui.MaxDistance = MAX_DISTANCE
		gui.Parent = character

		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Name = "TagLabel"
		label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
		label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		label.TextScaled = true
		label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
		label.Parent = gui
	end

	gui.Enabled = enabled
	local label = gui:FindFirstChild("TagLabel")
	if label then
		label.Text = playerName .. "\n[" .. (roleName or "Unknown") .. "]"
		label.TextColor3 = color
	end
end

-- MY TG YHYZO
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
	local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player ~= LocalPlayer then
			local char = player.Character
			local targetRoot = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

			if char and targetRoot and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
				local inRange = true
				if myRoot then
					local distance = (myRoot.Position - targetRoot.Position).Magnitude
					inRange = distance <= MAX_DISTANCE
				end

				local roleName, roleColor = getRoleInfo(char)
				updateHighlight(char, roleColor, inRange)
				updateNameTag(char, player.Name, roleName, roleColor, inRange)
			end
		end
	end
end)

scripts.code:
--=============================================================
--  OKAZ LEGACY  v1.0
--  Fling Things and People
--  Simple build. Two tabs. Nothing to learn.
--  RightShift = show/hide
--=============================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local WS = game:GetService("Workspace")

local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
local PG = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local CAM = WS.CurrentCamera

if PG:FindFirstChild("OkazLegacy") then PG.OkazLegacy:Destroy() end

-- how hard you throw. 350 is the safe limit for this game.
local power = 350
local lift = 0.25
local autoFling = true
local aura = false
local held = nil

-- small helper so the GUI code stays short
local function new(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do o[k] = v end
	o.Parent = parent
	return o
end

local function getRoot(plr)
	local c = plr and plr.Character
	local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local r = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if h and r and h.Health > 0 then return r end
end

-- pushes a part away from the camera
local function push(part, force, up, dir)
	if not part or not part.Parent then return end
	dir = dir or CAM.CFrame.LookVector
	local bv = new("BodyVelocity", {
		MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6),
		Velocity = dir * force + Vector3.new(0, force * up, 0) }, part)
	task.delay(0.12, function() if bv then bv:Destroy() end end)
end

-- the game creates a "GrabParts" model while you hold something.
-- WeldConstraint.Part1 is the real object. We catch it on release.
WS.ChildAdded:Connect(function(model)
	if model.Name ~= "GrabParts" then return end
	task.wait(0.05)
	local gp = model:FindFirstChild("GrabPart")
	local weld = gp and gp:FindFirstChildOfClass("WeldConstraint")
	local target = weld and weld.Part1
	if not target then return end
	held = target

	model:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Parent"):Connect(function()
		if model.Parent then return end
		if autoFling and target.Parent then push(target, power, lift) end
		held = nil
	end)
end)

-- aura: fling whatever is near you
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(0.3)
		if aura then
			local r = getRoot(LP)
			if r then
				local params = OverlapParams.new()
				params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
				params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { LP.Character }
				for _, p in ipairs(WS:GetPartBoundsInRadius(r.Position, 30, params)) do
					if p:IsA("BasePart") and not p.Anchored and p ~= held then
						push(p, power * 0.5, 0.4, (p.Position - r.Position).Unit)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

--=========================== GUI =============================
local gui = new("ScreenGui", { Name = "OkazLegacy", IgnoreGuiInset = true,
	ResetOnSpawn = false, DisplayOrder = 999, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling }, PG)

local main = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 340), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -140, 0.5, -170),

	Clear    = merge(WEATHER_BASE, {}),
	Cloudy   = merge(WEATHER_BASE, { cover = 0.65, density = 0.7, gloom = 0.25 }),
	Overcast = merge(WEATHER_BASE, { cover = 0.9, density = 0.9, gloom = 0.5 }),
	Foggy    = merge(WEATHER_BASE, { cover = 0.6, density = 0.7, gloom = 0.3, fog = 1 }),
	Rain     = merge(WEATHER_BASE, { cover = 0.9, density = 0.95, gloom = 0.6, fog = 0.25, rain = 1 }),

--// Create the effects ---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function make(className, name, props)
	local old = Lighting:FindFirstChild(name)
	if old then old:Destroy() end
	local inst = Instance.new(className)
	inst.Name = name
	for k, v in pairs(props) do
		inst[k] = v
	end
	inst.Parent = Lighting
	return inst
end

local function newGui(name, order)
	local g = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	g.Name = name
	g.ResetOnSpawn = false
	g.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	g.DisplayOrder = order
	g.Parent = guiParent

-- Vignette: four gradient edges
local vigGui = newGui("SP_Vignette", 50)
local vigEdges = {}
local function edge(anchor, position, size, rotation)
	local f = Instance.new("Frame")
	f.BorderSizePixel = 0
	f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	f.AnchorPoint = anchor
	f.Position = position
	f.Size = size
	local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	g.Rotation = rotation
	g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1)
	g.Parent = f
	f.Parent = vigGui
	table.insert(vigEdges, f)
end

-- Lens flare: sun glow, ghosts along the sun->center axis, and an anamorphic streak
local flareGui = newGui("SP_Flare", 40)
local flareParts = {}
local function flareElement(k, size, color, alpha, ring, streak)
	local f = Instance.new("Frame")
	f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	f.BorderSizePixel = 0
	f.BackgroundColor3 = color
	f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	local e = { frame = f, k = k, size = size, alpha = alpha, streak = streak }
	if streak then
		local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
		g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
		})
		g.Parent = f
	else
		local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
		c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
		c.Parent = f
		if ring then
			local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
			s.Color = color
			s.Thickness = 3
			s.Transparency = 1
			s.Parent = f
			f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			e.stroke = s
		end
	end
	f.Parent = flareGui
	table.insert(flareParts, e)
end

-- Screen-space rain streaks
local rainGui = newGui("SP_Rain", -5)
local drops = {}
for i = 1, RAIN_DROPS do
	local f = Instance.new("Frame")
	f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	f.BorderSizePixel = 0
	f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(205, 220, 240)
	f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.6 + math.random() * 0.25
	f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.random(1, 2), math.random(26, 60))
	f.Visible = false
	f.Parent = rainGui
	drops[i] = {
		frame = f,
		x = math.random() * 1.2 - 0.1,
		y = math.random(),
		speed = 1.1 + math.random() * 0.9,
		on = false,
	}
end

local function updateRain(dt, amount, slantDeg, vp)
	local count = math.floor(RAIN_DROPS * math.clamp(amount, 0, 1))
	local drift = math.tan(math.rad(slantDeg)) * (vp.Y / math.max(vp.X, 1))
	for i, d in ipairs(drops) do
		if i <= count then
			if not d.on then
				d.on = true
				d.frame.Visible = true
			end
			d.y += d.speed * dt
			d.x += d.speed * dt * drift
			if d.y > 1.1 then
				d.y = -0.1
				d.x = math.random() * 1.2 - 0.1
			end
			if d.x > 1.1 then d.x = -0.1 end
			d.frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(d.x, d.y)
			d.frame.Rotation = -slantDeg
		elseif d.on then
			d.on = false
			d.frame.Visible = false
		end
	end
end
