--// Hide / restore the game's own post effects -------------------------------------------------------
local stashed = {}

local function stashExisting()
	if not REPLACE_EXISTING_EFFECTS then return end
	for _, child in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
		if (child:IsA("PostEffect") or child:IsA("Atmosphere")) and child.Name:sub(1, 3) ~= "SP_" then
			table.insert(stashed, child)
			child.Parent = nil
		end
	end
end

local function restoreStashed()
	for _, inst in ipairs(stashed) do
		inst.Parent = Lighting
	end
	table.clear(stashed)
end

--// Clouds / sky / water (capture originals, restore on disable) ---------------------------------------
local clouds, cloudsOrig, cloudsOwn
local function ensureClouds()
	if clouds and clouds.Parent then return end
	clouds = terrain:FindFirstChildOfClass("Clouds")
	cloudsOwn = false
	if clouds then
		cloudsOrig = { Cover = clouds.Cover, Density = clouds.Density, Color = clouds.Color, Enabled = clouds.Enabled }
	else
		clouds = Instance.new("Clouds")
		clouds.Name = "SP_Clouds"
		clouds.Parent = terrain
		cloudsOwn = true
	end
end
local function restoreClouds()
	if not (clouds and clouds.Parent) then return end
	if cloudsOwn then
        clouds:Destroy()
        clouds = nil
	else
		for k, v in pairs(cloudsOrig) do
			clouds[k] = v
		end
	end
end

local sky, skyOrig, skyOwn
local function ensureSky()
	if sky and sky.Parent then return end
	sky = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky")
	skyOwn = false
	if sky then
		skyOrig = {
			StarCount = sky.StarCount, SunAngularSize = sky.SunAngularSize,
			MoonAngularSize = sky.MoonAngularSize, CelestialBodiesShown = sky.CelestialBodiesShown,
		}
	else
		sky = Instance.new("Sky")
		sky.Name = "SP_Sky"
		sky.Parent = Lighting
		skyOwn = true
	end
end
local function restoreSky()
	if not (sky and sky.Parent) then return end
	if skyOwn then
		sky:Destroy()
		sky = nil
	else
		for k, v in pairs(skyOrig) do
			sky[k] = v
		end
	end
end

local function restoreWater()
	for p, v in pairs(waterOrig) do
		terrain[p] = v
	end
end

--// Helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function approach(inst, prop, target, a)
	local cur = inst[prop]
	if typeof(cur) == "Color3" then
		inst[prop] = cur:Lerp(target, a)
	else
		inst[prop] = cur + (target - cur) * a
	end
end

local function applyProps(inst, tbl, a)
	for prop, value in pairs(tbl) do
		approach(inst, prop, value, a)
	end
end

local scratch = { Lighting = {}, Bloom = {}, Color = {}, SunRays = {}, DOF = {}, Atmo = {}, Water = {} }
local function fill(dst, src)
	for k in pairs(dst) do dst[k] = nil end
	for k, v in pairs(src) do dst[k] = v end
	return dst
end

local function isUnderwater(pos)
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		local cell = terrain:WorldToCell(pos)
		local center = terrain:CellCenterToWorld(cell.X, cell.Y, cell.Z)
		local region = Region3.new(center - Vector3.one * 2, center + Vector3.one * 2)
		local materials, occupancy = terrain:ReadVoxels(region, 4)
		if materials[1][1][1] ~= Enum.Material.Water then
			return false
		end
		local surfaceY = (center.Y - 2) + occupancy[1][1][1] * 4
		return pos.Y < surfaceY
	end)
	return ok and result or false
end

-- Checks how enclosed the camera is and whether the sun is visible (runs ~7x per second)
local SKY_RAYS = {
	Vector3.new(0, 1, 0),
	Vector3.new(0.6, 1, 0).Unit,
	Vector3.new(-0.6, 1, 0).Unit,
	Vector3.new(0, 1, 0.6).Unit,
	Vector3.new(0, 1, -0.6).Unit,
}
local function sampleSurroundings()
	local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
	local hits = 0
	for _, dir in ipairs(SKY_RAYS) do
		if Workspace:Raycast(origin, dir * 70, rayParams) then
			hits += 1
		end
	end
	indoorTarget = hits / #SKY_RAYS
	local sunDir = Lighting:GetSunDirection()
	sunVisible = sunDir.Y > -0.05 and Workspace:Raycast(origin, sunDir * 1500, rayParams) == nil
end

local function refreshFlags()
	local m = config.Master
	bloom.Enabled = m and features.Bloom
	grade.Enabled = m and features.ColorGrade
	sunRays.Enabled = m and features.SunRays
	dof.Enabled = m and features.DepthOfField
	if not (m and features.MotionBlur) then
		motionBlur.Enabled = false
		motionBlur.Size = 0
	end
	atmosphere.Parent = (m and features.Atmosphere) and Lighting or nil
	if not m then
		waterGrade.Enabled = false
		waterBlur.Enabled = false
		flashGrade.Enabled = false
	end
	vigGui.Enabled = m
	barsGui.Enabled = m
	rainGui.Enabled = m
	flareGui.Enabled = m and features.LensFlare
end

local function setWeather(name)
	currentWeather = name
	features.Weather = true
	if refreshUI then refreshUI() end
end

local function pickRandomWeather()
	local pool = {}
	for _, n in ipairs(WEATHER_ORDER) do
		if n ~= currentWeather then
			table.insert(pool, n)
		end
	end
	setWeather(pool[math.random(#pool)])
end

local function updateFlare(dt, sunDir, vp)
	local target = 0
	if features.LensFlare then
		local pos, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(camera.CFrame.Position + sunDir * 1000)
		if onScreen and pos.Z > 0 and sunVisible then
			lastSunPx = Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y)
			local fromCenter = (lastSunPx - vp / 2).Magnitude / math.max(vp.Magnitude / 2, 1)
			target = math.clamp(1.3 - fromCenter * 1.3, 0, 1)
			target *= math.clamp(sunDir.Y * 6 + 0.3, 0, 1)
			target *= (1 - 0.85 * wx.cover)
			target *= (1 - uw)
		end
	end
	flareAmt += (target - flareAmt) * (1 - math.exp(-dt * 8))
	flareGui.Enabled = flareAmt > 0.01
	if not flareGui.Enabled then return end

	local axis = vp / 2 - lastSunPx
	for _, e in ipairs(flareParts) do
		local p = lastSunPx + axis * e.k
		e.frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p.X, p.Y)
		if e.streak then
			e.frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(vp.X * 0.7, 5)
		else
			local s = e.size * vp.Y
			e.frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(s, s)
		end
		local tr = 1 - flareAmt * e.alpha
		if e.stroke then
			e.stroke.Transparency = tr
		else
			e.frame.BackgroundTransparency = tr
		end
	end
end

--// Main loop -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(rawDt)
	if not config.Master then return end
	local activeCamera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not activeCamera then return end
    if camera ~= activeCamera then
        camera = activeCamera
        baseFov = camera.FieldOfView
        lastLook = camera.CFrame.LookVector
        fovTouched = false
    end

	local dt = math.min(rawDt, 0.1)
    local instantFPS = 1 / math.max(rawDt, 1 / 240)
    fpsAverage += (instantFPS - fpsAverage) * (1 - math.exp(-dt * 1.8))
    qualityCheckTimer += dt
    if autoQuality and qualityCheckTimer >= 2 then
        qualityCheckTimer = 0
        if fpsAverage < 42 then
            qualityScale = math.max(0.45, qualityScale - 0.10)
        elseif fpsAverage > 58 then
            qualityScale = math.min(0.72, qualityScale + 0.04)
        end
        if refreshUI then refreshUI() end
    end
    fpsUiTimer += dt
	local preset = PRESETS[currentPreset]
	local S = strength
	local a = 1 - math.exp(-dt * TRANSITION_SPEED)
	local fa = 1 - math.exp(-dt * FOCUS_SPEED)
	local vp = camera.ViewportSize

	-- Clock + sun
	if features.DayNightCycle then
		Lighting.ClockTime = (Lighting.ClockTime + dt * CLOCK_SPEED) % 24
	end
	local sunDir = Lighting:GetSunDirection()
	local sunHeight = sunDir.Y
	local dayFactor = features.NightAdapt and math.clamp(sunHeight * 2 + 0.2, 0, 1) or 1
	local night = math.clamp(-sunHeight * 3.5, 0, 1)
	local golden = math.clamp(1 - math.abs(sunHeight) / 0.3, 0, 1)
	local tg = features.TimeGrade and 1 or 0

	timeUiTimer -= dt
	if timeUiTimer <= 0 and timeSlider then
		timeUiTimer = 0.25
		timeSlider.set(Lighting.ClockTime)
	end

	-- Weather blending
	local wTarget = features.Weather and WEATHER[currentWeather] or WEATHER.Clear
	local wa = 1 - math.exp(-dt * WEATHER_SPEED)
	for k, v in pairs(wTarget) do
		wx[k] += (v - wx[k]) * wa
	end
	if features.AutoWeather then
		weatherTimer -= dt
		if weatherTimer <= 0 then
			weatherTimer = math.random(AUTO_WEATHER_MIN, AUTO_WEATHER_MAX)
			pickRandomWeather()
		end
	end

	-- Surroundings (indoors / sun visibility)
	sampleTimer -= dt
	if sampleTimer <= 0 then
		sampleTimer = 0.15 / math.max(qualityScale, 0.45)
		sampleSurroundings()
	end
	indoor += (indoorTarget - indoor) * (1 - math.exp(-dt * 3))

	-- Underwater (checked 10x per second)
	waterTimer += dt
	if waterTimer > (0.1 / math.max(qualityScale, 0.45)) then
		waterTimer = 0
		underwater = features.UnderwaterFX and isUnderwater(camera.CFrame.Position)
	end
	uw += ((underwater and 1 or 0) - uw) * (1 - math.exp(-dt * 4))
	waterGrade.Enabled = underwater
	waterBlur.Enabled = underwater

	-- Low health amount (0 = healthy, 1 = nearly dead)
	local danger = 0
	if features.LowHealthFX and humanoid and humanoid.Parent and humanoid.MaxHealth > 0 then
		local frac = humanoid.Health / humanoid.MaxHealth
		danger = math.clamp((0.35 - frac) / 0.35, 0, 1)
	end

	-- Lightning
	if features.Weather and wx.storm > 0.6 then
		boltTimer -= dt
		if boltTimer <= 0 then
			flash = 1
			boltTimer = 4 + math.random() * 10
			pendingFlash = (math.random() < 0.55) and 0.12 or nil
		end
	end
	if pendingFlash then
		pendingFlash -= dt
		if pendingFlash <= 0 then
			flash = math.max(flash, 0.75)
			pendingFlash = nil
		end
	end
	flash *= math.exp(-dt * 8)
	local flashAmt = flash * (1 - indoor * 0.7)
	flashGrade.Enabled = flashAmt > 0.01
	if flashGrade.Enabled then
		flashGrade.Brightness = flashAmt * 0.35
		flashGrade.Contrast = flashAmt * 0.25
	end

	-- Auto exposure (eye adaptation): brighter indoors, darker when staring at the sun
	local exposureTarget = 0
	if features.AutoExposure then
		exposureTarget += indoor * 0.5 * (0.4 + 0.6 * dayFactor)
		local facing = math.max(0, camera.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(sunDir)) ^ 6
		exposureTarget -= facing * 0.55 * dayFactor * (sunVisible and 1 or 0) * (1 - 0.8 * wx.cover)
	end
	eyeExposure += (exposureTarget - eyeExposure) * (1 - math.exp(-dt * 1.2))

	-- Lighting properties (+ weather + time of day)
	local lt = fill(scratch.Lighting, preset.Lighting)
	lt.Brightness = lt.Brightness * (1 - 0.4 * wx.gloom)
	lt.ExposureCompensation = lt.ExposureCompensation - 0.35 * wx.gloom + eyeExposure
	lt.EnvironmentSpecularScale = math.min(1, lt.EnvironmentSpecularScale + 0.3 * wx.rain)
	lt.Ambient = lt.Ambient:Lerp(GREY_AMBIENT, wx.gloom * 0.45)
	lt.OutdoorAmbient = lt.OutdoorAmbient:Lerp(GREY_AMBIENT, wx.gloom * 0.45)
	if tg > 0 then
		lt.Ambient = lt.Ambient:Lerp(NIGHT_AMBIENT, night * 0.55)
		lt.OutdoorAmbient = lt.OutdoorAmbient:Lerp(NIGHT_OUTDOOR, night * 0.7)
		lt.ColorShift_Top = lt.ColorShift_Top:Lerp(WARM_SUN, golden * 0.7)
		lt.ColorShift_Bottom = lt.ColorShift_Bottom:Lerp(WARM_BOUNCE, golden * 0.5)
	end
	applyProps(Lighting, lt, a)

	-- Bloom (stronger at night)
	if features.Bloom then
		local t = fill(scratch.Bloom, preset.Bloom)
		t.Intensity = t.Intensity * S * (1 + (1 - dayFactor) * 0.6)
		applyProps(bloom, t, a)
	end

	-- Color grading (strength, weather, time of day, rainbow, low health)
	if features.ColorGrade then
		local t = fill(scratch.Color, preset.Color)
		t.Brightness = t.Brightness * S
		t.Contrast = t.Contrast * S
		t.Saturation = t.Saturation * S
		t.TintColor = WHITE:Lerp(t.TintColor, math.min(S, 1))

		t.Saturation = t.Saturation - 0.35 * wx.gloom - 0.2 * wx.snow
		t.TintColor = t.TintColor:Lerp(COOL_GREY, wx.gloom * 0.45 + wx.snow * 0.2)

		if tg > 0 then
			t.TintColor = t.TintColor:Lerp(GOLDEN_TINT, golden * 0.5)
			t.TintColor = t.TintColor:Lerp(NIGHT_TINT, night * 0.45)
			t.Saturation = t.Saturation + golden * 0.12 - night * 0.1
			t.Contrast = t.Contrast + golden * 0.05
		end
		if features.RainbowTint then
			t.TintColor = Color3.fromHSV((os.clock() * 0.05) % 1, 0.3, 1)
		end
		if danger > 0 then
			t.Saturation = t.Saturation - danger * 0.6
			t.TintColor = t.TintColor:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 110), danger * 0.6)
		end
		t.Saturation = math.clamp(t.Saturation, -1, 1)
		t.Contrast = math.clamp(t.Contrast, -1, 1)
		t.Brightness = math.clamp(t.Brightness, -1, 1)
		applyProps(grade, t, a)
	end

	-- God rays fade after sunset and behind clouds
	if features.SunRays then
		local t = fill(scratch.SunRays, preset.SunRays)
		t.Intensity = math.clamp(t.Intensity * S * dayFactor * (1 - 0.8 * wx.cover), 0, 1)
		applyProps(sunRays, t, a)
	end

	-- Atmosphere (weather fog, golden/blue hour, underwater fog)
	if features.Atmosphere then
		local t = fill(scratch.Atmo, preset.Atmosphere)
		t.Density = math.clamp(t.Density * S + 0.45 * wx.fog + 0.08 * wx.gloom + 0.45 * uw, 0, 1)
		t.Haze = t.Haze + 3 * wx.fog + wx.gloom
		t.Glare = t.Glare * (1 - 0.85 * wx.cover)
		if tg > 0 then
			t.Color = t.Color:Lerp(GOLD_FOG, golden * 0.6):Lerp(NIGHT_FOG, night * 0.8)
			t.Decay = t.Decay:Lerp(GOLD_DECAY, golden * 0.6):Lerp(NIGHT_DECAY, night * 0.8)
			t.Glare = t.Glare + golden * 0.6
		end
		t.Color = t.Color:Lerp(GREY_FOG, wx.gloom * 0.7):Lerp(WATER_FOG, uw * 0.85)
		t.Decay = t.Decay:Lerp(GREY_DECAY, wx.gloom * 0.7):Lerp(WATER_DECAY, uw * 0.85)
		applyProps(atmosphere, t, a)
	end

	-- Depth of field with auto-focus (raycasts from the camera)
	if features.DepthOfField then
		local t = fill(scratch.DOF, preset.DOF)
		t.FarIntensity = t.FarIntensity * S
		t.NearIntensity = t.NearIntensity * S
		if features.AutoFocus then
			local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
			local hit = Workspace:Raycast(origin, camera.CFrame.LookVector * MAX_FOCUS, rayParams)
			local dist = hit and (hit.Position - origin).Magnitude or MAX_FOCUS
			t.FocusDistance = dist
			t.InFocusRadius = math.clamp(dist * 0.5, 8, 120)
			t.NearIntensity = 0 -- don't blur your own character
		end
		applyProps(dof, t, fa)
	end

	-- Volumetric clouds (cover/density from weather, color from time of day)
	if features.Clouds then
		ensureClouds()
		clouds.Enabled = true
		clouds.Cover = wx.cover
		clouds.Density = wx.density
		local cc = WHITE:Lerp(CLOUD_GOLD, golden * 0.8 * tg)
		cc = cc:Lerp(CLOUD_NIGHT, night * 0.9 * tg)
		cc = cc:Lerp(CLOUD_GLOOM, wx.gloom * 0.75)
		approach(clouds, "Color", cc, a)
	end

	-- Stars, sun and moon
	if features.Celestial then
		ensureSky()
		sky.CelestialBodiesShown = true
		sky.StarCount = math.floor(( ((currentPreset == "StarryNight") or (currentPreset == "Aurora")) and 9000 or 7000 ) * night * (1 - 0.55 * wx.cover))
		sky.SunAngularSize = 21 + golden * 12
		sky.MoonAngularSize = 15
	end

	-- Water shader (waves get bigger in rain / storms)
	if features.WaterFX then
		local t = fill(scratch.Water, preset.Water)
		t.WaterWaveSize = math.min(1, t.WaterWaveSize + 0.35 * wx.storm + 0.12 * wx.rain)
		t.WaterWaveSpeed = t.WaterWaveSpeed + 14 * wx.storm + 5 * wx.rain
		t.WaterColor = t.WaterColor:Lerp(GREY_WATER, wx.gloom * 0.5)
		applyProps(terrain, t, a)
	end

	-- Motion blur from camera rotation speed
	local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
	if features.MotionBlur then
		local angle = math.acos(math.clamp(lastLook:Dot(look), -1, 1))
		local turnSpeed = angle / math.max(dt, 1 / 240)
		local target = math.clamp(turnSpeed * MOTION_BLUR_STRENGTH, 0, MOTION_BLUR_MAX)
		motionBlur.Size += (target - motionBlur.Size) * (1 - math.exp(-dt * 14))
		motionBlur.Enabled = motionBlur.Size > 0.3
	end
	lastLook = look

	-- Vignette (+ low-health pulse)
	local vigTarget = features.Vignette and (preset.Vignette * S + wx.gloom * 0.1) or 0
	if danger > 0 then
		vigTarget += danger * 0.45 + math.sin(os.clock() * 7) * 0.08 * danger
	end
	vig += (vigTarget - vig) * a
	setVignette(vig)

	-- Cinematic bars (2.39:1)
	local barFrac = math.max(0, (1 - (vp.X / math.max(vp.Y, 1)) / 2.39) / 2)
	local barTarget = features.Letterbox and barFrac or 0
	barCur += (barTarget - barCur) * math.min(1, a * 2)
	barTop.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, barCur)
	barBottom.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, barCur)

	-- Lens flare
	updateFlare(dt, sunDir, vp)

	-- Snow follows the camera; both snow and rain fade out when you're sheltered or underwater
	local shelter = (1 - indoor) * (1 - uw)
	snowPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(camera.CFrame.Position + Vector3.new(0, 35, 0))
	snowEmitter.Rate = 300 * wx.snow * shelter * qualityScale
	updateRain(dt, wx.rain * shelter * qualityScale, 6 + 10 * wx.storm, vp)

	-- Speed FOV
	if features.SpeedFOV and rootPart and rootPart.Parent then
		local speed = rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
		local target = baseFov + math.clamp((speed - 20) * 0.4, 0, 22)
		camera.FieldOfView += (target - camera.FieldOfView) * fa
		fovTouched = true
	elseif fovTouched then
		camera.FieldOfView += (baseFov - camera.FieldOfView) * a
		if math.abs(camera.FieldOfView - baseFov) < 0.05 then
			camera.FieldOfView = baseFov
			fovTouched = false
		end
	end
end)

--// Handheld camera sway (runs right after the default camera) ---------------------------------------------------
local swaySeed = math.random() * 100
RunService:BindToRenderStep("SP_CameraSway", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
	if not (config.Master and features.CameraSway) then return end
	local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then return end

	local t = os.clock() + swaySeed
	local planar = 0
	if rootPart and rootPart.Parent then
		local v = rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		planar = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z).Magnitude
	end
	local move = math.clamp(planar / 16, 0, 1)
	local amp = 0.0015 + move * 0.0035 + wx.storm * 0.004
	local pitch = math.sin(t * 1.1) * amp + math.sin(t * 2.3) * amp * 0.4
	local yaw = math.sin(t * 0.9 + 2) * amp
	local roll = math.sin(t * 0.7 + 4) * amp * 0.8
	local bob = math.sin(t * 9) * 0.045 * move
	cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, bob, 0) * CFrame.Angles(pitch, yaw, roll)
end)

local function makeSlider(text, minV, maxV, value, fmt, onChange)
	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42)
	holder.LayoutOrder = nextOrder()
	holder.Parent = scroll

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")

	label.TextSize = 12
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 215)
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.Parent = holder

	local track = Instance.new("Frame")
	track.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 28)
	track.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 6)
	track.BackgroundColor3 = COL_OFF
	track.BorderSizePixel = 0
	round(track, 3)
	track.Parent = holder

	local fillBar = Instance.new("Frame")
	fillBar.BackgroundColor3 = COL_SEL
	fillBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
	fillBar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
	round(fillBar, 3)
	fillBar.Parent = track

	local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
	knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14)
	knob.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.5)
	knob.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
	knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
	round(knob, 7)
	knob.Parent = track

	local hit = Instance.new("TextButton")
	hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	hit.Text = ""
	hit.Position = UDim2.new(0, -6, 0, 20)
	hit.Size = UDim2.new(1, 12, 0, 22)
	hit.Parent = holder

	local dragging = false
	local function setValue(v, silent)
		local current = math.clamp(v, minV, maxV)
		local alpha = (current - minV) / (maxV - minV)
		fillBar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(alpha, 1)
		knob.Position = UDim2.fromScale(alpha, 0.5)
		label.Text = text .. ":  " .. fmt(current)
		if not silent then onChange(current) end
	end
	local function fromInput(x)
		local alpha = math.clamp((x - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(track.AbsoluteSize.X, 1), 0, 1)
		setValue(minV + (maxV - minV) * alpha)
	end
	local function isPointer(input)
		return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
	end

	hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if isPointer(input) then
			dragging = true
			scroll.ScrollingEnabled = false
			fromInput(input.Position.X)
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			fromInput(input.Position.X)
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and isPointer(input) then
			dragging = false
			scroll.ScrollingEnabled = true
		end
	end)

	setValue(value, true)
	return {
		set = function(v)
			if not dragging then setValue(v, true) end
		end,
	}
end

local function cycleList(listTable, current, step)
	local idx = table.find(listTable, current) or 1
	return listTable[(idx - 1 + step) % #listTable + 1]

scripts.code:
-- Join Discord For More Open Sources, Coming Soon https://discord.gg/axonic

repeat task.wait() until game:IsLoaded()

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer or Players.PlayerAdded:Wait()
local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
local env = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G

if type(env.AxonicRivalsCleanup) == "function" then
    pcall(env.AxonicRivalsCleanup)
end

local function safeRequire(instance)
    if not instance then return end
    local ok, result = pcall(require, instance)
    if ok then return result end
end

local scripts = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts")
local Gun = safeRequire(scripts:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("ItemTypes"):WaitForChild("Gun"))
local controllers = scripts:WaitForChild("Controllers")
local FighterController = safeRequire(controllers:WaitForChild("FighterController"))
local DuelController = safeRequire(controllers:FindFirstChild("DuelController"))
local Utility = safeRequire(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("Utility"))
if not (Gun and FighterController and Utility) then
    return
end

local State = {
    SilentAim = true,
    AimPart = "Smart",
    ShowFOV = true,
    FOV = 180,
    WallCheck = true,
    StickyTarget = true,
    HitChance = 100,
    MaxHitDistance = 350,
    ESP = true,
}
local lockGrace = 0.18

local Connections = {}
local function connect(signal, fn)
    local c = signal:Connect(fn)
    Connections[#Connections + 1] = c
    return c
end
local function getHumanoid(character)
    return character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or nil
end
local function isAlive(player)
    local humanoid = getHumanoid(player and player.Character)
    return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
end
local function getLocalDuel()
    if not DuelController or not DuelController.GetDuel then
        return nil
    end
    local ok, duel = pcall(DuelController.GetDuel, DuelController, LocalPlayer)
    return ok and duel or nil
end
local function isEnemy(player)
    if not player or player == LocalPlayer then
        return false
    end
    local duel = getLocalDuel()
    if not duel or not duel.GetDueler then
        return false
    end
    local okMine, myDueler = pcall(duel.GetDueler, duel, LocalPlayer)
    local okTheirs, theirDueler = pcall(duel.GetDueler, duel, player)
    if not okMine or not okTheirs or not myDueler or not theirDueler then
        return false
    end
    local myTeam
    local theirTeam
    if myDueler.Get then
        pcall(function()
            myTeam = myDueler:Get("TeamID")
        end)
    end
    if theirDueler.Get then
        pcall(function()
            theirTeam = theirDueler:Get("TeamID")
        end)
    end
    if myTeam ~= nil and theirTeam ~= nil then
        return myTeam ~= theirTeam
    end
    return true
end
local RayParams = RaycastParams.new()
RayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
RayParams.IgnoreWater = true
local function updateRayFilter()
    local list = {}
    if LocalPlayer.Character then
        table.insert(list, LocalPlayer.Character)
    end
    RayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = list
end
updateRayFilter()
connect(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded, function()
    task.defer(updateRayFilter)
end)
local function rawVisibleFrom(origin, character, part)
    if not (origin and character and part) then
        return false
    end
    local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, part.Position - origin, RayParams)
    return not result or result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(character)
end
local function visibleFrom(origin, character, part)
    if not State.WallCheck then
        return true
    end
    return rawVisibleFrom(origin, character, part)
end
local SmartParts = {
    "Head",
    "UpperTorso",
    "LowerTorso",
    "HumanoidRootPart",
    "LeftUpperArm",
    "RightUpperArm",
    "LeftUpperLeg",
    "RightUpperLeg",
}
local CurrentTargetPlayer
local CurrentTargetPart
local CurrentTargetLostAt = 0
local function targetParts(character)
    if State.AimPart ~= "Smart" then
        local part = character and character:FindFirstChild(State.AimPart)
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
        print("Join Discord https://discord.gg/axonic")
            return {part}
        end
        return {}
    end
    local parts = {}
    for _, name in ipairs(SmartParts) do
        local part = character and character:FindFirstChild(name)
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
            table.insert(parts, part)
        end
    end
    return parts
end
local function getPartMetrics(part)
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not Camera or not part then
        return nil
    end
    local screen, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
    if not onScreen or screen.Z <= 0 then
        return nil
    end
    local viewport = Camera.ViewportSize
    local center = Vector2.new(viewport.X * 0.5, viewport.Y * 0.5)
    local screenDistance = (Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y) - center).Magnitude
    local worldDistance = (part.Position - Camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
    return screenDistance, worldDistance
end
local function bestPartForPlayer(player)
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then
        return nil
    end
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not Camera then
        return nil
    end
    local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local bestPart
    local bestPartScore = math.huge
    local bestScreenDistance
    local bestWorldDistance
    for _, part in ipairs(targetParts(character)) do
        local screenDistance, worldDistance = getPartMetrics(part)
        if screenDistance
            and worldDistance <= State.MaxHitDistance
            and screenDistance <= State.FOV
            and visibleFrom(origin, character, part) then
            local priorityPenalty = 0
            if State.AimPart == "Smart" then
                if part.Name == "Head" then
                    priorityPenalty = 0
                elseif part.Name == "UpperTorso" then
                    priorityPenalty = 1.5
                elseif part.Name == "LowerTorso" or part.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then
                    priorityPenalty = 3
                else
                    priorityPenalty = 6
                end
            end
            local partScore = screenDistance + priorityPenalty
            if partScore < bestPartScore then
                bestPartScore = partScore
                bestPart = part
                bestScreenDistance = screenDistance
                bestWorldDistance = worldDistance
            end
        end
    end
    return bestPart, bestScreenDistance, bestWorldDistance
end
local function findBestTarget()
    local bestPlayer
    local bestPart
    local bestScore = math.huge
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if isEnemy(player) and isAlive(player) then
            local part, screenDistance, worldDistance = bestPartForPlayer(player)
            if part then
                local score = screenDistance + worldDistance * 0.035
                if score < bestScore then
                    bestScore = score
                    bestPlayer = player
                    bestPart = part
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return bestPlayer, bestPart
end
local function lockedTargetStillValid()
    local player = CurrentTargetPlayer
    local part = CurrentTargetPart
    if not State.StickyTarget or not player or not part then
        return false
    end
    if not player.Parent or not part.Parent or not isEnemy(player) or not isAlive(player) then
        return false
    end
    local screenDistance, worldDistance = getPartMetrics(part)
    if not screenDistance then
        return false
    end
    if worldDistance > State.MaxHitDistance or screenDistance > State.FOV * 1.20 then
        return false
    end
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if State.WallCheck and (not Camera or not visibleFrom(Camera.CFrame.Position, player.Character, part)) then
        return false
    end
    return true
end
local function acquireTarget(forceFresh)
    local now = os.clock()
    if lockedTargetStillValid() then
        CurrentTargetLostAt = 0
        return CurrentTargetPlayer, CurrentTargetPart
    end
    if (not forceFresh) and CurrentTargetPlayer and State.StickyTarget and lockGrace > 0 then
        if CurrentTargetLostAt == 0 then
            CurrentTargetLostAt = now
            return nil, nil
        end
        if now - CurrentTargetLostAt < lockGrace then
            return nil, nil
        end
    end
    local player, part = findBestTarget()
    CurrentTargetPlayer = player
    CurrentTargetPart = part
    CurrentTargetLostAt = 0
    return player, part
end
local FOVCircle
pcall(function()
    if Drawing and Drawing.new then
        FOVCircle = Drawing.new("Circle")
        FOVCircle.Filled = false
        FOVCircle.Thickness = 1
        FOVCircle.NumSides = 80
        FOVCircle.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        FOVCircle.Transparency = 0.85
    end
end)
local OriginalGunStartShooting = Gun.StartShooting
local ShotOffset = Utility:EncodeCFrame(CFrame.new(0.43, 0.25, 0.42))
local ShotKey0 = utf8.char(0)
local ShotKey1 = utf8.char(1)
local ShotKey2 = utf8.char(2)
local ShotKey3 = utf8.char(3)
local function buildShotPayload(origin, target, part)
    local aimCFrame = Utility:EncodeCFrame(CFrame.new(origin, target))
    return {
        [ShotKey0] = aimCFrame,
        [ShotKey1] = aimCFrame,
        [ShotKey2] = part,
        [ShotKey3] = ShotOffset,
    }
end
local function writeShotPayload(cameraData, payload)
    if type(cameraData) ~= "table" then
        return payload
    end
    cameraData[ShotKey0] = payload[ShotKey0]
    cameraData[ShotKey1] = payload[ShotKey1]
    cameraData[ShotKey2] = payload[ShotKey2]
    cameraData[ShotKey3] = payload[ShotKey3]
    return cameraData
end
Gun.StartShooting = function(self, ...)
    local results = table.pack(OriginalGunStartShooting(self, ...))
    if not self or not self.ClientFighter or not self.ClientFighter.IsLocalPlayer then
        return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
    end
    if results[1] ~= true or results[2] ~= "StartShooting" then
        return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
    end
    if not State.SilentAim or math.random(1, 100) > State.HitChance then
        return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
    end

    local targetPlayer, part = acquireTarget(true)
    if not targetPlayer or not part or not part.Parent then
        return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
    end
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then
        return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
    end

    results[3] = writeShotPayload(results[3], buildShotPayload(root.Position, part.Position, part))
    return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
end
local ESPFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
ESPFolder.Name = "_AxonicRivalsESP"
ESPFolder.Parent = Workspace
local ESPObjects = {}

local function removeESP(player)
    local entry = ESPObjects[player]
    if not entry then return end
    if entry.Highlight then entry.Highlight:Destroy() end
    if entry.Gui then entry.Gui:Destroy() end
    ESPObjects[player] = nil
end

local function enemyWeaponName(player)
    if not FighterController or not FighterController.GetFighter then return end
    local ok, fighter = pcall(FighterController.GetFighter, FighterController, player)
    if ok and fighter and fighter.EquippedItem then
        return fighter.EquippedItem.Name
    end
end

local function updateESP()
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer then
            local character = player.Character
            local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if not State.ESP or not isEnemy(player) or not isAlive(player) or not head then
                removeESP(player)
            else
                local entry = ESPObjects[player]
                if entry and entry.Character ~= character then
                    removeESP(player)
                    entry = nil
                end
                if not entry then
                    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
                    highlight.Name = "AxonicESP"
                    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                    highlight.FillTransparency = 0.72
                    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
                    highlight.Adornee = character
                    highlight.Parent = ESPFolder

                    local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                    gui.Name = "AxonicName"
                    gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 52)
                    gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0)
                    gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
                    gui.Adornee = head
                    gui.Parent = ESPFolder

                    local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                    text.Name = "Text"
                    text.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                    text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    text.TextSize = 14
                    text.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
                    text.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.45
                    text.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                    text.TextWrapped = true
                    text.Parent = gui
                    entry = {Character = character, Highlight = highlight, Gui = gui, Label = text}
                    ESPObjects[player] = entry
                end

                local lines = {player.DisplayName}
                local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if root and myRoot then
                    lines[1] = lines[1] .. "  |  " .. math.floor((root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude + .5) .. "m"
                end
                local humanoid = getHumanoid(character)
                local details = {}
                if humanoid then details[#details + 1] = "HP " .. math.floor(humanoid.Health + .5) end
                local weapon = enemyWeaponName(player)
                if weapon then details[#details + 1] = weapon end
                if #details > 0 then lines[#lines + 1] = table.concat(details, "  |  ") end
                entry.Label.Text = table.concat(lines, "\n")
            end
        end
    end
    for player in pairs(ESPObjects) do
        if not player.Parent then removeESP(player) end
    end
end
connect(Players.PlayerRemoving, removeESP)

local discordGui
local lastViewport

local function makeDiscordPopup()
    local parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    local previous = parent:FindFirstChild("AxonicRivalsInvite")
    if previous then previous:Destroy() end

    local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name = "AxonicRivalsInvite"
    gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.DisplayOrder = 100
    gui.Parent = parent
    discordGui = gui

    local theme = {
        Window = Color3.fromRGB(13, 13, 15),
        Header = Color3.fromRGB(17, 17, 20),
        Card = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 24),
        Button = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 26),
        Hover = Color3.fromRGB(29, 30, 35),
        Border = Color3.fromRGB(40, 41, 47),
        BorderBright = Color3.fromRGB(64, 66, 75),
        Text = Color3.fromRGB(242, 243, 246),
        Muted = Color3.fromRGB(156, 158, 167),
        Faint = Color3.fromRGB(98, 100, 109),
    }

    local function make(class, props, parentObj)
        local instance = Instance.new(class)
        for key, value in pairs(props) do instance[key] = value end
        instance.Parent = parentObj
        return instance
    end

    local function round(obj, amount)
        make("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, amount)}, obj)
    end

    local function outline(obj, color, transparency)
        make("UIStroke", {
            Color = color, Transparency = transparency or 0, Thickness = 1,
        }, obj)
    end

    local function label(obj, value, x, y, w, h, size, color, font)
        return make("TextLabel", {
            Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = value,
            TextColor3 = color,
            TextSize = size,
            Font = font or Enum.Font.Gotham,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
        }, obj)
    end

    local width, height = 360, 240
    local panel = make("Frame", {
        Name = "Window",
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5),
        Position = UDim2.fromScale(.5, .5),
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height),
        BackgroundColor3 = theme.Window,
        ClipsDescendants = true,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, gui)
    round(panel, 7)
    outline(panel, theme.BorderBright, .34)
    local scale = make("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, panel)

    local header = make("Frame", {
        Name = "Header",
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 49),
        BackgroundColor3 = theme.Header,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, panel)
    round(header, 7)
    make("Frame", {
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 7),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -7),
        BackgroundColor3 = theme.Header,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, header)
    make("Frame", {
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -1),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
        BackgroundColor3 = theme.Border,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, header)

    label(header, "Axonic", 15, 6, 220, 20, 15, theme.Text, Enum.Font.GothamBold)
    label(header, "RIVALS  /  Open Source", 15, 26, 225, 13, 10, theme.Muted)

    local dragHandle = make("TextButton", {
        Name = "DragHandle",
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 1, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = "",
        Active = true,
        AutoButtonColor = false,
        ZIndex = 2,
    }, header)

    local close = make("TextButton", {
        Name = "Close",
        Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 11),
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(27, 27),
        BackgroundColor3 = theme.Button,
        Text = "×",
        TextSize = 15,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
        TextColor3 = theme.Muted,
        AutoButtonColor = false,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ZIndex = 3,
    }, header)
    round(close, 3)
    outline(close, theme.Border, .3)
    close.MouseEnter:Connect(function() close.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Hover end)
    close.MouseLeave:Connect(function() close.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Button end)
    close.Activated:Connect(function() gui:Destroy() end)

    local dragging = false
    local dragStart, startPosition, touchInput
    dragHandle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        local kind = input.UserInputType
        if kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPosition = panel.Position
        touchInput = kind == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input or nil
    end)

    connect(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
        if not dragging or not panel.Parent then return end
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input ~= touchInput then return end
        local viewport = Workspace.CurrentCamera and Workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
        if not viewport then return end
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        local halfWidth = panel.AbsoluteSize.X * .5
        local halfHeight = panel.AbsoluteSize.Y * .5
        local centerX = viewport.X * startPosition.X.Scale + startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X
        local centerY = viewport.Y * startPosition.Y.Scale + startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        panel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
            math.clamp(centerX, math.min(halfWidth + 8, viewport.X * .5), math.max(viewport.X - halfWidth - 8, viewport.X * .5)),
            math.clamp(centerY, math.min(halfHeight + 8, viewport.Y * .5), math.max(viewport.Y - halfHeight - 8, viewport.Y * .5))
        )
    end)
    connect(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input == touchInput then
            dragging = false
            touchInput = nil
        end
    end)

    label(panel, "OPEN-SOURCE SCRIPTS", 15, 59, 220, 14, 10, theme.Faint, Enum.Font.GothamBold)

    for index, name in ipairs({"Blox Fruits", "Murder Mystery 2", "RIVALS"}) do
        local row = make("Frame", {
            Name = "Game" .. index,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 79 + (index - 1) * 33),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 29),
            BackgroundColor3 = theme.Card,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
        }, panel)
        round(row, 3)
        outline(row, theme.Border, .27)
        label(row, name, 13, 0, 285, 29, 12, theme.Text, Enum.Font.GothamMedium)
    end

    label(panel, "discord.gg/axonic", 15, 184, 180, 13, 10, theme.Muted)

    local copyButton = make("TextButton", {
        Name = "CopyDiscordInvite",
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 204),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 28),
        BackgroundColor3 = theme.Button,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Text = "COPY DISCORD LINK (CLICK)",
        TextSize = 11,
        TextColor3 = theme.Text,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
        AutoButtonColor = false,
    }, panel)
    round(copyButton, 4)
    outline(copyButton, theme.BorderBright, .3)
    copyButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function() copyButton.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Hover end)
    copyButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function() copyButton.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Button end)
    copyButton.Activated:Connect(function()
        local clipboard = setclipboard or toclipboard
        local copied = type(clipboard) == "function" and pcall(clipboard, "https://discord.gg/axonic")
        copyButton.Text = copied and "COPIED" or "discord.gg/axonic"
    end)

    local lastViewport
    local function fit()
        local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        local viewport = camera and camera.ViewportSize
        if not viewport or viewport == lastViewport then return end
        lastViewport = viewport
        scale.Scale = math.clamp(math.min((viewport.X - 24) / width, (viewport.Y - 24) / height), .6, 1)
    end
    fit()
    connect(RunService.RenderStepped, function()
        if gui.Parent then fit() end
    end)
end

pcall(makeDiscordPopup)
local tickAccumulator = 0
local espAccumulator = 0
connect(RunService.RenderStepped, function(dt)
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if FOVCircle then
        local viewport = Camera and Camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.zero
        FOVCircle.Position = Vector2.new(viewport.X * .5, viewport.Y * .5)
        FOVCircle.Radius = State.FOV
        FOVCircle.Visible = State.SilentAim and State.ShowFOV
    end
    tickAccumulator += dt
    if tickAccumulator >= .016 then
        tickAccumulator = 0
        if State.SilentAim then acquireTarget() end
    end
    espAccumulator += dt
    if espAccumulator >= .15 then
        espAccumulator = 0
        pcall(updateESP)
    end
end)

env.AxonicRivalsCleanup = function()
    State.SilentAim = false
    if Gun.StartShooting ~= OriginalGunStartShooting then
        Gun.StartShooting = OriginalGunStartShooting
    end
    for _, c in ipairs(Connections) do
        pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
    end
    table.clear(Connections)
    if FOVCircle then pcall(function() FOVCircle:Remove() end) end
    for player in pairs(ESPObjects) do removeESP(player) end
    if ESPFolder then ESPFolder:Destroy() end
    if discordGui then discordGui:Destroy() end
    env.AxonicRivalsCleanup = nil
end

scripts.title: KNOWN GRAFICS
scripts.author: Kaiashell
scripts.summary: For enhancing your experience quility
scripts.code:
--// Known GFX v10 (client-side) //--
-- Black rectangular panel with RGB accents and tabs: SKY / TIME / SOUND / STYLE / CONTACT.
-- Only YOU see these changes.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RS = game:GetService("RunService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local lp = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Birds / nature ambience asset ID (numbers only). Only the sound NAME is shown in the SOUND tab.
local AMBIENT_SOUND_ID = "9119383684"

-- Paste your uploaded Roblox decal IDs (numbers only). Leave "" to use the default look.
local FRAME_ID = ""   -- the rectangle galaxy frame, shown on the loading screen
local CIRCLE_ID = ""  -- the purple round image, used as the open / close button

----------------------------------------------------------------- cleanup of an older run
local pg = lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
for _, n in ipairs({ "GraphicsPlus", "GP_Vignette" }) do
	local o = pg:FindFirstChild(n)
	if o then o:Destroy() end
end
for _, n in ipairs({ "GP_Bloom", "GP_Color", "GP_Rays", "GP_DoF" }) do
	local o = Lighting:FindFirstChild(n)
	if o then o:Destroy() end
end
local oldSnd = SoundService:FindFirstChild("GP_Ambient")
if oldSnd then oldSnd:Destroy() end

-- remember the game's own lighting so Reset can restore it
if Lighting:GetAttribute("GP_OB") == nil then
	Lighting:SetAttribute("GP_OB", Lighting.Brightness)
	Lighting:SetAttribute("GP_OE", Lighting.ExposureCompensation)
end
local origB = Lighting:GetAttribute("GP_OB")
local origE = Lighting:GetAttribute("GP_OE")

----------------------------------------------------------------- effects
local bloom = Instance.new("BloomEffect")
bloom.Name = "GP_Bloom"; bloom.Intensity = 0; bloom.Size = 28; bloom.Threshold = 0.95; bloom.Enabled = false; bloom.Parent = Lighting
local color = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
color.Name = "GP_Color"; color.Parent = Lighting
local rays = Instance.new("SunRaysEffect")
rays.Name = "GP_Rays"; rays.Intensity = 0; rays.Spread = 0.6; rays.Parent = Lighting
local dof = Instance.new("DepthOfFieldEffect")
dof.Name = "GP_DoF"; dof.FarIntensity = 0; dof.NearIntensity = 0; dof.FocusDistance = 45; dof.InFocusRadius = 35; dof.Enabled = false; dof.Parent = Lighting
local vigGrads = {}
local dimFull = nil
local BST = { shadows = false, fx = false }
local fxSaved = {}

----------------------------------------------------------------- sky / atmosphere / clouds
-- read what the game already has (objects are only created when you use them)
local Terrain = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
local exSky = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky")
local exAtmo = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
local exClouds = Terrain and Terrain:FindFirstChildOfClass("Clouds")
-- the game's own realism settings (restored on Reset / close)
local OR = {
	spec = Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale, diff = Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale, soft = Lighting.ShadowSoftness,
	gs = Lighting.GlobalShadows, water = Terrain and Terrain.WaterReflectance or 0,
	fov = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView or 70,
}
local SKY_KEYS = {
	stars = exSky and exSky.StarCount or 3000,
	moon = exSky and exSky.MoonAngularSize or 11,
	sun = exSky and exSky.SunAngularSize or 21,
	adens = exAtmo and exAtmo.Density or 0.395,
	aoff = exAtmo and exAtmo.Offset or 0,
	acol = exAtmo and exAtmo.Color or Color3.fromRGB(199, 170, 107),
	adec = exAtmo and exAtmo.Decay or Color3.fromRGB(92, 60, 13),
	haze = exAtmo and exAtmo.Haze or 0,
	glare = exAtmo and exAtmo.Glare or 0,
	cover = exClouds and exClouds.Cover or 0.5,
	cdens = exClouds and exClouds.Density or 0.7,
	ccol = exClouds and exClouds.Color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
}

local S = {
	bloom = 0, sat = 0, con = 0, rays = 0, bright = origB, exp = origE, tint = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
	lightOn = false, timeLock = false, time = Lighting.ClockTime,
	dim = 0, sound = true, vol = 0.5,
	skyOn = false,
	dof = 0, soft = OR.soft, spec = OR.spec, diff = OR.diff, water = OR.water, vig = 0, fov = OR.fov,
	rtOn = false, waterOn = false, fovOn = false,
}
for k, v in pairs(SKY_KEYS) do S[k] = v end

local skyObjs = nil
local function ensureSky()
	if skyObjs then return skyObjs end
	local o = { created = {}, orig = {} }
	local function get(parent, class, name, props)
		local inst = parent:FindFirstChildOfClass(class)
		if inst then
			local t = {}
			for _, pr in ipairs(props) do t[pr] = inst[pr] end
			o.orig[inst] = t
		else
			inst = Instance.new(class)
			inst.Name = name
			inst.Parent = parent
			table.insert(o.created, inst)
		end
		return inst
	end
	o.sky = get(Lighting, "Sky", "GP_Sky", { "StarCount", "MoonAngularSize", "SunAngularSize" })
	o.atmo = get(Lighting, "Atmosphere", "GP_Atmo", { "Density", "Offset", "Color", "Decay", "Glare", "Haze" })
	o.clouds = get(Terrain, "Clouds", "GP_Clouds", { "Cover", "Density", "Color" })
	skyObjs = o
	return o
end

local function applySky()
	local o = ensureSky()
	o.sky.StarCount = math.floor(S.stars)
	o.sky.MoonAngularSize = S.moon
	o.sky.SunAngularSize = S.sun
	o.atmo.Density = S.adens
	o.atmo.Offset = S.aoff
	o.atmo.Color = S.acol
	o.atmo.Decay = S.adec
	o.atmo.Haze = S.haze
	o.atmo.Glare = S.glare
	o.clouds.Cover = S.cover
	o.clouds.Density = S.cdens
	o.clouds.Color = S.ccol
end

local function restoreSkyObjs()
	if not skyObjs then return end
	for inst, t in pairs(skyObjs.orig) do
		if inst.Parent then
			for pr, v in pairs(t) do pcall(function() inst[pr] = v end) end
		end
	end
	for _, inst in ipairs(skyObjs.created) do inst:Destroy() end
	skyObjs = nil
end

local function resetSky()
	restoreSkyObjs()
	for k, v in pairs(SKY_KEYS) do S[k] = v end
	S.skyOn = false
end

local function apply()
	bloom.Intensity = S.bloom
	bloom.Enabled = S.bloom > 0.01
	color.Saturation = S.sat
	color.Contrast = S.con
	color.TintColor = S.tint
	rays.Intensity = S.rays
	if S.skyOn then pcall(applySky) end
	dof.FarIntensity = S.dof
	dof.Enabled = S.dof > 0.01
	for _, gr in ipairs(vigGrads) do gr.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1 - S.vig, 1) end
	if dimFull then dimFull.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(S.dim, 0, 1) * 0.85 end
	if BST.fx then bloom.Enabled = false; rays.Enabled = false; dof.Enabled = false end
	if S.rtOn then
		pcall(function()
			Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = S.spec
			Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = S.diff
			Lighting.ShadowSoftness = S.soft
			Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
		end)
	end
	if S.waterOn and Terrain then pcall(function() Terrain.WaterReflectance = S.water end) end
end

local function restoreRT()
	S.dof, S.soft, S.spec, S.diff, S.water, S.vig, S.fov = 0, OR.soft, OR.spec, OR.diff, OR.water, 0, OR.fov
	S.rtOn, S.waterOn, S.fovOn = false, false, false
	pcall(function()
		Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = OR.spec
		Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = OR.diff
		Lighting.ShadowSoftness = OR.soft
		Lighting.GlobalShadows = OR.gs
		if Terrain then Terrain.WaterReflectance = OR.water end
		local c = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if c then c.FieldOfView = OR.fov end
	end)
end

----------------------------------------------------------------- ambient sound
local snd = Instance.new("Sound")
snd.Name = "GP_Ambient"; snd.Looped = true; snd.Volume = 0; snd.Parent = SoundService

-- how loud the birds should be at a given game hour (silent at night)
local function dayFactor(t)
	if t < 5 or t >= 19 then return 0
	elseif t < 7 then return (t - 5) / 2
	elseif t < 11 then return 1
	elseif t < 17 then return 0.6
	else return 0.6 * (19 - t) / 2 end
end

----------------------------------------------------------------- UI basics
local C = {
	bg = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 15), bg2 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 12, 32), panel = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 26), field = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 40),
	btn = Color3.fromRGB(36, 36, 52), text = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 248), sub = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 172),
	red = Color3.fromRGB(200, 30, 60),
}
local rgb = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
local rgbObjs = {}
local spinners = {}
local function rgbify(inst, prop)
	if inst:IsA("UIStroke") then
		-- spinning red/black style RGB outline
		inst.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		local gr = Instance.new("UIGradient")
		gr.Color = ColorSequence.new(rgb)
		gr.Parent = inst
		table.insert(spinners, gr)
		return
	end
	table.insert(rgbObjs, { inst, prop })
	inst[prop] = rgb
end

local function new(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	if parent then o.Parent = parent end
	return o
end

local conns = {}
local function track(c) table.insert(conns, c) return c end

-- tap = one step, hold = keeps repeating
local function bindHold(btn, fn, interval)
	local held, repeated = nil, false
	btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
		local id = {}
		held, repeated = id, false
		task.delay(0.4, function()
			if held ~= id then return end
			repeated = true
			while held == id and btn.Parent do
				fn()
				task.wait(interval or 0.07)
			end
		end)
	end)
	btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if not repeated then fn() end
		held = nil
	end)
	btn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() held = nil end)
	btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() held = nil end)
	track(UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function() held = nil end))
end

local gui = new("ScreenGui", { Name = "GraphicsPlus", ResetOnSpawn = false, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling }, pg)
pcall(function() gui.ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.None end) -- notch / cutout areas bhi cover ho
local main = new("Frame", {
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(580, 410), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -290, 0.5, -205), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0,
	ClipsDescendants = true,
}, gui)
new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14) }, main)
new("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(C.bg2, C.bg) }, main)
rgbify(new("UIStroke", { Thickness = 2, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border }, main), "Color")

-- title bar
local bar = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, main)
local title = new("TextLabel", {
	Text = "KNOWN GFX", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 19, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, 0), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
}, bar)
rgbify(title, "TextColor3")
-- window lock (stops dragging)
local winLocked = false
local lockBtn2
local lockPill = new("TextButton", {
	Text = "LOCK", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = C.text, BackgroundColor3 = C.btn, BorderSizePixel = 0,
	AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 22), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(78, 26), AutoButtonColor = false,
}, bar)
new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 13) }, lockPill)
rgbify(new("UIStroke", { Thickness = 1.5, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border }, lockPill), "Color")
local function setLock(v)
	winLocked = v
	lockPill.Text = v and "LOCKED" or "LOCK"
	lockPill.BackgroundColor3 = v and C.red or C.btn
	if lockBtn2 then lockBtn2.Text = "LOCK WINDOW: " .. (v and "ON" or "OFF") end
end
lockPill.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setLock(not winLocked) end)

-- open / close with a small animation
local mainScale = new("UIScale", { Scale = 1 }, main)
local function toggleMain()
	if main.Visible then
		local t = TweenService:Create(mainScale, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Scale = 0.85 })
		t:Play()
		t.Completed:Connect(function()
			if mainScale.Scale <= 0.86 then main.Visible = false end
		end)
	else
		main.Visible = true
		TweenService:Create(mainScale, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
	end
end

-- circle open / close button (draggable)
local circle = new("TextButton", {
	Text = "KG", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = C.text, BackgroundColor3 = C.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0,
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 54), Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0.5, -27), AutoButtonColor = false,
}, gui)
new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 27) }, circle)
if CIRCLE_ID ~= "" then
	circle.Text = ""
	new("ImageLabel", {
		Image = "rbxassetid://" .. CIRCLE_ID, BackgroundTransparency = 1, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = circle.ZIndex + 1,
	}, circle)
end
rgbify(new("UIStroke", { Thickness = 2.5, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border }, circle), "Color")
do
	local down, startPos, startIn, moved
	circle.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
		if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			down, startPos, startIn, moved = true, circle.Position, i.Position, false
		end
	end)
	track(UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
		if down and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local d = i.Position - startIn
			if d.Magnitude > 6 then moved = true end
			if moved then
				circle.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
			end
		end
	end))
	track(UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
		if down and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			down = false
			if not moved then toggleMain() end
		end
	end))
end

-- sidebar (tabs)
new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 44), Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 82), BorderSizePixel = 0 }, main)
local rgbLine = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 43), Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 2), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0 }, main)
table.insert(spinners, new("UIGradient", {}, rgbLine))
local side = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 56), Size = UDim2.new(0, 124, 1, -70), BackgroundColor3 = C.panel, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, main)
new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12) }, side)
rgbify(new("UIStroke", { Thickness = 1.5, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border }, side), "Color")
local tabList = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -58), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, side)
new("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 4), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, tabList)
new("UIPadding", { PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10) }, tabList)

local pagesFrame = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 56), Size = UDim2.new(1, -206, 1, -70), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, main)

local pages, tabBtns = {}, {}
local activeTab = nil

local function makePage(name)
	local f = new("ScrollingFrame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = C.panel, BorderSizePixel = 0, ScrollBarThickness = 5, ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y, ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0,
		CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Visible = false,
	}, pagesFrame)
	rgbify(f, "ScrollBarImageColor3")
	new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10) }, f)
	rgbify(new("UIStroke", { Thickness = 1.5, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border }, f), "Color")
	new("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 10), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, f)
	new("UIPadding", { PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 12), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 12), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 16), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 12) }, f)
	pages[name] = f
	return f
end

local function selectTab(name)
	activeTab = name
	for n, p in pairs(pages) do p.Visible = (n == name) end
	for n, b in pairs(tabBtns) do
		b.BackgroundColor3 = (n == name) and C.field or C.btn
		if n ~= name then b.TextColor3 = C.sub end
	end
end

for i, name in ipairs({ "GRAPHICS", "REALISTIC", "SKY", "TIME", "FPS", "SOUND", "STYLE", "CONTACT" }) do
	makePage(name)
	if name ~= "GRAPHICS" then
		local b = new("TextButton", {
			Text = name, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = C.sub, BackgroundColor3 = C.btn, BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), AutoButtonColor = false, LayoutOrder = i,
		}, tabList)
		tabBtns[name] = b
		new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) }, b)
		b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() selectTab(name) end)
	end
end

local resetAll = new("TextButton", {
	Text = "RESET ALL", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = C.text, BackgroundColor3 = C.red, BorderSizePixel = 0,
	Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -48), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 38), AutoButtonColor = false,
}, side)

----------------------------------------------------------------- UI helpers (per page)
local function nextOrder(page)
	local n = (page:GetAttribute("o") or 0) + 1
	page:SetAttribute("o", n)
	return n
end

local function header(page, text)
	local l = new("TextLabel", {
		Text = text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 13, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, LayoutOrder = nextOrder(page),
	}, page)
	rgbify(l, "TextColor3")
end

local function button(parent, text, layoutOrder)
	local b = new("TextButton", {
		Text = text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = C.text, BackgroundColor3 = C.btn, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		AutoButtonColor = false, LayoutOrder = layoutOrder or 0,
	}, parent)
	rgbify(new("UIStroke", { Thickness = 1.5, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border }, b), "Color")
	new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) }, b)
	return b
end

local function fullButton(page, text)
	local b = button(page, text, nextOrder(page))
	b.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38)
	return b
end

local function grid(page)
	local g = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = nextOrder(page) }, page)
	new("UIGridLayout", { CellSize = UDim2.new(0.5, -5, 0, 38), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, g)
	return g
end

local sliders = {}
local function slider(page, key, label, min, max, onChange)
	local row = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 66), BackgroundColor3 = C.field, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = nextOrder(page) }, page)
	new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) }, row)
	rgbify(new("UIStroke", { Thickness = 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border }, row), "Color")
	local lbl = new("TextLabel", {
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = C.text, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 7), Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 18), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
	}, row)
	local valLbl = new("TextLabel", {
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 13, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 7), Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 18), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
	}, row)
	rgbify(valLbl, "TextColor3")

	-- [-] and [+] buttons (tap = small step, hold = keep going)
	local minus = button(row, "-", 0)
	minus.TextSize = 18
	minus.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32)
	minus.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 28)
	minus:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner").CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	local plus = button(row, "+", 0)
	plus.TextSize = 18
	plus.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32)
	plus.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	plus.Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 28)
	plus:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner").CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

	local trk = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new(0, 54, 0, 40), Size = UDim2.new(1, -108, 0, 8), BackgroundColor3 = C.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, row)
	new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, trk)
	local fill = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), BorderSizePixel = 0 }, trk)
	new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, fill)
	rgbify(fill, "BackgroundColor3")
	local knob = new("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2,
	}, trk)
	new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, knob)
	rgbify(new("UIStroke", { Thickness = 2, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border }, knob), "Color")
	-- touch area over the track (does not block scrolling)
	local hit = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0, 48, 0, 26), Size = UDim2.new(1, -96, 0, 36) }, row)

	local fmt = max >= 10 and "%.0f" or "%.2f"
	local function refresh()
		local a = math.clamp((S[key] - min) / (max - min), 0, 1)
		fill.Size = UDim2.new(a, 0, 1, 0)
		knob.Position = UDim2.new(a, 0, 0.5, 0)
		lbl.Text = label
		valLbl.Text = string.format(fmt, S[key])
	end
	sliders[key] = refresh
	refresh()

	local function commit()
		refresh()
		if onChange then onChange() end
		apply()
	end
	local function setFromX(x)
		local a = math.clamp((x - trk.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(trk.AbsoluteSize.X, 1), 0, 1)
		S[key] = min + (max - min) * a
		commit()
	end
	local stepSize = (max - min) / 40
	local function nudge(dir)
		S[key] = math.clamp(S[key] + dir * stepSize, min, max)
		commit()
	end
	bindHold(minus, function() nudge(-1) end)
	bindHold(plus, function() nudge(1) end)

	-- gesture: horizontal drag = change value, vertical drag = scroll the page, tap = jump to that spot
	local state, startPos = nil, nil
	hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
		if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			state, startPos = "pending", i.Position
		end
	end)
	track(UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
		if not state then return end
		if i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
		if state == "pending" then
			local d = i.Position - startPos
			if math.abs(d.X) > 8 and math.abs(d.X) > math.abs(d.Y) * 1.2 then
				state = "drag"
				page.ScrollingEnabled = false
				setFromX(i.Position.X)
			elseif math.abs(d.Y) > 10 then
				state = nil -- it's a scroll, leave the value alone
			end
		elseif state == "drag" then
			setFromX(i.Position.X)
		end
	end))
	track(UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
		if not state then return end
		if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			if state == "pending" then setFromX(i.Position.X) end
			state = nil
			page.ScrollingEnabled = true
		end
	end))
end

local function refreshAll() for _, f in pairs(sliders) do f() end end

	local p = activeTab and pages[activeTab]
	if not p then return end
	local maxY = math.max(0, p.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y - p.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y)
	p.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.clamp(p.CanvasPosition.Y + dy, 0, maxY))
end

}
local origs = {}
local function keyOf(col)
	for k, v in pairs(C0) do
		if v == col then return k end
	end

local mainGrad = main:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
local function applyTheme(name)
	local P = PAL[name]
	for k, v in pairs(P) do C[k] = v end
	local glass = (name == "Transparent")
	for _, d in ipairs(main:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("GuiObject") then
			local o = origs[d]
			if not o then
				o = {
					bg = d.BackgroundColor3, bt = d.BackgroundTransparency,
					tc = (d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") or d:IsA("TextBox")) and d.TextColor3 or nil,
				}
				origs[d] = o
			end
			local kb = keyOf(o.bg)
			if kb then d.BackgroundColor3 = P[kb] end
			if o.bt < 1 then d.BackgroundTransparency = glass and math.clamp(o.bt + 0.55, 0, 0.9) or o.bt end
			if o.tc then
				local kt = keyOf(o.tc)
				if kt then d.TextColor3 = P[kt] end
			end
		end
	end
	if mainGrad then
		mainGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(P.bg2, P.bg)
		mainGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(glass and 0.6 or 0)
	end
	lockPill.BackgroundColor3 = winLocked and C.red or C.btn
	lockPill.TextColor3 = C.text
end

local acc, frames = 0, 0
RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	acc = acc + dt
	frames = frames + 1
	if acc >= 0.25 then
		local f = math.floor(frames / acc + 0.5)
		table.remove(hist, 1)
		table.insert(hist, f)
		local mn, mx, sum, cnt = math.huge, 0, 0, 0
		for _, v in ipairs(hist) do
			if v > 0 then mn = math.min(mn, v); mx = math.max(mx, v); sum = sum + v; cnt = cnt + 1 end
		end
		if cnt == 0 then mn = 0 end
		local avg = cnt > 0 and math.floor(sum / cnt + 0.5) or 0
		fpsNum.Text = f .. " FPS"
		fpsNum.TextColor3 = colFor(f)
		fpsStat.Text = "MIN " .. mn .. "   AVG " .. avg .. "   MAX " .. mx .. "   " .. string.format("%.1f", 1000 / math.max(f, 1)) .. " ms"
		for i, b in ipairs(bars) do
			b.Size = UDim2.new(1 / N, -2, 0, math.max(2, math.clamp(hist[i] / 144, 0, 1) * 26))
			b.BackgroundColor3 = colFor(hist[i])
		end
		acc, frames = 0, 0
	end
end)

-- lighting / sky / sound
local cur = 0
local skyT = 0
track(RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	skyT += dt
	if S.skyOn and skyT > 1 then
		skyT = 0
		pcall(applySky)
	end
	if S.lightOn then
		Lighting.Brightness = S.bright
		Lighting.ExposureCompensation = S.exp
	end
	if S.timeLock then Lighting.ClockTime = S.time end
	if S.fovOn then pcall(function() workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = S.fov end) end

	local factor = curFade and dayFactor(Lighting.ClockTime) or 1
	local target = (S.sound and curIdx > 0) and factor * S.vol or 0
	cur = cur + (target - cur) * math.min(1, dt * 0.8)
	snd.Volume = cur

local fixedSpamTexts = {
    "NOVA HYPER VOID WORM VOID WAVE POWER FUN FACT VOID WORM",
    "HYPER DARK POWER VOID WORM HYPER GODZILLA SPELL WAVE FRAUD",
    "FUN FACT DARK POWER VOID WORM NOVA POWER WAVE",
    "HYPER POWER POWER FACT VOID WORM HYPER GODZILLA SPELL"
}

local safeEmojiList = {"🔥", "⚡", "⭐", "💎", "👑", "🚀", "💥"}

local bigAtPattern = "[" .. string.rep("@", 120) .. "]"
local slashPattern = [==[[///==//\\\==\\\///==\\\\\\==\\\///==//\\\==\\\///==//\\\==\\\///==//\\\==\\\///==//\\\==\\\///==//\\\==\\\///==//\\\==\\\///==//\\\==\\\///==//\\\==\\\///==//\\\==\\\///==//\\\==\\\///==//\\\==\\\///==//\\\==\\\///==//\\\==\\\\\\==\\\///==//\\\==\\\///==//\\\==\\\///==//\\\==\\\///==//\\\==\\\\\\==\\\///==//\\\==\\\///==//\\\==\\\///==//\\\==\\\///==//]]==]
local newCustomPattern = [==[[+++---+++//===//===\\\\-+++---+++//===//===\\\\+++---+++//===//===\\\\+++---+++//===//===\\\\+++---+++//===//===\\\\+++---+++//===//===\\\\+++---+++//===//===\\\\+++---+++//===//===\\\\+++---+++//===//===\\\]]==]

local function buildSafeMessage(pat, target, fixedText, emoji)
    local suffix = " [ " .. target .. " ] " .. fixedText .. emoji
    local suffix_len = utf8.len(suffix) or #suffix
    local max_pat_len = 195 - suffix_len
    if max_pat_len < 10 then max_pat_len = 10 end
    
    local safe_pat = truncate_chars(pat, max_pat_len)
    return safe_pat .. suffix
end

local isSpamming = false
local textIndex = 1
local targetIndex = 1
local counter = 0

local function startSpamLoop()
    task.spawn(function()
        while isSpamming do
            pcall(function()
                if not useAtPattern and not useSlashPattern and not useNewPattern then
                    task.wait(0.5)
                    return
                end

                local delay = tonumber(RuntimeDelayBox.Text) or 0.8
                if delay < 0.1 then delay = 0.1 end

                local activeTargets = {}
                for _, box in ipairs(targetInputBoxes) do
                    if box.Text ~= "" then table.insert(activeTargets, box.Text) end
                end
                if #activeTargets == 0 then activeTargets = {"TARGET"} end

                if targetIndex > #activeTargets then targetIndex = 1 end
                local currentTarget = activeTargets[targetIndex]
                
                counter = counter + 1
                NumLabel.Text = tostring(counter)

                local extraEmoji = ""
                if emojiOn then
                    extraEmoji = " " .. safeEmojiList[math.random(1, #safeEmojiList)]
                end
                
                local currentFixedText = fixedSpamTexts[textIndex]

                if useAtPattern then
                    sendMessage(buildSafeMessage(bigAtPattern, currentTarget, currentFixedText, extraEmoji))
                elseif useSlashPattern then
                    sendMessage(buildSafeMessage(slashPattern, currentTarget, currentFixedText, extraEmoji))
                elseif useNewPattern then
                    sendMessage(buildSafeMessage(newCustomPattern, currentTarget, currentFixedText, extraEmoji))
                end

                textIndex = textIndex + 1
                if textIndex > #fixedSpamTexts then textIndex = 1 end
                
                targetIndex = targetIndex + 1
                if targetIndex > #activeTargets then targetIndex = 1 end
                
                task.wait(delay)
            end)
        end
    end)
end

ToggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isSpamming = not isSpamming
    if isSpamming then
        ToggleButton.Text = "TERMINATE SYSTEM"
        ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 30, 30)
        startSpamLoop()
    else
        ToggleButton.Text = "START ꜱᴏɴɪᴄ SPAMMER"
        ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 30, 30)
    end
end)

local language = "en"
local function T(key, ...)
    local pack = TEXT[language] or TEXT.en
    local value = pack[key] or TEXT.en[key] or key
    if select("#", ...) > 0 then
        local ok, formatted = pcall(string.format, value, ...)
        if ok then
            return formatted
        end
    end
    return value
end

local function notify(content, duration)
    Rayfield:Notify({
        Title = "REX SoundService",
        Content = content,
        Duration = duration or 4,
        Image = 4483362458
    })
end
