-- Read the live SoundService property exposed to the client.
-- Return only a real boolean; never convert a failed read into true/false.
local function getFilteringState()
    local ok, value = pcall(function()
        return SoundService.RespectFilteringEnabled
    end)

    if not ok or typeof(value) ~= "boolean" then
        return nil
    end

    return value
end

initializeInterface = function()
        local SoundTab = Window:CreateTab(T("browser"), 4483362458)
        local PlaybackTab = Window:CreateTab(T("playback"), 4483362458)
        local StatusTab = Window:CreateTab(T("status"), 4483362458)

        local state = {
            sounds = {},
            soundByOption = {},
            selected = {},
            selectedList = {},
            dropdownOptions = {},
            mode = "CLIENT",
            playbackKind = "ALL",
            loopEnabled = false,
            isPlaying = false,
            playbackToken = 0,
            activeClones = {},
            activeOriginals = {},
            originalLoopValues = {},
            scanning = false,
            scanToken = 0
        }

        local StatusLabel
        local SelectionLabel
        local CountLabel
        local SoundDropdown
        local StatusCurrentLabel
        local StatusModeLabel

        local function updateSelectionDisplay()
            local selectedList = {}
            for sound in pairs(state.selected) do
                if sound and sound.Parent and sound:IsA("Sound") then
                    table.insert(selectedList, sound)
                end
            end
            table.sort(selectedList, function(a, b)
                return a:GetFullName():lower() < b:GetFullName():lower()
            end)
            state.selectedList = selectedList

            local count = #selectedList
            local typeText = count == 0 and T("none") or (count == 1 and T("one") or T("various"))
            if SelectionLabel then
                pcall(function()
                    SelectionLabel:Set(T("selection") .. ": " .. typeText)
                end)
            end
            if CountLabel then
                pcall(function()
                    CountLabel:Set(T("selectedCount", count))
                end)
            end
        end

        local function setStatus(message)
            if StatusLabel then
                pcall(function()
                    StatusLabel:Set(message)
                end)
            end
        end

        local function updateModeStatus()
            local filtering = getFilteringState()
            local filteringText = filtering == true and T("filteringTrue")
                or filtering == false and T("filteringFalse")
                or T("filteringUnknown")
            if StatusCurrentLabel then
                pcall(function() StatusCurrentLabel:Set(T("filteringStatus", filteringText)) end)
            end
            if StatusModeLabel then
                local modeText = state.mode == "SERVER" and T("server") or T("client")
                pcall(function() StatusModeLabel:Set(T("currentMode", modeText)) end)
            end
        end

        local function clearSelection()
            table.clear(state.selected)
            table.clear(state.selectedList)
            if SoundDropdown then
                pcall(function()
                    SoundDropdown:Set({})
                end)
            end
            updateSelectionDisplay()
        end

        SoundTab:CreateSection(T("sounds"))
        SoundTab:CreateLabel(T("tabInfo"))
        SelectionLabel = SoundTab:CreateLabel(T("selection") .. ": " .. T("none"))
        CountLabel = SoundTab:CreateLabel(T("selectedCount", 0))

        SoundDropdown = SoundTab:CreateDropdown({
            Name = T("sounds"),
            Options = {},
            CurrentOption = {},
            MultipleOptions = true,
            Flag = "REX_SoundSelection",
            Callback = function(options)
                local chosen = {}
                if type(options) == "table" then
                    for _, option in ipairs(options) do
                        local sound = state.soundByOption[option]
                        if sound and sound.Parent then
                            chosen[sound] = true
                        end
                    end
                end
                state.selected = chosen
                updateSelectionDisplay()
            end
        })

        SoundTab:CreateButton({
            Name = T("clear"),
            Callback = clearSelection
        })

        SoundTab:CreateButton({
            Name = T("scan"),
            Callback = function()
                -- The scan function is assigned below before the user can press this.
                if state.scanFunction then
                    state.scanFunction()
                end
            end
        })

        SoundTab:CreateButton({
            Name = T("copy"),
            Callback = function()
                updateSelectionDisplay()
                local sound = state.selectedList[1]
                if not sound then
                    notify(T("nothingSelected"), 3)
                    return
                end
                local lines = {}
                for _, selectedSound in ipairs(state.selectedList) do
                    table.insert(lines, string.format("%s -- ID: %s", selectedSound.Name, selectedSound.SoundId or ""))
                end
                local payload = table.concat(lines, "\n")
                if type(setclipboard) == "function" then
                    local ok = pcall(setclipboard, payload)
                    if ok then
                        notify(T("copied") .. " (" .. tostring(#lines) .. ")", 3)
                        return
                    end
                end
                notify(T("clipboardUnavailable", payload), 8)
            end
        })

        local function cleanupPlayback()
            for _, clone in ipairs(state.activeClones) do
                pcall(function()
                    clone:Stop()
                    clone:Destroy()
                end)
            end
            table.clear(state.activeClones)

            for _, original in ipairs(state.activeOriginals) do
                pcall(function()
                    original:Stop()
                end)
            end
            table.clear(state.activeOriginals)

            for original, oldLooped in pairs(state.originalLoopValues) do
                if original and original.Parent then
                    pcall(function()
                        original.Looped = oldLooped
                    end)
                end
            end
            table.clear(state.originalLoopValues)
            state.isPlaying = false
        end

        local function stopPlayback(showStatus)
            state.playbackToken += 1
            cleanupPlayback()
            if showStatus ~= false then
                setStatus(T("stopped"))
            end
        end

        local function preparePlaybackSound(original)
            if not original or not original.Parent or not original:IsA("Sound") then
                return nil, nil
            end

            if state.mode == "CLIENT" then
                local ok, clone = pcall(function()
                    return original:Clone()
                end)
                if not ok or not clone then
                    return nil, nil
                end

                clone.Name = "REX_Local_" .. original.Name
                clone.Looped = false
                clone.PlayOnRemove = false

                local parent = original.Parent
                if not parent or not parent:IsDescendantOf(game) then
                    parent = SoundService
                end
                clone.Parent = parent
                table.insert(state.activeClones, clone)
                return clone, clone
            end

            if state.originalLoopValues[original] == nil then
                state.originalLoopValues[original] = original.Looped
            end
            original.Looped = false
            if not table.find(state.activeOriginals, original) then
                table.insert(state.activeOriginals, original)
            end
            return original, nil
        end

        local function playOne(original, token)
            local playbackSound, clone = preparePlaybackSound(original)
            if not playbackSound then
                return
            end

            local ended = false
            local connection = playbackSound.Ended:Connect(function()
                ended = true
            end)

            -- Reset the position before every pass. This is important when the
            -- same original Sound is replayed by the loop after reaching its end.
            local ok = pcall(function()
                playbackSound:Stop()
                playbackSound.TimePosition = 0
                playbackSound:Play()
            end)

            if not ok then
                connection:Disconnect()
                if clone then
                    pcall(function() clone:Destroy() end)
                    for index = #state.activeClones, 1, -1 do
                        if state.activeClones[index] == clone then
                            table.remove(state.activeClones, index)
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
                return
            end

            local startTime = os.clock()
            local hasStarted = false
            while token == state.playbackToken and playbackSound.Parent and not ended do
                if playbackSound.IsPlaying then
                    hasStarted = true
                end

                -- Ended is the primary completion signal. TimeLength is a
                -- fallback for assets/contexts where Ended is not delivered.
                if hasStarted and playbackSound.TimeLength > 0
                    and playbackSound.TimePosition >= playbackSound.TimeLength - 0.05 then
                    break
                end

                -- Do not wait forever for an unavailable or unplayable asset.
                if not hasStarted and os.clock() - startTime >= 20 then
                    break
                end

                task.wait(0.05)
            end

            connection:Disconnect()
            if clone then
                pcall(function()
                    clone:Stop()
                    clone:Destroy()
                end)
                for index = #state.activeClones, 1, -1 do
                    if state.activeClones[index] == clone then
                        table.remove(state.activeClones, index)
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        local function finishPlayback(token)
            if token ~= state.playbackToken then
                return
            end
            cleanupPlayback()
            setStatus(T("finished"))
        end

        local function startPlayback()
            updateSelectionDisplay()
            local list = {}
            for _, sound in ipairs(state.selectedList) do
                if sound and sound.Parent and sound:IsA("Sound") then
                    table.insert(list, sound)
                end
            end

            if #list == 0 then
                setStatus(T("nothingSelected"))
                notify(T("nothingSelected"), 3)
                return
            end

            stopPlayback(false)
            state.playbackToken += 1
            local token = state.playbackToken
            state.isPlaying = true
            setStatus(T("started"))

            task.spawn(function()
                while token == state.playbackToken do
                    if state.playbackKind == "ALL" then
                        -- Start the selected sounds together, then wait until
                        -- every sound in this pass has finished before replaying.
                        local remaining = #list
                        for _, sound in ipairs(list) do
                            task.spawn(function()
                                playOne(sound, token)
                                remaining -= 1
                            end)
                        end

                        while token == state.playbackToken and remaining > 0 do
                            task.wait(0.05)
                        end
                    else
                        -- One-by-one mode completes the full list before the
                        -- next loop pass begins.
                        for _, sound in ipairs(list) do
                            if token ~= state.playbackToken then
                                break
                            end
                            setStatus(T("started") .. " " .. sound.Name)
                            playOne(sound, token)
                        end
                    end

                    -- Loop means replay the complete selection continuously.
                    -- Turning it off lets the current pass finish, then exits.
                    if token ~= state.playbackToken or not state.loopEnabled then
                        break
                    end
                    task.wait(0.1)
                end

                finishPlayback(token)
            end)
        end

        PlaybackTab:CreateSection(T("mode"))

        PlaybackTab:CreateDropdown({
            Name = T("mode"),
            Options = {T("client"), T("server")},
            CurrentOption = {T("client")},
            MultipleOptions = false,
            Flag = "REX_PlaybackMode",
            Callback = function(options)
                local value = options and options[1]
                state.mode = (value == T("server")) and "SERVER" or "CLIENT"
                updateModeStatus()
            end
        })

        PlaybackTab:CreateDropdown({
            Name = T("playbackType"),
            Options = {T("all"), T("oneByOne")},
            CurrentOption = {T("all")},
            MultipleOptions = false,
            Flag = "REX_PlaybackKind",
            Callback = function(options)
                local value = options and options[1]
                state.playbackKind = (value == T("oneByOne")) and "ONE_BY_ONE" or "ALL"
            end
        })

        PlaybackTab:CreateToggle({
            Name = T("loop"),
            CurrentValue = false,
            Flag = "REX_Loop",
            Callback = function(value)
                state.loopEnabled = value
            end
        })

        PlaybackTab:CreateButton({
            Name = T("inject"),
            Callback = startPlayback
        })

        PlaybackTab:CreateButton({
            Name = T("stop"),
            Callback = function()
                stopPlayback(true)
            end
        })

        StatusTab:CreateSection(T("status"))
        StatusLabel = StatusTab:CreateLabel(T("idle"))
        StatusCurrentLabel = StatusTab:CreateLabel(T("filteringStatus", T("filteringUnknown")))
        StatusModeLabel = StatusTab:CreateLabel(T("currentMode", T("client")))
        StatusTab:CreateLabel(T("statusExplanation"))
        StatusTab:CreateLabel(T("filteringTrueInfo"))
        StatusTab:CreateLabel(T("filteringFalseInfo"))
        StatusTab:CreateLabel(T("serverModeInfo"))
        StatusTab:CreateLabel(T("clientModeInfo"))

        -- Show the replication warning controls only when the live property
        -- is explicitly TRUE. FALSE or an unreadable value keeps this section hidden.
        if getFilteringState() == true then
            StatusTab:CreateSection(T("filterWarningTitle"))
            StatusTab:CreateLabel(T("filterWarningBody"))
            StatusTab:CreateButton({
                Name = T("stay"),
                Callback = function()
                    notify(T("idle"), 3)
                end
            })
            StatusTab:CreateButton({
                Name = T("leave"),
                Callback = function()
                    LocalPlayer:Kick(T("leaveMessage"))
                end
            })
        end

        StatusTab:CreateSection(T("rejoin"))
        StatusTab:CreateButton({
            Name = T("rejoin"),
            Callback = function()
                setStatus(T("teleporting"))
                local ok, err = pcall(function()
                    TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, game.JobId, LocalPlayer)
                end)
                if not ok then
                    local message = T("teleportFailed", tostring(err))
                    setStatus(message)
                    notify(message, 6)
                end
            end
        })
        StatusTab:CreateButton({
            Name = T("randomServer"),
            Callback = function()
                setStatus(T("randomServerSearching"))
                task.spawn(function()
                    local ok, result = pcall(function()
                        local endpoint = "https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/"
                            .. tostring(game.PlaceId)
                            .. "/servers/Public?sortOrder=Asc&limit=100"
                        local response = game:HttpGet(endpoint)
                        local decoded = HttpService:JSONDecode(response)
                        local candidates = {}

                        for _, server in ipairs(decoded.data or {}) do
                            if server.id and server.id ~= game.JobId
                                and (server.playing or 0) < (server.maxPlayers or math.huge) then
                                table.insert(candidates, server.id)
                            end
                        end

                        if #candidates == 0 then
                            error(T("randomServerFailed"))
                        end

                        local targetId = candidates[math.random(1, #candidates)]
                        TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, targetId, LocalPlayer)
                    end)

                    if not ok then
                        local message = T("randomServerFailed") .. " " .. tostring(result)
                        setStatus(message)
                        notify(message, 7)
                    end
                end)
            end
        })

        -- Read-only status. The value is read from the live SoundService
        -- property available to the client; this script never changes it.
        local warnedFilteringTrue = false
        local function refreshFilteringStatus()
            updateModeStatus()
            local filteringNow = getFilteringState()

            if filteringNow == true and not warnedFilteringTrue then
                warnedFilteringTrue = true
                notify(T("filterWarningBody") .. " " .. T("stay") .. " / " .. T("leave"), 8)
            elseif filteringNow == false then
                warnedFilteringTrue = false
            end

            return filteringNow
        end

        refreshFilteringStatus()

        -- Update immediately when Roblox reports a property change.
        -- The periodic refresh remains as a fallback for UI/status recovery.
        local filteringChangedConnection
        pcall(function()
            filteringChangedConnection = SoundService:GetPropertyChangedSignal(
                "RespectFilteringEnabled"
            ):Connect(refreshFilteringStatus)
        end)

        task.spawn(function()
            while started do
                refreshFilteringStatus()
                task.wait(2)
            end

            if filteringChangedConnection then
                filteringChangedConnection:Disconnect()
            end
        end)

        local SCAN_DURATION = 60
        local function scanSounds()
            if state.scanning then
                notify(T("scanBusy"), 3)
                return
            end

            state.scanning = true
            state.scanToken += 1
            local thisScan = state.scanToken
            setStatus(T("scanning", 0))

            task.spawn(function()
                local descendants = game:GetDescendants()
                local found = {}
                local addedConnection

                local seenIds = {}
                local defaultCharacterSoundNames = {
                    running = true, jumping = true, freefalling = true, gettingup = true,
                    landing = true, climbing = true, swimming = true, splash = true,
                    died = true, footsteps = true
                }

                local function canonicalSoundId(soundId)
                    local raw = tostring(soundId or ""):gsub("%s+", "")
                    local numeric = raw:match("rbxassetid://(%d+)")
                        or raw:match("[?&]id=(%d+)")
                    return numeric or raw:lower()
                end

                local function isRobloxDefaultSound(object)
                    local id = tostring(object.SoundId or ""):lower()
                    if id:match("^rbxasset://") then
                        return true
                    end

                    local ancestor = object.Parent
                    while ancestor and ancestor ~= game do
                        local name = tostring(ancestor.Name):lower()
                        if name == "rbxcharactersounds" or name == "playermodule" or name == "robloxgui" then
                            return true
                        end
                        ancestor = ancestor.Parent
                    end

                    local model = object:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                    if model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) then
                        if defaultCharacterSoundNames[tostring(object.Name):lower()] then
                            return true
                        end
                    end
                    return false
                end

                local function addSound(object)
                    if not object or not object:IsA("Sound") or object.SoundId == ""
                        or object.Name:match("^REX_Local_") or isRobloxDefaultSound(object) then
                        return
                    end
                    local idKey = canonicalSoundId(object.SoundId)
                    if idKey == "" or seenIds[idKey] then
                        return
                    end
                    seenIds[idKey] = true
                    table.insert(found, object)
                end

                -- Track newly-created sounds without launching another full scan.
                addedConnection = game.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
                    if thisScan == state.scanToken then
                        addSound(object)
                    end
                end)

                local total = #descendants
                local batches = 600
                local batchSize = math.max(1, math.ceil(total / batches))
                local startedAt = os.clock()
                local lastProgressAt = 0

                for first = 1, total, batchSize do
                    if thisScan ~= state.scanToken then
                        if addedConnection then addedConnection:Disconnect() end
                        state.scanning = false
                        return
                    end

                    local last = math.min(first + batchSize - 1, total)
                    for index = first, last do
                        addSound(descendants[index])
                    end

                    local elapsed = os.clock() - startedAt
                    local progress = math.min(99, math.floor((last / math.max(total, 1)) * 100))
                    if elapsed - lastProgressAt >= 5 then
                        setStatus(T("scanning", progress))
                        lastProgressAt = elapsed
                    end

                    -- 600 small batches spread over about one minute.
                    local targetElapsed = ((last / math.max(total, 1)) * SCAN_DURATION)
                    local waitTime = targetElapsed - (os.clock() - startedAt)
                    if waitTime > 0 then
                        task.wait(math.min(waitTime, 0.12))
                    else
                        task.wait()
                    end
                end

                local remaining = SCAN_DURATION - (os.clock() - startedAt)
                while remaining > 0 and thisScan == state.scanToken do
                    task.wait(math.min(remaining, 0.25))
                    remaining = SCAN_DURATION - (os.clock() - startedAt)
                end

                if addedConnection then
                    addedConnection:Disconnect()
                end
                if thisScan ~= state.scanToken then
                    state.scanning = false
                    return
                end

                table.sort(found, function(a, b)
                    local aName = a:GetFullName():lower()
                    local bName = b:GetFullName():lower()
                    return aName < bName
                end)

                state.sounds = found
                state.soundByOption = {}

                local options = {}
                local nameCounts = {}
                for index = 1, #found do
                    local sound = found[index]
                    local baseName = tostring(sound.Name)
                    nameCounts[baseName] = (nameCounts[baseName] or 0) + 1
                    local option = baseName
                    if nameCounts[baseName] > 1 then
                        option = string.format("%s (%d)", baseName, nameCounts[baseName])
                    end
                    state.soundByOption[option] = sound
                    table.insert(options, option)
                end
                state.dropdownOptions = options

                -- Remove selections whose instances disappeared.
                for sound in pairs(state.selected) do
                    if not sound or not sound.Parent then
                        state.selected[sound] = nil
                    end
                end
                updateSelectionDisplay()

                pcall(function()
                    SoundDropdown:Refresh(options)
                    SoundDropdown:Set({})
                end)

                state.scanning = false
                if #found == 0 then
                    setStatus(T("scanEmpty"))
                    notify(T("scanEmpty"), 5)
                else
                    local completionMessage = T("scanDone", #found)
                    setStatus(completionMessage)
                    notify(completionMessage, 7)
                end
            end)
        end

        state.scanFunction = scanSounds
        scanSounds()
end

-- Join Discord For More Open Sources, Coming Soon https://discord.gg/axonic

repeat
    task.wait()
until game:IsLoaded() and game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local env = type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or _G
if type(env.AxonicMM2SilentStop) == "function" then
    pcall(env.AxonicMM2SilentStop)
end
local Connections = {}
local function track(connection)
    Connections[#Connections + 1] = connection
    return connection
end
local function connect(signal, callback)
    return track(signal:Connect(callback))
end
local State = {
    Running = true,
    GunAimV2 = true,
    GunRageMode = false,
    GunAimTargetPart = "Head",
    KnifeAim = true,
    KnifeAimV2 = false,
    KnifeRageMode = false,
    KnifeAimTargetPart = "Head",
    KnifeAimFOV = 220,
    RoundCombatSuspended = true,
    WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0,
}
local BypassWeaponAimRedirect = false
local OriginalWorkspaceNamecall
local OriginalWorkspaceRaycastFunction
local WeaponServiceMouseRaw
local WeaponServiceTargetRaw
local getIgnoredParts
local function safeRequire(module)
    if not module or not module:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil end
    local ok, value = pcall(require, module)
    return ok and value or nil
end
local modules = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules", 15)
local CurrentRoundClient = modules and safeRequire(modules:WaitForChild("CurrentRoundClient", 15))
local clientServices = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ClientServices", 15)
local WeaponService = clientServices and safeRequire(clientServices:WaitForChild("WeaponService", 15))
local OriginalWeaponService = {}
if type(WeaponService) == "table" then
    OriginalWeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame = WeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame
    OriginalWeaponService.GetTargetPosition = WeaponService.GetTargetPosition
end
local function premiumGunAimIsEnabled() return false end
local function getGunRageShotCFrames() return nil, nil, nil end
local function isKnifeWallBangRay() return false end
local function getPremiumGunAimCFrame() return nil, nil, nil end

-- Round data
local function getRoundDataRemote()
    local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    local gameplay = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Gameplay")
    local remote = gameplay and gameplay:FindFirstChild("GetCurrentPlayerData")
    if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then return remote end
    return nil
end
local function getRoundData()
    if type(CurrentRoundClient) == "table" then
        if type(CurrentRoundClient.PlayerData) == "table" and next(CurrentRoundClient.PlayerData) then return CurrentRoundClient.PlayerData end
        if type(CurrentRoundClient.GetLatestPlayerData) == "function" then
            local ok, result = pcall(CurrentRoundClient.GetLatestPlayerData)
            if ok and type(result) == "table" then return result end
        end
    end
    local remote = getRoundDataRemote()
    if remote then
        local ok, result = pcall(function()
            return remote:InvokeServer()
        end)
        if ok and type(result) == "table" then return result end
    end
    return {}
end
local function hasWeaponTool(player, weapon)
    for _, container in ipairs({ player.Character, player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") }) do
        if container then
            for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("Tool") then
                    local lowerToolName = string.lower(child.Name)
                    if weapon == "Knife" and (child:FindFirstChild("Stab") or child:FindFirstChild("KnifeClient") or child:FindFirstChild("KnifeLocal")
                            or CollectionService:HasTag(child, "Weapon_Knife")) then
                        return true
                    end
                    if weapon == "Gun" and (child:FindFirstChild("IsGun") or CollectionService:HasTag(child, "Weapon_Gun") or lowerToolName == "gun") then
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end
local function hasEquippedWeapon(weapon)
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return false end
    for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Tool") then
            local lowerToolName = string.lower(child.Name)
            if weapon == "Knife" and (child:FindFirstChild("Stab") or child:FindFirstChild("KnifeClient") or child:FindFirstChild("KnifeLocal")
                    or CollectionService:HasTag(child, "Weapon_Knife")) then
                return true
            end
            if weapon == "Gun" and (child:FindFirstChild("IsGun") or CollectionService:HasTag(child, "Weapon_Gun") or lowerToolName == "gun") then
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end
local function getPlayerRole(player, playerData)
    local data = playerData[player.Name]
    if hasWeaponTool(player, "Knife") then return "Murderer", data end
    if hasWeaponTool(player, "Gun") then return "Sheriff", data end
    if type(data) == "table" and data.Dead ~= true and type(data.Role) == "string" then return data.Role, data end
    return nil, data
end
local function getRoundIntel()
    local playerData = getRoundData()
    local intel = { Murderer = {}, Sheriff = {}, Innocent = {}, }
    local alive = 0
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local role, data = getPlayerRole(player, playerData)
        local isAlive = type(data) ~= "table" or data.Dead ~= true
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0 then isAlive = false end
        if role == "Hero" then role = "Sheriff" end
        if isAlive then
            alive += 1
            if role == "Murderer" or role == "Sheriff" or role == "Innocent" then
                table.insert(intel[role], player.Name)
            end
        end
    end
    return intel, alive
end
local function isPlaying()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not character or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
    local playerData = getRoundData()
    local localData = playerData[LocalPlayer.Name]
    if type(localData) == "table" and localData.Dead == true then return false end
    if hasWeaponTool(LocalPlayer, "Gun") or hasWeaponTool(LocalPlayer, "Knife") then return true end
    if type(localData) == "table" then
        local role = localData.Role
        if role == "Murderer" or role == "Sheriff" or role == "Hero" or role == "Innocent" then return true end
    end
    local aliveAttribute = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Alive")
    if aliveAttribute ~= nil then return aliveAttribute == true end
    return humanoid.Health > 0
end
local function getRoot()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    return character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end
local function getInstanceRoot(instance)
    if not instance then return nil end
    if instance:IsA("BasePart") then return instance end
    if instance:IsA("Model") then return instance.PrimaryPart or instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) end
    if instance:IsA("Tool") then return instance:FindFirstChild("Handle") or instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) end
    return instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
end
local function findMurderer()
    local playerData = getRoundData()
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer then
            local role = getPlayerRole(player, playerData)
            if role == "Murderer" then return player end
        end
    end
    return nil
end
local function playerIsAlive(player, playerData)
    if not player or not player.Character then return false end
    local humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
    local data = playerData and playerData[player.Name]
    return type(data) ~= "table" or data.Dead ~= true
end
local getIgnoredParts
local function getCharacterKnifeAimPart(character, mode)
    if not character then return nil end
    if mode == "Torso" then
        return character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            or character:FindFirstChild("Head") or getInstanceRoot(character)
    end
    return character:FindFirstChild("Head") or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        or character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or getInstanceRoot(character)
end
local function getCrosshair()
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then return nil end
    local mouseLocation = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    local x = mouseLocation.X
    local y = mouseLocation.Y
    local playerScripts = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
    local mouseLock = playerScripts and playerScripts:FindFirstChild("MouseLock")
    if mouseLock and mouseLock:GetAttribute("Enabled") == true and UserInputService.PreferredInput ~= Enum.PreferredInput.Gamepad then
        local viewportSize = camera.ViewportSize
        x = viewportSize.X / 2
        y = viewportSize.Y / 2
    end

-- Gun
local function getGunTarget(allowWalls)
    local murderer = findMurderer()
    local playerData = getRoundData()
    if not murderer or not playerIsAlive(murderer, playerData) or not murderer.Character then return nil, nil, nil end
    local character = murderer.Character
    local preferred
    if State.GunAimTargetPart == "Torso" then
        preferred = { character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"), character:FindFirstChild("Torso"), character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),
            character:FindFirstChild("Head"), }
    else
        preferred = { character:FindFirstChild("Head"), character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"), character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),
            character:FindFirstChild("Torso"), }
    end
    local root = getRoot()
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local origin = camera and camera.CFrame.Position or (root and root.Position)
    local targetPart
    for _, part in ipairs(preferred) do
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
            if allowWalls or not origin or hasClearShot(origin, part) then
                targetPart = part
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if not targetPart then return nil, murderer, nil end
    local velocity = targetPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
    if velocity.Magnitude > 120 then velocity = velocity.Unit * 120 end
    local distance = root and (targetPart.Position - root.Position).Magnitude or 0
    local leadTime = math.clamp(0.035 + distance / 2200, 0.035, 0.09)
    local predicted = targetPart.Position + velocity * leadTime
    return CFrame.new(predicted), murderer, targetPart
end
local KnifeAimStickyPlayer = nil
local KnifeAimStickyUntil = 0

-- Knife
local function getKnifeTarget(requireVisible)
    local root = getRoot()
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local aimPoint = getCrosshair()
    if not root or not camera or not aimPoint then
        KnifeAimStickyPlayer = nil
        return nil, nil, nil
    end
    local viewOrigin = camera.CFrame.Position
    local playerData = getRoundData()
    local now = os.clock()
    local fov = math.max(40, tonumber(State.KnifeAimFOV) or 220)
    local function evaluate(player, sticky)
        if player == LocalPlayer or not playerIsAlive(player, playerData) or not player.Character then return nil end
        local role = getPlayerRole(player, playerData)
        if role == "Murderer" then return nil end
        local part = getCharacterKnifeAimPart( player.Character, State.KnifeAimTargetPart )
        if not part then return nil end
        local screenPosition, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        if not onScreen or screenPosition.Z <= 0 then return nil end
        local screenDistance = (Vector2.new(screenPosition.X, screenPosition.Y) - aimPoint).Magnitude
        local allowedFov = sticky and (fov * 1.25) or fov
        if screenDistance > allowedFov then return nil end
        if requireVisible and not hasClearShot(viewOrigin, part) then return nil end
        local distance = (part.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
        return part, screenDistance + distance * 0.025, distance
    end
    if KnifeAimStickyPlayer and now <= KnifeAimStickyUntil then
        local part, _, distance = evaluate(KnifeAimStickyPlayer, true)
        if part then
            local velocity = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
            if velocity.Magnitude > 100 then velocity = velocity.Unit * 100 end
            local leadTime = math.clamp(distance / 180, 0.045, 0.28)
            return CFrame.new(part.Position + velocity * leadTime), KnifeAimStickyPlayer, part
        end
    end
    local bestTarget
    local bestPart
    local bestDistance
    local bestScore = math.huge
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local part, score, distance = evaluate(player, false)
        if part and score < bestScore then
            bestTarget = player
            bestPart = part
            bestDistance = distance
            bestScore = score
        end
    end
    if not bestTarget or not bestPart then
        KnifeAimStickyPlayer = nil
        KnifeAimStickyUntil = 0
        return nil, nil, nil
    end
    KnifeAimStickyPlayer = bestTarget
    KnifeAimStickyUntil = now + 0.28
    local velocity = bestPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
    if velocity.Magnitude > 100 then velocity = velocity.Unit * 100 end
    local leadTime = math.clamp((bestDistance or 0) / 180, 0.045, 0.28)
    local targetPosition = bestPart.Position + velocity * leadTime
    return CFrame.new(targetPosition), bestTarget, bestPart
end

local function isWeaponRay(origin, direction)
    if typeof(origin) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(direction) ~= "Vector3" then return false end
    if os.clock() > (State.WeaponRayWindowUntil or 0) then return false end
    local magnitude = direction.Magnitude
    if magnitude < 297 or magnitude > 303 then return false end
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then return false end
    if (origin - camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude > 3.5 then return false end
    if type(getcallingscript) == "function" then

        if ok and typeof(caller) == "Instance" then
            local path = string.lower(caller:GetFullName())
            if string.find(path, "camera", 1, true) or string.find(path, "zoom", 1, true) or string.find(path, "occlusion", 1, true) then
                return false

            if string.find(path, "gun", 1, true) or string.find(path, "weapon", 1, true) or string.find(path, "shoot", 1, true)
                or string.find(path, "knife", 1, true) or string.find(path, "projectile", 1, true) then

local function raycastToTarget(targetPart)
    if not targetPart or not targetPart.Parent then return nil end
    local targetCharacter = targetPart.Parent
    local targetPosition = targetPart.Position
    local ignored = getIgnoredParts()
    for _, child in ipairs(targetCharacter:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Accessory") or child:IsA("Tool") then
            table.insert(ignored, child)
        end
    end
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.IgnoreWater = true
    local right = targetPart.CFrame.RightVector
    local forward = targetPart.CFrame.LookVector
    local offsets = { -forward * 5, forward * 5, right * 5, -right * 5, Vector3.new(0, 5, 0), Vector3.new(0, -4, 0), }
    for _, offset in ipairs(offsets) do
        local origin = targetPosition + offset
        local direction = targetPosition - origin
        if direction.Magnitude > 0.1 then
            local ok, result = pcall(raycastForGunAimV2, origin, direction, params )
            if ok and result and result.Instance and result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(targetCharacter) then return result end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

    if argumentCount >= 2 and typeof(args[1]) == "CFrame" and typeof(args[2]) == "Vector3" then

        args[2] = args[2].Magnitude <= 5 and throwDirection or targetPosition

    if argumentCount >= 2 and typeof(args[1]) == "Vector3" and typeof(args[2]) == "Vector3" then
        if wallBang and spoofedOrigin then
            args[1] = spoofedOrigin.Position
        end
        args[2] = args[2].Magnitude <= 5 and throwDirection or targetPosition
        return true
    end
    for index = 1, argumentCount do
        local valueType = typeof(args[index])
        if valueType == "CFrame" then
            if wallBang and index == 1 and argumentCount > 1 and spoofedOrigin then
                args[index] = spoofedOrigin
            else
                args[index] = targetCFrame

-- Weapon hooks
local function installNamecallHook()
    if OriginalWorkspaceNamecall or type(hookmetamethod) ~= "function" or type(getnamecallmethod) ~= "function" then return end
    local namecallHook
    namecallHook = function(self, ...)
        local method = getnamecallmethod()
        local args = { ... }
        local argumentCount = select("#", ...)
        if not State.RoundCombatSuspended and (State.KnifeAim or State.KnifeRageMode or (State.KnifeAimV2))
            and (method == "FireServer" or method == "InvokeServer") and isKnifeThrowRemote(self) then
            local rewritten = rewriteKnifeArgs(args, argumentCount)
            if rewritten then
                local dispatchResults = table.pack(pcall(sendWeaponRemote, self, method, args, argumentCount ))
                if not dispatchResults[1] then return nil end
                State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
                return table.unpack(dispatchResults, 2, dispatchResults.n)
            end
            State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
            return sendWeaponRemote(self, method, args, argumentCount)
        end
        if not State.RoundCombatSuspended and (State.GunAimV2 or State.GunRageMode or premiumGunAimIsEnabled())
            and (method == "FireServer" or method == "InvokeServer") and isGunShotRemote(self) then
            local rewritten = rewriteGunArgs(args, argumentCount)
            if rewritten then
                local dispatchResults = table.pack(pcall(sendWeaponRemote, self, method, args, argumentCount ))
                if not dispatchResults[1] then return nil end
                State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
                return table.unpack(dispatchResults, 2, dispatchResults.n)
            end
            State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
            return sendWeaponRemote(self, method, args, argumentCount)
        end
        if self == workspace and method == "Raycast" and not BypassWeaponAimRedirect and not State.RoundCombatSuspended and isPlaying() then
            if hasEquippedWeapon("Gun") and not State.GunRageMode and (State.GunAimV2 or premiumGunAimIsEnabled()) and isWeaponRay(args[1], args[2]) then
                local result = getGunRayHit(args[3])
                if result then
                    State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
                    return result
                end
            end
            if hasEquippedWeapon("Knife") and (State.KnifeAim or State.KnifeRageMode or (State.KnifeAimV2))
                and ((State.KnifeRageMode and isKnifeWallBangRay(args[1], args[2])) or (not State.KnifeRageMode and isWeaponRay(args[1], args[2]))) then
                local result = getKnifeRayHit()
                if result then
                    State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
                    return result
                end
            end
        end
        return callOriginal(self, method, args, argumentCount)
    end
    OriginalWorkspaceNamecall = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", type(newcclosure) == "function" and newcclosure(namecallHook) or namecallHook )
end

local function installWeaponHook()
    if type(WeaponService) ~= "table" or WeaponService.AxonicAimHooked then return end
    WeaponService.AxonicAimHooked = true
    local function redirectedTargetCFrame()
        if State.RoundCombatSuspended then return nil end
        if os.clock() > (State.WeaponRayWindowUntil or 0) then return nil end
        if (State.GunAimV2 or premiumGunAimIsEnabled()) and not State.GunRageMode and isPlaying() and hasEquippedWeapon("Gun") then
            local targetCFrame = getGunTargetCFrame()
            if targetCFrame then return targetCFrame end
        end
        if (State.KnifeAim or State.KnifeRageMode or (State.KnifeAimV2)) and isPlaying() and hasEquippedWeapon("Knife") then
            local targetCFrame = getKnifeTarget(State.KnifeRageMode ~= true)
            if targetCFrame then return targetCFrame end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local mouseWrapper
    local targetWrapper
    mouseWrapper = function(...)
        local redirected = redirectedTargetCFrame()
        if redirected then return redirected end
        local raw = WeaponServiceMouseRaw or OriginalWeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame
        if type(raw) == "function" then return raw(...) end
        return CFrame.new()
    end
    targetWrapper = function(...)
        local redirected = redirectedTargetCFrame()
        if redirected then return redirected end
        local raw = WeaponServiceTargetRaw or OriginalWeaponService.GetTargetPosition
        if type(raw) == "function" then return raw(...) end
        return CFrame.new()
    end
    if type(newcclosure) == "function" then
        mouseWrapper = newcclosure(mouseWrapper)
        targetWrapper = newcclosure(targetWrapper)
    end
    local hooked = false
    if type(hookfunction) == "function" and type(OriginalWeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame) == "function"
        and type(OriginalWeaponService.GetTargetPosition) == "function" then
        local okMouse, rawMouse = pcall(hookfunction, OriginalWeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame, mouseWrapper )
        local okTarget, rawTarget = pcall(hookfunction, OriginalWeaponService.GetTargetPosition, targetWrapper )
        if okMouse and okTarget and type(rawMouse) == "function" and type(rawTarget) == "function" then
            WeaponServiceMouseRaw = rawMouse
            WeaponServiceTargetRaw = rawTarget
            hooked = true
        end
    end
    if not hooked then
        WeaponServiceMouseRaw = OriginalWeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame
        WeaponServiceTargetRaw = OriginalWeaponService.GetTargetPosition
        WeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame = mouseWrapper
        WeaponService.GetTargetPosition = targetWrapper
    end
end

            Font = font or Enum.Font.Gotham,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
        }, obj)
    end

    local width, height = 360, 240
    local panel = make("Frame", {
        Name = "Window",
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5),
        Position = UDim2.fromScale(.5, .5),
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height),
        BackgroundColor3 = theme.Window,
        ClipsDescendants = true,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, gui)
    round(panel, 7)
    outline(panel, theme.BorderBright, .34)
    local scale = make("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, panel)

    local header = make("Frame", {
        Name = "Header",
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 49),
        BackgroundColor3 = theme.Header,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, panel)
    round(header, 7)
    make("Frame", {
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 7),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -7),
        BackgroundColor3 = theme.Header,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, header)
    make("Frame", {
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -1),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
        BackgroundColor3 = theme.Border,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, header)

    label(header, "Axonic", 15, 6, 220, 20, 15, theme.Text, Enum.Font.GothamBold)
    label(header, "MM2  /  Open Source", 15, 26, 225, 13, 10, theme.Muted)

    local dragHandle = make("TextButton", {
        Name = "DragHandle",
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 1, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = "",
        Active = true,
        AutoButtonColor = false,
        ZIndex = 2,
    }, header)

    local close = make("TextButton", {
        Name = "Close",
        Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 11),
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(27, 27),
        BackgroundColor3 = theme.Button,
        Text = "×",
        TextSize = 15,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
        TextColor3 = theme.Muted,
        AutoButtonColor = false,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ZIndex = 3,
    }, header)
    round(close, 3)
    outline(close, theme.Border, .3)
    close.MouseEnter:Connect(function() close.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Hover end)
    close.MouseLeave:Connect(function() close.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Button end)
    close.Activated:Connect(function()
        gui:Destroy()
        discordGui = nil
    end)

    local dragging = false
    local dragStart, startPosition, touchInput
    dragHandle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        local kind = input.UserInputType
        if kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPosition = panel.Position
        touchInput = kind == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input or nil
    end)

    connect(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
        if not dragging or not panel.Parent then return end
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input ~= touchInput then return end
        local viewport = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
        if not viewport then return end
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        local halfWidth = panel.AbsoluteSize.X * .5
        local halfHeight = panel.AbsoluteSize.Y * .5
        local centerX = viewport.X * startPosition.X.Scale + startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X
        local centerY = viewport.Y * startPosition.Y.Scale + startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        panel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
            math.clamp(centerX, math.min(halfWidth + 8, viewport.X * .5), math.max(viewport.X - halfWidth - 8, viewport.X * .5)),
            math.clamp(centerY, math.min(halfHeight + 8, viewport.Y * .5), math.max(viewport.Y - halfHeight - 8, viewport.Y * .5))
        )
    end)
    connect(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input == touchInput then
            dragging = false
            touchInput = nil
        end
    end)

    label(panel, "OPEN-SOURCE SCRIPTS", 15, 59, 220, 14, 10, theme.Faint, Enum.Font.GothamBold)

    for index, name in ipairs({"Blox Fruits", "Murder Mystery 2", "RIVALS"}) do
        local row = make("Frame", {
            Name = "Game" .. index,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 79 + (index - 1) * 33),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 29),
            BackgroundColor3 = theme.Card,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
        }, panel)
        round(row, 3)
        outline(row, theme.Border, .27)
        label(row, name, 13, 0, 285, 29, 12, theme.Text, Enum.Font.GothamMedium)
    end

    label(panel, "discord.gg/axonic", 15, 184, 180, 13, 10, theme.Muted)

    local copyButton = make("TextButton", {
        Name = "CopyDiscordInvite",
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 204),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 28),
        BackgroundColor3 = theme.Button,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Text = "COPY DISCORD",
        TextSize = 11,
        TextColor3 = theme.Text,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
        AutoButtonColor = false,
    }, panel)
    round(copyButton, 4)
    outline(copyButton, theme.BorderBright, .3)
    copyButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function() copyButton.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Hover end)
    copyButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function() copyButton.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Button end)
    copyButton.Activated:Connect(function()
        local clipboard = setclipboard or toclipboard
        local copied = type(clipboard) == "function" and pcall(clipboard, "https://discord.gg/axonic")
        copyButton.Text = copied and "COPIED" or "discord.gg/axonic"
    end)

    local lastViewport
    local function fit()
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local viewport = camera and camera.ViewportSize
        if not viewport or viewport == lastViewport then return end
        lastViewport = viewport
        scale.Scale = math.clamp(math.min((viewport.X - 24) / width, (viewport.Y - 24) / height), .6, 1)
    end
    fit()
    connect(game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped, function()
        if gui.Parent then fit() end
    end)
end


pcall(makeDiscordPopup)

env.AxonicMM2SilentStop = function()
    State.Running = false
    State.GunAimV2 = false
    State.KnifeAim = false
    State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
    if type(WeaponService) == "table" then WeaponService.AxonicAimHooked = nil end
    for _, connection in ipairs(Connections) do
        pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end)
    end
    if discordGui and discordGui.Parent then discordGui:Destroy() end
end

--// MERTHUB BETA // FULL RGB EDITION
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

local okCore, coreGui = pcall(function() return game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
local ParentGui = (okCore and coreGui) or LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

if ParentGui:FindFirstChild("MertHub_Beta") then
    ParentGui.MertHub_Beta:Destroy()
end

local OriginalLighting = {
    Ambient = Lighting.Ambient,
    OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
    ColorShift_Top = Lighting.ColorShift_Top,
    FogColor = Lighting.FogColor,
    Brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
    ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime,
    GlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
    EnvironmentDiffuseScale = Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale,
    EnvironmentSpecularScale = Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale
}

local Settings = {
    AimbotEnabled = true,
    ShowFOV = true,
    FOVRadius = 90,
    Smoothness = 1,
    RGBSpeed = 0.5,
    LockedColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0),
    TeamCheck = false,

    BoxESP = false,
    NameESP = false,
    HealthESP = false,
    TracerESP = false,
    ESPTeamCheck = false,

    WalkSpeed = 16,
    JumpPower = 50,
    InfiniteJump = false,
    FlyEnabled = false,
    FlySpeed = 65,
    Noclip = false,

    SpinEnabled = false,
    SpinSpeed = 25,
    LowGravity = false,
    RGBWorld = false,
    RGBWorldSpeed = 0.35,
    ShadersEnabled = false,
    ShaderClockTime = 17.6,

    MenuOpen = true,
    ToggleKey = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift,
    UIRGBSpeed = 0.35,
    BgBrightness = 0.78,
    CardTransparency = 0.26
}

local Connections = {}
local DynamicCards = {}
local isRightClickHeld = false
local lockedTarget = nil
local isBindingKey = false

local RGBPool = { Strokes = {}, Texts = {}, Backgrounds = {}, Gradients = {} }

local function Create(className, props, parent)
    local inst = Instance.new(className)
    for k, v in pairs(props) do
        inst[k] = v
    end
    if parent then
        inst.Parent = parent
    end
    return inst
end

local function AddCorner(parent, radius)
    return Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or 8) }, parent)
end

local function AddRGBStroke(parent, thickness, transparency)
    local stroke = Create("UIStroke", {
        Thickness = thickness or 1.2,
        Transparency = transparency or 0,
        ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    }, parent)
    RGBPool.Strokes[stroke] = true
    return stroke
end

--// FOV Circle
local hasDrawing, FOVCircle = pcall(function()
    local c = Drawing.new("Circle")
    c.Visible = Settings.ShowFOV
    c.Radius = Settings.FOVRadius
    c.Color = Color3.fromHSV(0, 1, 1)
    c.Thickness = 2
    c.Filled = false
    c.Transparency = 1
    return c
end)

--// Main GUI
local ScreenGui = Create("ScreenGui", {
    Name = "MertHub_Beta",
    ResetOnSpawn = false,
    ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
}, ParentGui)

local MainFrame = Create("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 690, 0, 430),
    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -345, 0.5, -215),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    ClipsDescendants = true
}, ScreenGui)
AddCorner(MainFrame, 12)
AddRGBStroke(MainFrame, 2.4, 0)

local MainGradient = Create("UIGradient", { Rotation = 35 }, MainFrame)
RGBPool.Gradients[MainGradient] = true

local GlassOverlay = Create("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 15),
    BackgroundTransparency = 0.34,
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    ZIndex = 1
}, MainFrame)
AddCorner(GlassOverlay, 12)

--// TopBar
local TopBar = Create("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 20),
    BackgroundTransparency = 0.25,
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    ZIndex = 2
}, MainFrame)

local TopLine = Create("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -2),
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    ZIndex = 3
}, TopBar)
RGBPool.Backgrounds[TopLine] = true

local BrandTitle = Create("TextLabel", {
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 1, 0),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 0),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
    Text = "MERTHUB BETA // FULL RGB",
    TextSize = 16,
    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
    ZIndex = 3
}, TopBar)
RGBPool.Texts[BrandTitle] = true

local StatusPill = Create("TextLabel", {
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 185, 0, 24),
    Position = UDim2.new(1, -235, 0.5, -12),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 26),
    BackgroundTransparency = 0.2,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
    Text = "AIMBOT: READY [RMB]",
    TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 250),
    TextSize = 11,
    ZIndex = 3
}, TopBar)
AddCorner(StatusPill, 6)
AddRGBStroke(StatusPill, 1.2, 0)

local HideBtn = Create("TextButton", {
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 28),
    Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0.5, -14),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 30),
    BackgroundTransparency = 0.15,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
    Text = "—",
    TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    TextSize = 13,
    AutoButtonColor = false,
    ZIndex = 3
}, TopBar)
AddCorner(HideBtn, 6)
AddRGBStroke(HideBtn, 1.2, 0)

HideBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Settings.MenuOpen = false
    MainFrame.Visible = false
end)

--// Drag Logic
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
TopBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = MainFrame.Position
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
        end)
    end
end)

TopBar.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

table.insert(Connections, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
end))

--// Sidebar & Navigation
local Sidebar = Create("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 174, 1, -46),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 46),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 20),
    BackgroundTransparency = 0.25,
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    ZIndex = 2
}, MainFrame)

local SideBorder = Create("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 2, 1, 0),
    Position = UDim2.new(1, -2, 0, 0),
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    ZIndex = 3
}, Sidebar)
RGBPool.Backgrounds[SideBorder] = true

local NavList = Create("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -2, 1, -64),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 10),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    ZIndex = 3
}, Sidebar)

Create("UIListLayout", {
    Padding = UDim.new(0, 7),
    HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
    SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
}, NavList)

local BottomDock = Create("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -2, 0, 56),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -56),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 18),
    BackgroundTransparency = 0.2,
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    ZIndex = 3
}, Sidebar)

local DockDivider = Create("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(0.84, 0, 0, 1),
    Position = UDim2.new(0.08, 0, 0, 0),
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    ZIndex = 4
}, BottomDock)
RGBPool.Backgrounds[DockDivider] = true

local ContentArea = Create("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -174, 1, -46),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 174, 0, 46),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    ZIndex = 2
}, MainFrame)

local TabButtons, TabPages = {}, {}

local function CreateTab(name, isBottom, order)
    local btn = Create("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 152, 0, 38),
        Position = isBottom and UDim2.new(0.5, -76, 0.5, -19) or UDim2.new(),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 28),
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.25,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        Text = "   " .. name,
        TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(205, 205, 220),
        TextSize = 13,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        AutoButtonColor = false,
        LayoutOrder = order,
        ZIndex = 4
    }, isBottom and BottomDock or NavList)
    AddCorner(btn, 8)
    local stroke = AddRGBStroke(btn, 1.4, 0.7)

    local indicator = Create("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 20),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0.5, -10),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Visible = false,
        ZIndex = 5
    }, btn)
    AddCorner(indicator, 4)
    RGBPool.Backgrounds[indicator] = true

    local page = Create("ScrollingFrame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -18),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 9),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ScrollBarThickness = 4,
        CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
        AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        Visible = false,
        ZIndex = 3
    }, ContentArea)

    Create("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 9), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, page)
    Create("UIPadding", {
        PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4),
        PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10),
        PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4),
        PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8)
    }, page)

    TabButtons[name] = { Button = btn, Stroke = stroke, Indicator = indicator }
    TabPages[name] = page

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        for tName, data in pairs(TabButtons) do
            local active = (tName == name)
            TabPages[tName].Visible = active
            data.Indicator.Visible = active
            data.Stroke.Transparency = active and 0 or 0.7
            data.Button.BackgroundTransparency = active and 0.1 or 0.3
            data.Button.TextColor3 = active and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(205, 205, 220)
        end
    end)

    return page
end

--// UI Builders
local function AddHeader(parent, titleText, subtitleText)
    local box = Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, subtitleText and 42 or 26), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 3 }, parent)
    local title = Create("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
        Text = titleText,
        TextSize = 15,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        ZIndex = 4
    }, box)
    RGBPool.Texts[title] = true

    if subtitleText then
        Create("TextLabel", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 22),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
            Text = subtitleText,
            TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(215, 215, 230),
            TextSize = 12,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ZIndex = 4
        }, box)
    end
end

local function AddToggle(parent, titleText, descText, defaultVal, callback)
    local state = defaultVal or false
    local card = Create("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, descText and 52 or 40),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 24),
        BackgroundTransparency = Settings.CardTransparency,
        ZIndex = 3
    }, parent)
    AddCorner(card, 8)
    AddRGBStroke(card, 1.2, 0.45)
    table.insert(DynamicCards, card)

    Create("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -76, 0, 22),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, descText and 6 or 9),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        Text = titleText,
        TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 255),
        TextSize = 13,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        ZIndex = 4
    }, card)

    if descText then
        Create("TextLabel", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -76, 0, 18),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 28),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
            Text = descText,
            TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 210),
            TextSize = 11,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ZIndex = 4
        }, card)
    end

    local switch = Create("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, 24),
        Position = UDim2.new(1, -58, 0.5, -12),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(34, 34, 46),
        Text = "",
        AutoButtonColor = false,
        ZIndex = 4
    }, card)
    AddCorner(switch, 12)

    local knob = Create("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 18),
        Position = state and UDim2.new(1, -21, 0.5, -9) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -9),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
        ZIndex = 5
    }, switch)
    AddCorner(knob, 9)

    local function Refresh()
        TweenService:Create(knob, TweenInfo.new(0.16), { Position = state and UDim2.new(1, -21, 0.5, -9) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -9) }):Play()
        if state then
            RGBPool.Backgrounds[switch] = true
        else
            RGBPool.Backgrounds[switch] = nil
            switch.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(34, 34, 46)
        end
    end
    Refresh()

    switch.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        state = not state
        Refresh()
        if callback then callback(state) end
    end)
end

local function AddSlider(parent, titleText, minVal, maxVal, defaultVal, callback)
    local value = math.clamp(defaultVal or minVal, minVal, maxVal)
    local card = Create("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 54),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 24),
        BackgroundTransparency = Settings.CardTransparency,
        ZIndex = 3
    }, parent)
    AddCorner(card, 8)
    AddRGBStroke(card, 1.2, 0.45)
    table.insert(DynamicCards, card)

    Create("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0.72, 0, 0, 22),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 5),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        Text = titleText,
        TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 255),
        TextSize = 13,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        ZIndex = 4
    }, card)

    local valTxt = Create("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0.24, 0, 0, 22),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.76, -12, 0, 5),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
        Text = tostring(value),
        TextSize = 13,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
        ZIndex = 4
    }, card)
    RGBPool.Texts[valTxt] = true

    local track = Create("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 9),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 34),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 44),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ZIndex = 4
    }, card)
    AddCorner(track, 5)

    local fill = Create("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new((value - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal), 0, 1, 0),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ZIndex = 5
    }, track)
    AddCorner(fill, 5)
    RGBPool.Backgrounds[fill] = true

    local draggingSlider = false
    local function UpdateFromMouse(input)
        local rel = math.clamp((input.Position.X - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / track.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
        value = math.floor((minVal + (maxVal - minVal) * rel) * 10 + 0.5) / 10
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(rel, 0, 1, 0)
        valTxt.Text = tostring(value)
        if callback then callback(value) end
    end

    track.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            draggingSlider = true
            UpdateFromMouse(input)
        end
    end)

    table.insert(Connections, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            draggingSlider = false
        end
    end))

    table.insert(Connections, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

local ShaderInstances = {}
local function ApplyShaders(enabled)
    for _, inst in ipairs(ShaderInstances) do
        if inst and inst.Parent then inst:Destroy() end
    end
    table.clear(ShaderInstances)

    if enabled then
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
        Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 1
        Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 1
        Lighting.Brightness = 2.3
        Lighting.ClockTime = Settings.ShaderClockTime

        table.insert(ShaderInstances, Create("BloomEffect", { Intensity = 0.85, Size = 28, Threshold = 1.05 }, Lighting))
        table.insert(ShaderInstances, Create("SunRaysEffect", { Intensity = 0.16, Spread = 0.75 }, Lighting))
        table.insert(ShaderInstances, Create("DepthOfFieldEffect", { FarIntensity = 0.14, FocusDistance = 45, InFocusRadius = 35, NearIntensity = 0 }, Lighting))
        table.insert(ShaderInstances, Create("ColorCorrectionEffect", { Brightness = 0.04, Contrast = 0.18, Saturation = 0.25 }, Lighting))
        table.insert(ShaderInstances, Create("Atmosphere", { Density = 0.28, Offset = 0.15, Glare = 0.35, Haze = 1.2 }, Lighting))
    else
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = OriginalLighting.GlobalShadows
        Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = OriginalLighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale
        Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = OriginalLighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale
        Lighting.Brightness = OriginalLighting.Brightness
        Lighting.ClockTime = OriginalLighting.ClockTime
    end
end

local RGBWorldCC = nil
local function SetRGBWorld(enabled)
    if enabled then
        if not RGBWorldCC or not RGBWorldCC.Parent then
            RGBWorldCC = Create("ColorCorrectionEffect", { Saturation = 0.3 }, Lighting)
        end
    else
        if RGBWorldCC and RGBWorldCC.Parent then
            RGBWorldCC:Destroy()
            RGBWorldCC = nil
        end
        Lighting.Ambient = OriginalLighting.Ambient
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = OriginalLighting.OutdoorAmbient
        Lighting.ColorShift_Top = OriginalLighting.ColorShift_Top
        Lighting.FogColor = OriginalLighting.FogColor
    end
end

        nameTxt.Center, nameTxt.Outline, nameTxt.Size, nameTxt.Font = true, true, 14, 2

        healthFill.Filled, healthFill.Transparency = true, 1

        local tracer = Drawing.new("Line")
        tracer.Thickness, tracer.Transparency = 1.5, 1

        return { Box = box, Name = nameTxt, HealthBg = healthBg, HealthFill = healthFill, Tracer = tracer }
    end)
    if ok and data then ESPPool[player] = data end
end

local function RemovePlayerESP(player)
    local data = ESPPool[player]
    if data then
        for _, obj in pairs(data) do pcall(function() obj:Remove() end) end
        ESPPool[player] = nil
    end
end

TabPages["Home"].Visible = true

--// Aimbot Logic
local function isTargetValid(player)
    if not player or player == LocalPlayer then return false end
    if Settings.TeamCheck and player.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then return false end
    local char = player.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    return hum and hum.Health > 0 and head ~= nil
end

local function getClosestTargetInFOV()
    local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    local closest, shortest = nil, Settings.FOVRadius
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if isTargetValid(player) then
            local screenPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(player.Character.Head.Position)
            if onScreen then
                local dist = (Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y) - mousePos).Magnitude
                if dist <= shortest then
                    shortest = dist
                    closest = player
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return closest
end

--// Inputs
table.insert(Connections, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if isBindingKey then return end
    if not gameProcessed and input.KeyCode == Settings.ToggleKey then
        Settings.MenuOpen = not Settings.MenuOpen
        MainFrame.Visible = Settings.MenuOpen
    end
    if not gameProcessed and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 and Settings.AimbotEnabled then
        isRightClickHeld = true
        lockedTarget = getClosestTargetInFOV()
    end
end))

table.insert(Connections, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
        isRightClickHeld = false

end))

table.insert(Connections, UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
