local Players             = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService          = game:GetService("RunService")
local CoreGui             = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local UserInputService    = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace           = game:GetService("Workspace")
local ReplicatedStorage   = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local TweenService        = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
local env    = getgenv()

if env.VD_Cleanup then pcall(env.VD_Cleanup) end
for _, name in ipairs({ "CustomScriptGUI", "VDInterface" }) do
    local old = CoreGui:FindFirstChild(name)
    if old then old:Destroy() end
end
if env.Violence2DESPConn then pcall(function() env.Violence2DESPConn:Disconnect() end) end
if env.ViolenceDrawings then
    for _, d in pairs(env.ViolenceDrawings) do pcall(function() d:Remove() end) end
end
env.ViolenceDrawings = nil

local connections, drawings = {}, {}
local gui

local function connect(signal, fn)
    local c = signal:Connect(fn)
    connections[#connections + 1] = c
    return c
end

local alive = true
env.VD_Cleanup = function()
    alive = false
    for _, c in ipairs(connections) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    for d in pairs(drawings) do pcall(function() d:Remove() end) end
    if gui then pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end) end
end

local cfg = {
    KillerESP     = false,
    SurvivorESP   = false,
    GeneratorESP  = false,
    PumpkinESP    = false,
    Tracers       = false,
    MaxDistance   = 1000,
    AutoGenerator = false,
    AutoSolveTrap = false,
}

local hidden = false

local floor, clamp, max, min = math.floor, math.clamp, math.max, math.min

local function newDrawing(class, props)
    local d = Drawing.new(class)
    for k, v in pairs(props) do d[k] = v end
    drawings[d] = true
    return d
end

local function killDrawing(d)
    drawings[d] = nil
    pcall(function() d:Remove() end)
end

local COLORS = {
    Killer   = Color3.fromRGB(255, 82, 82),
    Survivor = Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255),
    Pumpkin  = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 40),
    GenLow   = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 60),
    GenHigh  = Color3.fromRGB(100, 225, 130),
    Black    = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
    HpLow    = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70),
    HpHigh   = Color3.fromRGB(90, 230, 120),
}

local HEAD_OFFSET = Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0)
local FEET_OFFSET = Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0)

local ESP = { players = {}, gens = {}, pumpkins = {} }

local function createPlayerEntry(plr)
    local e = {
        plr = plr,
        label = plr.Name,
        shown = false,
        isKiller = false,
        box    = newDrawing("Square", { Thickness = 1, Filled = false, Visible = false }),
        hpBack = newDrawing("Line",   { Thickness = 4, Color = COLORS.Black, Transparency = 0.6, Visible = false }),
        hpBar  = newDrawing("Line",   { Thickness = 2, Visible = false }),
        name   = newDrawing("Text",   { Size = 13, Center = true, Outline = true, Font = 2, Visible = false }),
        info   = newDrawing("Text",   { Size = 12, Center = true, Outline = true, Font = 2, Visible = false }),
        tracer = newDrawing("Line",   { Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.7, Visible = false }),
    }
    e.all = { e.box, e.hpBack, e.hpBar, e.name, e.info, e.tracer }
    ESP.players[plr] = e
    return e
end

local function destroyPlayerEntry(plr)
    local e = ESP.players[plr]
    if not e then return end
    for _, d in ipairs(e.all) do killDrawing(d) end
    ESP.players[plr] = nil
end

local function hideEntry(e)
    if e.shown then
        e.shown = false
        for _, d in ipairs(e.all) do d.Visible = false end
    end
end

local function createLabelEntry(extra)
    local e = {
        shown = false,
        text = newDrawing("Text", { Size = 13, Center = true, Outline = true, Font = 2, Visible = false }),
    }
    for k, v in pairs(extra) do e[k] = v end
    return e
end

local function destroyLabelEntry(e) killDrawing(e.text) end

local function hideLabel(e)
    if e.shown then
        e.shown = false
        e.text.Visible = false
    end
end

local function clearTable(t, destroyFn)
    for k, e in pairs(t) do
        destroyFn(e)
        t[k] = nil
    end
end

local function hideAllESP()
    for _, e in pairs(ESP.players) do hideEntry(e) end
    for _, e in pairs(ESP.gens) do hideLabel(e) end
    for _, e in pairs(ESP.pumpkins) do hideLabel(e) end
end

local function isKillerPlayer(plr, char)
    if char and char:FindFirstChild("Killer") then return true end
    if plr:FindFirstChild("Killer") then return true end
    local team = plr.Team
    return team ~= nil and team.Name:lower():find("killer") ~= nil
end

local function scanPlayers()
    if not (cfg.KillerESP or cfg.SurvivorESP) then
        for plr in pairs(ESP.players) do destroyPlayerEntry(plr) end
        return
    end
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= player then
            local e = ESP.players[plr] or createPlayerEntry(plr)
            local char = plr.Character
            e.char = char
            e.hrp  = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            e.hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            e.isKiller = isKillerPlayer(plr, char)
        end
    end
end

local function scanWorld()
    local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")

    if cfg.GeneratorESP and map then
        local folder = map:FindFirstChild("new Generators")
        local seen = {}
        if folder then
            for _, gen in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
                seen[gen] = true
                if not ESP.gens[gen] then
                    local part = gen:FindFirstChild("GeneratorBody")
                        or gen:FindFirstChild("HitBox")
                        or gen:FindFirstChild("RootPart")
                    if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
                        ESP.gens[gen] = createLabelEntry({ part = part })
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        for gen, e in pairs(ESP.gens) do
            if not seen[gen] then destroyLabelEntry(e); ESP.gens[gen] = nil end
        end
    else
        clearTable(ESP.gens, destroyLabelEntry)
    end

    if cfg.PumpkinESP and map then
        local folder = map:FindFirstChild("Pumpkins")
        local seen = {}
        if folder then
            for _, pumpkin in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
                if pumpkin:IsA("PVInstance") then
                    local available = false
                    for _, part in ipairs(pumpkin:GetChildren()) do
                        if (part.Name == "shell" or part.Name == "inside")
                            and part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Transparency < 1 then
                            available = true
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if available then
                        seen[pumpkin] = true
                        if not ESP.pumpkins[pumpkin] then
                            ESP.pumpkins[pumpkin] = createLabelEntry({ inst = pumpkin })
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        for pumpkin, e in pairs(ESP.pumpkins) do
            if not seen[pumpkin] then destroyLabelEntry(e); ESP.pumpkins[pumpkin] = nil end
        end
    else
        clearTable(ESP.pumpkins, destroyLabelEntry)
    end
end

task.spawn(function()
    while alive do
        pcall(scanPlayers)
        pcall(scanWorld)
        task.wait(0.3)
    end
end)

connect(Players.PlayerRemoving, function(plr) destroyPlayerEntry(plr) end)

local function drawLabel(e, pos, text, color)
    local v = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(pos)
    if v.Z <= 0 then
        hideLabel(e)
        return
    end
    local t = e.text
    if e.last ~= text then t.Text = text; e.last = text end
    if e.color ~= color then t.Color = color; e.color = color end
    t.Position = Vector2.new(floor(v.X), floor(v.Y) - 7)
    if not e.shown then t.Visible = true; e.shown = true end
end

connect(RunService.RenderStepped, function()
    if hidden then return end
    camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then return end

    local camPos  = camera.CFrame.Position
    local vp      = camera.ViewportSize
    local maxDist = cfg.MaxDistance

    for _, e in pairs(ESP.players) do
        local isK = e.isKiller
        local hrp, hum = e.hrp, e.hum
        local enabled = (isK and cfg.KillerESP) or (not isK and cfg.SurvivorESP)

        if not enabled or not hrp or not hum or hrp.Parent == nil or hum.Health <= 0 then
            hideEntry(e)
            continue
        end

        local pos = hrp.Position
        local dist = (pos - camPos).Magnitude
        if dist > maxDist then
            hideEntry(e)
            continue
        end

        local top = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(pos + HEAD_OFFSET)
        local bot = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(pos - FEET_OFFSET)
        if top.Z <= 0 or bot.Z <= 0 then
            hideEntry(e)
            continue
        end

        local h = floor(bot.Y - top.Y)
        if h < 6 then
            hideEntry(e)
            continue
        end
        local w = floor(h * 0.55)
        local x, y = floor(top.X - w / 2), floor(top.Y)
        local cx = x + w / 2

        local color = isK and COLORS.Killer or COLORS.Survivor
        if e.color ~= color then
            e.color = color
            e.box.Color, e.name.Color, e.info.Color, e.tracer.Color = color, color, color, color
        end

        e.box.Size = Vector2.new(w, h)
        e.box.Position = Vector2.new(x, y)

        local ratio = clamp(hum.Health / max(hum.MaxHealth, 1), 0, 1)
        local hx = x - 5
        e.hpBack.From = Vector2.new(hx, y - 1)
        e.hpBack.To   = Vector2.new(hx, y + h + 1)
        e.hpBar.From  = Vector2.new(hx, y + h)
        e.hpBar.To    = Vector2.new(hx, y + h - floor(h * ratio))
        e.hpBar.Color = COLORS.HpLow:Lerp(COLORS.HpHigh, ratio)

        local nameText = isK and ("KILLER  " .. e.label) or e.label
        if e.nameText ~= nameText then e.name.Text = nameText; e.nameText = nameText end
        e.name.Position = Vector2.new(cx, y - 16)

        local infoText = floor(dist) .. "m"
        if e.infoText ~= infoText then e.info.Text = infoText; e.infoText = infoText end
        e.info.Position = Vector2.new(cx, y + h + 2)

        if cfg.Tracers then
            e.tracer.From = Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y)
            e.tracer.To   = Vector2.new(cx, y + h)
        end
        e.tracer.Visible = cfg.Tracers

        if not e.shown then
            e.shown = true
            e.box.Visible, e.hpBack.Visible, e.hpBar.Visible = true, true, true
            e.name.Visible, e.info.Visible = true, true
        end
    end

    for gen, e in pairs(ESP.gens) do
        local part = e.part
        if not cfg.GeneratorESP or part.Parent == nil then
            hideLabel(e)
        else
            local pos = part.Position
            local dist = floor((pos - camPos).Magnitude)
            if dist > maxDist then
                hideLabel(e)
            else
                local prog = floor(gen:GetAttribute("RepairProgress") or 0)
                local text = prog >= 100
                    and string.format("Generator - Done - %dm", dist)
                    or  string.format("Generator - %d%% - %dm", prog, dist)
                local color = prog >= 100 and COLORS.GenHigh
                    or COLORS.GenLow:Lerp(COLORS.GenHigh, clamp(prog / 100, 0, 1))
                drawLabel(e, pos, text, color)
            end
        end
    end

    for pumpkin, e in pairs(ESP.pumpkins) do
        if not cfg.PumpkinESP or pumpkin.Parent == nil then
            hideLabel(e)
        else
            local pos = pumpkin:GetPivot().Position
            local dist = floor((pos - camPos).Magnitude)
            if dist > maxDist then
                hideLabel(e)
            else
                drawLabel(e, pos, string.format("Pumpkin - %dm", dist), COLORS.Pumpkin)
            end
        end
    end
end)

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")

local function getRemote(...)
    local inst = Remotes
    for _, name in ipairs({ ... }) do
        inst = inst and inst:FindFirstChild(name)
    end
    return inst
end

local function fire(remote, ...)
    if remote then pcall(remote.FireServer, remote, ...) end
end

local lastCheck = { source = nil, args = nil }

for _, source in ipairs({ "Generator", "Healing" }) do
    local ev = getRemote(source, "SkillCheckEvent")
    if ev then
        connect(ev.OnClientEvent, function(args)
            lastCheck.source = source
            lastCheck.args = args
        end)
    end
end

local function inWindow(line, goal)
    local diff = (line.Rotation - goal.Rotation) % 360
    return diff >= 102 and diff <= 116
end

local function pressSpace()
    task.spawn(function()
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.Space, false, game)
        task.wait(0.04)
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.Space, false, game)
    end)
end

local lastFire = 0

connect(RunService.RenderStepped, function()
    if hidden then return end
    if not (cfg.AutoGenerator or cfg.AutoSolveTrap) then return end
    if tick() - lastFire < 0.4 then return end

    local pg = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    local prompt = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("SkillCheckPromptGui")
    local check = prompt and prompt:FindFirstChild("Check")
    if not check or not check.Visible then return end

    local line = check:FindFirstChild("Line")
    if not line then return end

    local trapGoal    = check:FindFirstChild("TrapGoal")
    local trapPerfect = check:FindFirstChild("TrapPerfect")
    local perfectOn   = trapPerfect and trapPerfect.Visible
    local trapOn      = perfectOn or (trapGoal and trapGoal.Visible)

    if trapOn then
        if not cfg.AutoSolveTrap then return end
        local target = perfectOn and trapPerfect or trapGoal
        if inWindow(line, target) then
            lastFire = tick()
            fire(getRemote("Killers", "Butcher", "TrapSkillResult"), "success")
            fire(getRemote("Killers", "Butcher", "FreeTrap"))
            pressSpace()
        end
    else
        if not cfg.AutoGenerator then return end
        local goal = check:FindFirstChild("Goal")
        if goal and inWindow(line, goal) then
            lastFire = tick()
            local src = lastCheck.source
            if src then
                fire(getRemote(src, "SkillCheckResultEvent"), "success", 1, lastCheck.args)
            else
                fire(getRemote("Generator", "SkillCheckResultEvent"), "success", 1, lastCheck.args)
                fire(getRemote("Healing", "SkillCheckResultEvent"), "success", 1, lastCheck.args)
            end
            pressSpace()
        end
    end
end)

local Theme = {
    RowOff      = Color3.fromRGB(206, 211, 220),
    RowOn       = Color3.fromRGB(34, 36, 42),
    RowOffT     = 0.5,
    RowOnT      = 0.08,
    HoverDelta  = 0.12,
    Text        = Color3.fromRGB(28, 30, 36),
    OnText      = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    IconOff     = Color3.fromRGB(62, 66, 76),
    SubText     = Color3.fromRGB(112, 118, 130),

    FontRegular = Enum.Font.BuilderSans,
    FontMedium  = Enum.Font.BuilderSansMedium,
    FontBold    = Enum.Font.BuilderSansBold,
}

local isTouch = UserInputService.TouchEnabled
local hasMouse = UserInputService.MouseEnabled

local function create(class, props)
    local inst = Instance.new(class)
    for k, v in pairs(props) do
        if k ~= "Parent" then inst[k] = v end
    end
    inst.Parent = props.Parent
    return inst
end

local function corner(parent, r)
    return create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r), Parent = parent })
end

local function tween(obj, time, props)
    TweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(time, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props):Play()
end

local guiParent = (gethui and gethui()) or CoreGui
gui = create("ScreenGui", {

local toastHolder = create("Frame", {

})
create("UIListLayout", {

local function notify(text, on)
    task.spawn(function()
        local toast = create("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(210, 34), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(250, 251, 253),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = toastHolder,
        })
        corner(toast, 8)
        local stroke = create("UIStroke", {
            Color = Theme.Stroke, Transparency = 1, Thickness = 1,
            ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border, Parent = toast,
        })
        local label = create("TextLabel", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = Theme.FontMedium, TextSize = 14,
            TextColor3 = Theme.Text, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTransparency = 1, Text = text, Parent = toast,
        })
        local state = create("TextLabel", {
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -54, 0, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = Theme.FontMedium, TextSize = 13,
            TextColor3 = on and Theme.Text or Theme.SubText,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, TextTransparency = 1,
            Text = on and "On" or "Off", Parent = toast,
        })
        tween(toast, 0.2, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.1 })
        tween(stroke, 0.2, { Transparency = 0.3 })
        tween(label, 0.2, { TextTransparency = 0 })
        tween(state, 0.2, { TextTransparency = 0 })
        task.wait(2)
        tween(toast, 0.25, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
        tween(stroke, 0.25, { Transparency = 1 })
        tween(label, 0.25, { TextTransparency = 1 })
        tween(state, 0.25, { TextTransparency = 1 })
        task.wait(0.3)
        toast:Destroy()
    end)
end

local WIDTH, HEADER_H, ROW_H, GAP, ROWS = 372, 156, 40, 5, 6
local HEIGHT = HEADER_H + 2 + ROWS * ROW_H + (ROWS - 1) * GAP + 16

local window = create("Frame", {
    Name = "Window", Active = true,
    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(WIDTH, HEIGHT),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 0.18,
    BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = gui,
})
corner(window, 18)
create("UIStroke", {
    Color = Theme.Stroke, Transparency = 0.35, Thickness = 1,
    ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border, Parent = window,
})
create("UIGradient", {
    Rotation = 90,
    Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(228, 232, 240)),
    }),
    Parent = window,
})
local uiScale = create("UIScale", { Parent = window })

local function updateScale()
    local vp = gui.AbsoluteSize
    if vp.X <= 0 or vp.Y <= 0 then return end
    uiScale.Scale = clamp(min((vp.X - 24) / WIDTH, (vp.Y - 24) / HEIGHT, 1), 0.45, 1)
end

local function placeAt(target, topLeft)
    local vp = gui.AbsoluteSize
    local size = target.AbsoluteSize
    local x = clamp(topLeft.X, 0, max(vp.X - size.X, 0))
    local y = clamp(topLeft.Y, 0, max(vp.Y - size.Y, 0))
    local ap = target.AnchorPoint
    local pos = target.Position
    target.Position = UDim2.new(
        pos.X.Scale, x + size.X * ap.X - vp.X * pos.X.Scale,
        pos.Y.Scale, y + size.Y * ap.Y - vp.Y * pos.Y.Scale
    )
end

local function isPointer(input)
    return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
end

local function makeDraggable(handle, target, onTap)
    local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startAbs, moved = false, nil, nil, nil, false

    connect(handle.InputBegan, function(input)
        if isPointer(input) then
            dragging = true
            moved = false
            dragInput = input
            dragStart = input.Position
            startAbs = target.AbsolutePosition
        end
    end)

    connect(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
        if not dragging then return end
        local valid
        if dragInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            valid = input == dragInput
        else
            valid = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        end
        if not valid then return end
        local d = input.Position - dragStart
        if d.Magnitude > 6 then moved = true end
        if moved then
            placeAt(target, startAbs + Vector2.new(d.X, d.Y))
        end
    end)

    connect(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
        if not dragging then return end
        local ended
        if dragInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            ended = input == dragInput
        else
            ended = input.UserInputType == dragInput.UserInputType
        end
        if not ended then return end
        dragging = false
        if not moved and onTap then onTap() end
    end)
end

local function makeButton(parent, size, position, iconName, text, getState, onClick, hintText)
    local btn = create("TextButton", {
        Size = size, Position = position or UDim2.new(),
        BackgroundColor3 = Theme.RowOff, BackgroundTransparency = Theme.RowOffT,
        BorderSizePixel = 0, AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", Parent = parent,
    })
    corner(btn, 6)

    local setIconColor = makeIcon(btn, iconName)
    local label = create("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, hintText and -118 or -70, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = Theme.FontMedium, TextSize = 14,
        TextColor3 = Theme.Text, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Text = text, Parent = btn,
    })

    local hintLabel
    if hintText then
        hintLabel = create("TextLabel", {
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 64, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -76, 0, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = Theme.FontRegular, TextSize = 12,
            TextColor3 = Theme.SubText, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
            Text = hintText, Parent = btn,
        })
    end

    local indicator, indicatorStroke
    if getState then
        indicator = create("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), Position = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0.5, -5),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.OnText, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = btn,
        })
        corner(indicator, 5)
        indicatorStroke = create("UIStroke", {
            Color = Theme.SubText, Transparency = 0.2, Thickness = 1.2,
            ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border, Parent = indicator,
        })
    end

    local hover = false
    local function paint()
        local on = getState and getState() or false
        local base = on and Theme.RowOnT or Theme.RowOffT
        tween(btn, 0.14, {
            BackgroundColor3 = on and Theme.RowOn or Theme.RowOff,
            BackgroundTransparency = base - (hover and Theme.HoverDelta or 0),
        })
        local c = on and Theme.OnText or Theme.Text
        tween(label, 0.14, { TextColor3 = c })
        setIconColor(on and Theme.OnText or Theme.IconOff)
        if indicator then
            tween(indicator, 0.14, { BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 1 })
            tween(indicatorStroke, 0.14, {
                Color = on and Theme.OnText or Theme.SubText,
                Transparency = on and 0.4 or 0.2,
            })
        end
    end
    paint()

    if hasMouse then
        connect(btn.MouseEnter, function() hover = true paint() end)
        connect(btn.MouseLeave, function() hover = false paint() end)
    end
    connect(btn.MouseButton1Click, function()
        onClick()
        paint()
    end)
    return btn, hintLabel
end

local function makeSlider(parent, text, min, max, default, callback)
    local row = Instance.new("Frame")
    row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48)
    row.BackgroundColor3 = Colors.BgElement
    row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
    row.Parent = parent
    local rc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    rc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    rc.Parent = row
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 22)
    label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 4)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = text .. ": " .. default
    label.TextColor3 = Colors.TextMain
    label.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    label.TextSize = 13
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.Parent = row

    local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
    bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 6)
    bar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 34)
    bar.BackgroundColor3 = Colors.BgDark
    bar.Parent = row
    local barc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    barc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    barc.Parent = bar

    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Size = UDim2.new((default - min) / (max - min), 0, 1, 0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = Colors.NeonPurple
    fill.Parent = bar
    local fillc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    fillc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    fillc.Parent = fill

    local dragging = false
    addConn(bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = true end end))
    addConn(uis.InputEnded:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = false end end))
    addConn(uis.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if dragging and i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            local rel = math.clamp((i.Position.X - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
            local val = math.floor(min + (max - min) * rel)
            fill.Size = UDim2.new(rel, 0, 1, 0)
            label.Text = text .. ": " .. val
            if callback then callback(val) end
        end
    end))
    return row
end
